You will also deliver used kit to the laundry throughout the day, follow kit-supplier requirements for different training uses and travel when and where the role requires.
Working as part of a supportive team, you will build effective relationships with colleagues across the Academy and provide a professional, service-focused response to changing needs. The role operates on a rota, with flexible hours to meet business requirements, including early and late starts, weekend work and matchdays; there may also be opportunities for international travel with Academy teams.
What You’ll Bring
⚽IT proficiency and the ability to use computerised stock-taking or record-keeping systems accurately.
⚽A clean driving licence and confidence driving as part of the role, including supporting kit deliveries and other team requirements.
⚽Ability to organise kit and equipment carefully so Players and Staff have what they need in a timely way.
⚽Careful attention to detail, with a practical approach to maintaining high housekeeping and kit-management standards.
⚽A flexible approach to working hours, including early starts, late finishes, weekends and matchdays when required.
⚽Self-management and a professional, service-focused approach when supporting colleagues, Players and Staff.
Why Choose Us
Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.
As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.
Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.
How to Apply
If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 25th September 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.The recruitment process will include an initial application screening followed by first-stage interviews for shortlisted candidates.
We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.
Equal Opportunities
City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.
We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.
All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.
Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Head of Physiotherapy
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester, this permanent role will lead the physiotherapy provision for Manchester City Women, helping create the clinical and performance environment that keeps players healthy, available and ready to perform. You will combine clinical leadership, evidence-informed rehabilitation and collaborative decision-making to support the team’s ambition to compete for major honours. 

 

Who We Are 

 

Manchester City Women is a team driven by ambition, belief and a desire to keep pushing the game forward. Founded in 1988 and relaunched in 2014, we have grown into a consistent force in the women’s game, competing at the highest level in the UK and Europe. Progress, performance and pride sit at the heart of everything we do. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are building what comes next, the City way. 

Within Manchester City Women’s Performance Services team, we bring together medical, physiotherapy, soft-tissue and wider performance expertise to support player health and development. Working closely with coaches, players and the wider multidisciplinary team, we create an environment where thoughtful clinical practice and high performance can work together. 

 

The Role 

 

As Head of Physiotherapy, you will shape and oversee the delivery of physiotherapy and soft-tissue services for Manchester City Women. You will lead a team of practitioners and contribute to the planning, review and continuous improvement of services that support injury prevention, effective injury management and successful return to play. 

You will provide clinical leadership across the first team and women’s academy, using evidence-informed rehabilitation, injury surveillance and performance-related data to guide practice. You will maintain high standards of clinical governance, including record keeping, databasing, auditing and emergency action planning, while coordinating specialist and contractor support where appropriate. 

The role is highly collaborative. You will work in partnership with the Manchester City Women’s Doctor, coaches, players and the wider performance team to build trust, enable clear decisions and support player availability. Through line management, mentoring and quality assurance, you will also help develop practitioners and align physiotherapy standards across the pathway. 

 

What You’ll Bring 

 

  • A recognised physiotherapy qualification, with current membership of the Chartered Society of Physiotherapy and registration with the Health and Care Professions Council. 

  • An up-to-date advanced emergency pitch-side qualification, such as ATMMiF or an equivalent qualification. 

  • Experience  providing physiotherapy and rehabilitation support in an elite sporting or high-performance environment, including the assessment and management of complex injuries. 

  • Experience leading service delivery and supporting the development of practitioners through line management, supervision or mentoring. 

  • Knowledge of evidence-informed injury prevention, injury management, rehabilitation and return-to-play practice, with the ability to use clinical and performance data to inform decisions. 

  • Clear and effective communication skills, with the ability to build collaborative relationships with players, coaches, medical colleagues and the wider multidisciplinary team. 

 

Why Choose Us 

 

Working at Manchester City Women means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work. 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance. 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs. 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers. 

 

How to Apply 

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by close of play on 5 October 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can. 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application. 

 

Equal Opportunities 

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation. 

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help. 

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. 

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Matchday Steward (casual contract)
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   0-hour, Casual Contract

Salary/ ROP:       £13.15 per hour


Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

Crystal Palace FC is looking for passionate, well-presented, and engaging individuals to join our Security matchday team. You’ll play a key role in ensuring the safety, safeguarding, and enjoyment of all our guests at Selhurst Park. Representing Crystal Palace FC on the front line, you’ll deliver outstanding service with a smile, support fans, and help create an unforgettable matchday experience. Be part of the energy, excitement, and pride of Selhurst Park as you play a key role in bringing our club to life on matchdays.


Responsibilities:

  • Commit to and attend all Premier League fixtures (schedule to be announced in June) as well as FA Cup games as required

  • Be responsible for the safe access and comfort of spectators visiting the stadium

  • Identify and report any incident, occurrence or hazard among spectators and report to a supervisor

  • Ensure that CPFC standards are upheld by being the first line of contact with guests and provide a welcoming environment to provide the best experience and visit at Selhurst Park Stadium.

  • Maintain an immaculate personal presentation with a polished professional appearance.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

• You must be over 18 (Essential)

• NVQ Level 2 in Spectator Safety (desirable)

• Friendly and happy to help all clients with patience and good manners

• Be mature and be able to handle situations calmly

• Possess excellent interpersonal skills and be polite and courteous

• A strong focus on accuracy and diligence in every aspect

• Good communication skills

• An understanding of body search regulations and processes

• Experience working at a football stadium and/or similar spectator events (Desirable)


Our commitment to Equality

At Crystal Palace Football Club, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion is spirited and continues to grow due to the working environment, which makes all staff feel appreciated and welcomed. Crystal Palace Football Club do this by encouraging good relations and practices towards different groups and are committed to promoting employment opportunities that celebrate diversity.

We are committed to attracting, recruiting, and retaining the most talented candidates and the club intends to ensure that everyone who wishes to engage with the club, whether as matchday fans, staff, players, board members, participants in Foundation programmes and any other person engaged with the club's activities, has a real and equal opportunity to do so.


Reasonable Adjustment

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Employer. We guarantee an interview to all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria for the role, ensuring equitable opportunities for everyone.

If you require disability-related adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact DLO@cpfc.co.uk (DLO inbox is for disability-related queries only, if you wish to gain further information regarding this vacancy, please contact cpfc.recruitment@cpfc.co.uk). We are here to help you through the whole recruitment process including trying to apply for a vacancy, getting in touch with us through the process, and/or helping with access in case you are required to come in for an interview.


Safeguarding

Crystal Palace Football Club is committed to safeguarding and ensuring the welfare and protection of children and vulnerable people and expects all staff to share this commitment. As such, the post holder will be required to undergo any relevant security checks, including a comprehensive background check, Enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) to ensure the safety and protection of children and vulnerable individuals.

You want to be a part of the buzz and excitement of a match day by being the face of Crystal Palace Football Club and providing excellent service to the customers of our many bars and kiosks.

 

Our match days are typically on Saturdays with some weekday evening and Sunday matches and the typical shift day is 6-8 hours depending on the game.


Responsibilities:

  • Take initiative and participate in the set-up of kiosks and bars, stock and supplies

  • Welcome guests and taking orders

  • Process payments on POS devices in an efficient manner

  • Maintain counters and fridges with sufficient supplies of stock throughout the service period, as guided by your manager.

  • Ensure stock rooms and areas are organised and clean, to ensure easy stock rotation and reconciliation.

  • Where necessary, assist in the back of house areas: kitchen and food preparation, pot wash and stock deliveries

  • Perform clean-up duties after each shift and ensure that concession stand is sanitized and tidied to a high standard

  • Serving alcohol responsibly and following the club’s Challenge 25 Policy

  • Adhering to all Health & Safety policies including the club’s Food Safety Management Systems

  • Carrying out any other reasonable duties asked of you from within your team and management including being flexible in covering tasks outside of your role-specific duties.

  • Maintain an immaculate personal presentation with a polished professional appearance.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.

  • A positive attitude and be prepared to help the team

  • Experience in catering, hospitality or food service

  • Strong customer service and communication skills

job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB | Copers Cope Road, Beckenham, London, BR3 1NZ, GB

Crystal Palace Football Club are looking for a self-motivated, detail orientated and hardworking cleaner to join our team. You will be responsible for making sure that the site is clean, presentable. This can entail dusting, polishing, mopping, sweeping, vacuuming, and cleaning smudges off windows and doors.


Responsibilities:

  • Being responsible for all basic cleaning in and around the building.

  • Cleaning floors and rooms - including dust mopping, damp mopping, sweeping, vacuuming, dusting, picking up objects off the floor, and spot cleaning glass and windows.

  • Cleaning restrooms, including restocking dispensers, emptying trash, cleaning and sanitizing fixtures, cleaning mirrors, spot cleaning partition doors and walls, sweeping and mopping tile floors, and cleaning toilets and urinals.

  • Emptying trash, cleaning vacuums and replacing liners

  • Setting up, stocks, and maintains cleaning equipment and supplies.

  • Monitoring and maintaining sanitation and organization of assigned areas.

  • Assisting other departments when needed to ensure optimum service to guests.

  • Liaising with the line manager to ensure that you have sufficient cleaning products at all times.

  • Reporting any breakages that occur during the cleaning process.

  • Informing the line manager of repairs that need to be done.

  • Reporting any large objects obstructing fire exit.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.

Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience in professional cleaning with exceptionally high standards

job.title: Matchday Public Catering Chef (casual contract)
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   0-hour, Fixed-Term Contract

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

If you have experience in preparing and cooking hot food or as a grill chef with a passion for customer service – we want to hear from you! You will be engaging, enthusiastic and have a thirst to learn and grow. You want to be a part of the buzz and excitement of a match day by being the face of Crystal Palace Football Club and serving high quality products throughout the match.

Our match days are typically on Saturdays with some weekday evening and Sunday matches and the typical shift day is 8 hours depending on the game.

Responsibilities:

  • Understanding all menus, product offerings, packaging and pricing

  • Responsible for preparing and cooking all the hot food such as burgers, pies, hot dogs nachos and specialty items for a unit on match day and meeting peak periods with appropriate food levels

  • Maintain high standards of food presentation and quality with regular controls

  • Ensure all products are accounted for, prepared and distributed according to cook-off numbers and instructions from your manager

  • Restock and ensure the food prep area is clean at the end of your shift

  • Ensure all kitchen unit equipment (electrical or otherwise) is cleaned down and properly maintained at the end of every shift

  • Adhere and keep up to date records for food and health and safety standards such as food temperature control levels and following the club’s Food Safety Management System

  • Adhering to all Health & Safety policies and Security policies

  • Carrying out any other reasonable duties asked of you from within your team and management including being flexible in covering tasks outside of your role-specific duties.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Food Safety Level 2 certificate and strong knowledge of proper food handling procedures

  • Experience grilling or cooking food in mass quantities, particularly in a busy or similar environment

  • A can-do attitude and be prepared to help the rest of the team out with a positive attitude

  • Immaculate grooming standards and overall appearance

  • Always look for ways to improve

  • Can work in high pressure situations

About this role:

Crystal Palace Football Club are looking for an experienced and skilled Maintenance operative to perform and upkeep tasks such as repairs, inspections, plumbing, carpentry, painting, decorating, general maintenance and planned improvement services to our facilitates. The individual will be responsible for assisting other trades when required to ensure the highest level of service across our sites.


Responsibilities:

  • Undertake the day-to-day general maintenance repairs in-house for all our facilities but mainly at our Academy Training Ground.

  • Undertake painting work, such as preparing painting surfaces, removing old paint, mixing and matching paints, and to use correct utilities to prepare the surrounding areas in order to prevent messes.

  • Undertake plumbing work, such as fixing leaks, unblocking drains and gutters, shower fitting, and more.

  • Undertake tiling and decorating work, such as, preparing surfaces by levelling off with the correct material, measuring and applying tiles, repairing/removing old surfaces, add more.

  • Undertake carpentry work, such as taking measurements and installing shelves, cabinets, handles, locks and more.

  • Preparation of the facilities for home matches

  • Regular checks and repairs on lights, toilets, and seats.

  • Completing work in accordance with the Crystal Palace specifications and in compliance with the relevant Legislation and industry best practices

  • Working to operational procedures, safe working practices and Health and Safety procedures as required.

  • Providing general support and assistance to the Maintenance Manager

  • Inspecting the Training ground and Academy and it’s adjoining structures on a daily and weekly basis to ensure they are all well-kept and in order.

  • Completing works at other Crystal Palace Football Club grounds and facilities including the Academy Training Ground.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience in a maintenance environment.

  • Experience in plumbing, painting, decorating, carpentry, and general maintenance.

  • Basic knowledge of maintenance systems such as HVAC, plumbing, electrical etc.

  • Ability to read manuals and drawings.

  • Experience using hand and electrical tools.

  • Experience working in large scale stadiums/ buildings.


Benefits:

  • Complimentary match day ticket

  • Reward and Discount Scheme through our Tech Scheme and Simple Health app

  • Health and Wellbeing benefit scheme

  • 20% Discount in our Retail Stores

  • Discounts in various gyms through GymFlex

  • Volunteering Day - 1 Workday off to support a charity of your choice.

  • Travel Season Ticket loan

job.title: Logistics & Fulfilment Operative (Casual Contract)
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   0-hour, Casual Contract

Salary/ ROP:       £13.15 per hour

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

The Logistics Operative plays a vital role in supporting the successful delivery of matchdays and events across Selhurst Park. Responsible for the movement, storage and organisation of food, beverages, equipment and disposables, the role ensures kiosks, bars and hospitality areas are fully stocked, organised and operational.

Working as part of the Public Catering team, the Logistics Operative helps maintain high standards of cleanliness, food safety and operational efficiency, ensuring an exceptional experience for supporters, guests and clients.

Responsibilities:

  • Receive, check and store food, beverage and equipment deliveries.

  • Ensure stock is rotated and stored in accordance with company procedures.

  • Support stock counts and stock reconciliation activities.

  • Report shortages, damages and discrepancies to management.

  • Maintain accurate stock records where required.

  • Prepare kiosks, bars and catering areas for operation.

  • Distribute food, beverage, equipment and disposable stock throughout the stadium.

  • Support premium areas and event spaces with operational requirements.

  • Ensure units are replenished efficiently throughout service.

  • Respond quickly and effectively to operational requests during matchdays and events.

  • Maintain cellar areas to a high operational standard.

  • Support beer line cleaning procedures where required.

  • Ensure food stores, disposable stock rooms and chemical storage areas are clean, organised and compliant.

  • Assist with the movement and handling of kegs and heavy stock items using safe working practices.

  • Complete HACCP, delivery, temperature and cleaning records accurately.

  • Follow all Health & Safety, Food Safety, COSHH and manual handling procedures.

  • Maintain high standards of cleanliness throughout operational areas.

  • Report maintenance issues, hazards and incidents promptly.

  • Work closely with the Stock Controller, Hub Leaders and management team to ensure operational requirements are met.

  • Support colleagues across the department where required.

  • Communicate shortages, equipment failures and operational issues promptly.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience working within hospitality, catering, logistics, warehouse or customer-facing environments.

  • Flexible approach to working hours, including evenings, weekends and matchdays.

  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.

  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to work independently and use initiative.

  • Previous experience within logistics, cellar operations or stock control. (Desirable)

  • Experience working in a stadium, arena or large-scale event environment. (Desirable)

  • Experience handling food and beverage stock. (Desirable)

  • Level 2 Food Safety Certificate. (Desirable)

  • Manual Handling Certificate. (Desirable)

  • Counterbalance Forklift Licence. (Desirable)

  • Personal Licence Holder. (Desirable)

  • First Aid qualification. (Desirable)

job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   0-hour, Casual Contract

Salary/ ROP:       £16.67 p/h

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

The Hub Leader is a senior front-line catering team member responsible for the safe and efficient operation of a designated concession or bar unit on matchdays and events. Acting as the main point of contact within their area, the Hub Leader is responsible for ensuring excellent guest service, accurate stock control and that all team members operate in accordance with Club standards and legal requirements.

Responsibilities:

  • Oversee the full operation of a designated concession or bar unit from set-up to close-down.

  • Attend pre-match/pre-event briefings and prepare the unit for service.

  • Complete close-down duties and support final counts and cleaning.

  • Liaise with the Concessions Supervisor and management team to ensure the smooth operation of the area.

  • Deliver exceptional service to supporters and guests, including dealing with customer complaints and resolving issues in a professional manner.

  • Promote product knowledge and upselling opportunities.

  • Ensure accurate counting and control of food, beverages and disposables.

  • Ensure stock is handled securely and replenished accurately throughout service.

  • Monitor stock usage during the event and communicate shortages proactively.

  • Record wastage, transfers and returns in accordance with training.

  • Maintain regular communication with the Concessions Supervisor and management team.

  • Communicate shortages, equipment failures and maintenance issues promptly.

  • Escalate concerns proactively to minimise disruption to service.

  • Lead by example while supporting, motivating, and developing team members.

  • Ensure key information is effectively communicated to team members.

  • Ensure food safety, hygiene and operational standards are maintained at all times.

  • Ensure all required documentation is completed accurately and on time.

  • Ensure licensing regulations are followed, with particular attention to Challenge 25 and protecting children from harm.

  • Monitor the correct use of PPE, handwashing and food handling procedures.

  • Ensure products are served to agreed specifications and brand standards.

  • Support stock accuracy and waste reduction initiatives.

  • Complete all paperwork accurately and within required timescales.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Previous experience in hospitality, retail, catering, or other fast-paced customer-facing environments.

  • Strong communication, leadership, and customer service skills.

  • Ability to work independently, use initiative, and remain calm under pressure.

  • Previous team leader or supervisory experience.

  • Experience with EPOS systems, cash handling, and stock control.

  • Availability to work evenings, weekends, and public holidays

  • Personal Licence Holder (desirable)

  • Reliable, responsible, and professional, consistently leading by example.

  • Positive and supportive, with the ability to motivate others and remain calm under pressure.

Our commitment to Equality

At Crystal Palace Football Club, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion is spirited and continues to grow due to the working environment, which makes all staff feel appreciated and welcomed. Crystal Palace Football Club do this by encouraging good relations and practices towards different groups and are committed to promoting employment opportunities that celebrate diversity.

We are committed to attracting, recruiting, and retaining the most talented candidates and the club intends to ensure that everyone who wishes to engage with the club, whether as matchday fans, staff, players, board members, participants in Foundation programmes and any other person engaged with the club's activities, has a real and equal opportunity to do so.


Reasonable Adjustment

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Employer. We guarantee an interview to all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria for the role, ensuring equitable opportunities for everyone.

If you require disability-related adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact DLO@cpfc.co.uk (DLO inbox is for disability-related queries only, if you wish to gain further information regarding this vacancy, please contact cpfc.recruitment@cpfc.co.uk). We are here to help you through the whole recruitment process including trying to apply for a vacancy, getting in touch with us through the process, and/or helping with access in case you are required to come in for an interview.


Safeguarding

Crystal Palace Football Club is committed to safeguarding and ensuring the welfare and protection of children and vulnerable people and expects all staff to share this commitment. As such, the post holder will be required to undergo any relevant security checks, including a comprehensive background check, Enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) to ensure the safety and protection of children and vulnerable individuals.

job.title: First Team Physiotherapist
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Training Ground, BR3 1RJ

Contract Type:   Full-time

Deadline:            24th September 2026

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

Crystal Palace FC is seeking an experienced First Team Physiotherapist to provide exceptional physiotherapy services to our Men’s First-Team players through:

  • Progressing individual return-to-play pathways, ensuring optimal player recovery and reducing risk of re-injury (or secondary injury) amongst injured players

  • Maintaining high player availability through the accurate assessment, treatment, and individual programming of non-injured players

Responsibilities:

  • Plan and deliver individualised, evidence-informed rehabilitation programmes aligned with the club's rehabilitation philosophy, team periodisation and the evolving demands of Premier League football.

  • Design and implement individualised short, medium, and long-term rehabilitation programmes tailored to the player’s stage of recovery and position-specific demands, ensuring integration of the broader interdisciplinary team to enhance player experience and drive performance outcomes.

  • Lead and/or contribute to the development of dynamic individual availability/performance plans for allocated players, integrating medical, physical performance, psychological and lifestyle factors.

  • Support holistic player health by reinforcing high-performance behaviours relating to recovery, sleep, nutrition and lifestyle, and appropriately integrating these considerations into individual player plans.

  • Conduct objective testing and data-informed assessments to monitor player progress across key health and performance variables.

  • Contribute to departmental research, audit and innovation, critically appraising emerging evidence and translating relevant findings into clinical practice.

  • Share knowledge across the Men’s First Team, Academy and Women's medical departments and contribute to the development of consistent club-wide clinical and rehabilitation standards.

  • Communicate effectively with the Head of Medical to ensure they are kept up to date on all medical matters relating to Men’s First Team players.

  • Design and deliver daily tailored rehabilitation sessions, both one-to-one and small-group, in the gym and on the pitch for injured players.

  • Liaise closely with all Sport Science and Medical team members to ensure the delivery of a service which inspires player performance through individualised care and positive connection.

  • Develop strong, trusting relationships with players through excellent communication, shared decision-making and clear explanation of diagnosis, risk, rehabilitation progression and availability.

  • Lead and support continual enhancement of injury prevention strategies and rehabilitation protocols, ensuring alignment with evidence-informed best practice in elite sport.

  • Produce phase-specific rehabilitation plans (daily, weekly, medium/long term) and share with key stakeholders.

  • Review and provide your clinical opinion on the management of all Men’s First Team injuries as required by the Head of Medical.

  • Lead on the rehabilitation of injured players as required by the Head of Medical.

  • Accompany players to medical appointments as required.

  • Carry out departmental administration tasks as required.

  • Produce daily and weekly rehabilitation plans for sports science and medicine staff.

  • Participate in pre-signing medical assessments where required, contributing physiotherapy and musculoskeletal expertise to the assessment and communication of future availability risk.

  • Develop the rehabilitation hub of the Crystal Palace Football Club athlete data management system.

  • Maintain the highest standards of clinical governance within a sporting environment, including (but not limited to) the maintenance of accurate and up-to-date clinical notes in keeping with HCPC regulations, participating in After-Action Reviews for all significant events, and updating medical processes in line with evidence-based practice.

  • Contribute to a culture of continuous learning and improvement, including rehabilitation case reviews, after-action reviews, audit, CPD and feedback processes.

  • Demonstrate the professional behaviours expected within a high-trust, high-performance environment, including accountability, collaboration, discretion, adaptability and a commitment to continuous personal development.

  • Take defined ownership of an agreed departmental performance area, such as muscle injury surveillance, rehabilitation frameworks, player availability, clinical audit or another strategic priority.

  • Attend all fixtures as required (according to the staff rota and department needs).

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Demonstrable experience working within elite sport (preferably with experience working in football), with experience managing musculoskeletal injuries and delivering return-to-performance rehabilitation.

  • BSc/MSc in Physiotherapy.

  • Postgraduate qualifications in Sports Medicine / Strength & Conditioning / Sport Science (MSc/PhD) - working towards, or motivated to work towards.

  • HCPC and CSP registration.

  • Up-to-date ATMMIF qualification (or equivalent).

  • Knowledgeable of current football medicine research.

  • Be flexible to support evening, weekend, and match-day rehabilitation and recovery needs when required.

  • Additional language capability, particularly French, Spanish or Portuguese, would be advantageous given the department's explicit strategic objective around multilingual capability.

Benefits:

  • Complimentary match day ticket

  • Reward and Discount Scheme through our Tech Scheme and Simple Health app

  • Health and Wellbeing benefit scheme

  • 20% Discount in our Retail Stores

  • Discounts in various gyms through GymFlex

  • Volunteering Day - 1 Workday off to support a charity of your choice.

  • Travel Season Ticket loan

  • Holiday allowance: 25 Days 

Our commitment to Equality

At Crystal Palace Football Club, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion is spirited and continues to grow due to the working environment, which makes all staff feel appreciated and welcomed. Crystal Palace Football Club do this by encouraging good relations and practices towards different groups and are committed to promoting employment opportunities that celebrate diversity.

We are committed to attracting, recruiting, and retaining the most talented candidates and the club intends to ensure that everyone who wishes to engage with the club, whether as matchday fans, staff, players, board members, participants in Foundation programmes and any other person engaged with the club's activities, has a real and equal opportunity to do so.


Reasonable Adjustment

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Employer. We guarantee an interview to all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria for the role, ensuring equitable opportunities for everyone.

If you require disability-related adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact DLO@cpfc.co.uk (DLO inbox is for disability-related queries only, if you wish to gain further information regarding this vacancy, please contact cpfc.recruitment@cpfc.co.uk). We are here to help you through the whole recruitment process including trying to apply for a vacancy, getting in touch with us through the process, and/or helping with access in case you are required to come in for an interview.


Safeguarding

Crystal Palace Football Club is committed to safeguarding and ensuring the welfare and protection of children and vulnerable people and expects all staff to share this commitment. As such, the post holder will be required to undergo any relevant security checks, including a comprehensive background check, Enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) to ensure the safety and protection of children and vulnerable individuals.

job.title: Editorial Manager
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB | Copers Cope Road, Beckenham, London, BR3 1NZ, GB | BR3 1RJ, Beckenham, London, BR3 1RJ, GB | 21 Warwick St, London, London, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Flexible across our Central London, Selhurst Park, Training Ground.

Contract Type:   Full-time

Deadline:            2nd October 2026

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

Portfolio:

When applying, please include a portfolio of up to three written pieces which you feel best show off your editorial flair. Candidates shortlisted for interview will be required to discuss the context and story behind these pieces. You can share your portofolio by providing the link, or by uploading it as an additional file (at the end of your application).

About this role:

The Editorial Manager is the most senior member of our editorial team, responsible for managing – and contributing to – all written output on cpfc.co.uk, the Official Crystal Palace App and editorial publications (including marketing collateral, and supporting on Men’s and Women’s matchday programmes), as well as App push notifications.

With a communications-first mindset, the successful candidate will be expected to produce a broad range of written content, leading on the Men’s team but supporting on Women’s and Academy sides – and digital initiatives and marketing campaigns – when required.

We are seeking someone to deliver best-in-class storytelling which inspires, informs and connects with our supporters around the world, building off the platform of back-to-back trophy-winning campaigns, whilst also effectively managing our newly redeveloped digital estate on a daily basis.

Based primarily in our Central London offices, but with the flexibility to travel to Selhurst Park and our training facilities in Beckenham as the role demands, this role will be expected to work in the week.

They will also work approximately two-thirds of our Men’s first-team matchdays, both home and away, including in the UEFA Europa League (with subsequent lieu days to be agreed with the Head of Marketing).

In doing so, the successful candidate will develop relationships across the club and assist the football department, marketing, retail, ticketing, commercial, premium hospitality, and operations with their communication requirements. They will need to work at pace, with sensitivity and strong attention to detail.

The successful candidate will manage three editorial line reports (who work across the wider team, but who specialise in our Programme, Women’s and Academy content streams), as well as commission guest contributors.

Responsibilities:

Editorial Content

  • Lead website and Official Palace App content. The Editorial Manager writes the majority of digital content, which can amount to around 30 to 40 articles per week. These can include:
    o Press releases

    o Club announcements

    o Matchday content (pre-match previews; match reports & live blogs; and post-match reaction and features)

    o Short-form and long-form features

    o Marketing collateral

    o Retail & commercial promotions

    o Supporter-focused updates

  • Produce engaging, emotive and innovative feature content that celebrates and showcases the important stories on our respective teams, and the wider club.

  • Commission and maintain the weekly editorial content schedule.

  • Manage a staffing schedule to ensure events/matches are appropriately covered.

  • Play a key role in the delivery of club and Premier League initiatives, such as those centring on Palace for All, Palace for Life Foundation, and Equality, Diversity & Inclusion campaigns.

  • Support with the production process of the Men’s and Women’s matchday programmes.

  • Proofread and edit contributors’ work where necessary.

Digital Management

  • Manage the website’s structure, with a key focus on keeping the newly redeveloped website and App homepages, tabs and news pages fresh and relevant to drive consumption.

  • Ensure that App Push notifications are delivered at an appropriate frequency to target audience(s) and maximise traffic and commercial goals.

  • Using Google Analytics and App analytics dashboards, the ideal candidate will monitor content consumption daily and adjust focus to drive growth.

  • Support colleagues in Marketing to ensure that ensure that campaigns / content / announcements are appropriately targeted to the desired audience(s) on digital channels.

  • Support the Head of Marketing in directing the continual development of cpfc.co.uk and the App, including working with our digital agency partners and raising support tickets.

Other

  • Work approximately two-thirds of Men’s first-team matchdays (with subsequent time off in lieu to be agreed with the Head of Marketing): home and away matches, including those in the Europa League.

  • Line manage the Editorial Executive & Programme Editor; Marketing & Communications Executive (leading on Palace Women); and Editorial Executive (leading on Palace Academy), including matchday rotas, time off and expenses.

  • Develop and maintain working relationships and key contacts across the club.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

You have

  • A minimum of four years’ experience as a journalist/editor/sub-editor of a high-traffic digital platform (ideally working in professional football or digital media).

  • Experience of managing and delivering content in high-pressure environments, such as live sporting events.

  • Sound editorial judgement and an understanding of sensitivities around digital club content.

  • The ability to vary copy to fit audiences, platforms and our club house style.

  • Excellent communication skills.

  • Strong time management, organisational and prioritisation skills.

  • An eye for detail.

  • The ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously as we operate in a fast-moving environment with regular, tight deadlines.

  • Line management experienced preferred.

You are

  • An outstanding copywriter.

  • A best-in-class storyteller.

  • A collaborator, team player by nature.

  • Able to work to tight deadlines, at pace and juggling multiple workflows.

  • Proactive and inquisitive – a self-starter with initiative.

  • Hard-working and committed.

  • Flexible to work weekends and occasional out-of-hours work.

  • As part of the role, you are required to work on approximately two-thirds of our Men’s first-team matchdays (with subsequent time off in lieu to be agreed with the Head of Marketing), including some travel.

  • Additional out-of-hours and matchday work may be required from time to time.

Benefits:

  • Complimentary match day ticket

  • Reward and Discount Scheme through our Tech Scheme and Simple Health app

  • Health and Wellbeing benefit scheme

  • 20% Discount in our Retail Stores

  • Discounts in various gyms through GymFlex

  • Volunteering Day - 1 Workday off to support a charity of your choice.

  • Travel Season Ticket loan

  • Holiday allowance: 25 Days 

Our commitment to Equality

At Crystal Palace Football Club, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion is spirited and continues to grow due to the working environment, which makes all staff feel appreciated and welcomed. Crystal Palace Football Club do this by encouraging good relations and practices towards different groups and are committed to promoting employment opportunities that celebrate diversity.

We are committed to attracting, recruiting, and retaining the most talented candidates and the club intends to ensure that everyone who wishes to engage with the club, whether as matchday fans, staff, players, board members, participants in Foundation programmes and any other person engaged with the club's activities, has a real and equal opportunity to do so.


Reasonable Adjustment

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Employer. We guarantee an interview to all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria for the role, ensuring equitable opportunities for everyone.

If you require disability-related adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact DLO@cpfc.co.uk (DLO inbox is for disability-related queries only, if you wish to gain further information regarding this vacancy, please contact cpfc.recruitment@cpfc.co.uk). We are here to help you through the whole recruitment process including trying to apply for a vacancy, getting in touch with us through the process, and/or helping with access in case you are required to come in for an interview.


Safeguarding

Crystal Palace Football Club is committed to safeguarding and ensuring the welfare and protection of children and vulnerable people and expects all staff to share this commitment. As such, the post holder will be required to undergo any relevant security checks, including a comprehensive background check, Enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) to ensure the safety and protection of children and vulnerable individuals.

Based primarily in our Central London offices, but with the flexibility to travel to Selhurst Park and our training facilities in Beckenham as the role demands, this role will be expected to work in the week.
They will also work approximately two-thirds of our Men’s first-team matchdays, both home and away, including in the UEFA Europa League (with subsequent lieu days to be agreed with the Head of Marketing).
In doing so, the successful candidate will develop relationships across the club and assist the football department, marketing, retail, ticketing, commercial, premium hospitality, and operations with their communication requirements. They will need to work at pace, with sensitivity and strong attention to detail.
The successful candidate will manage three editorial line reports (who work across the wider team, but who specialise in our Programme, Women’s and Academy content streams), as well as commission guest contributors.
Responsibilities:
Editorial Content
- Lead website and Official Palace App content. The Editorial Manager writes the majority of digital content, which can amount to around 30 to 40 articles per week. These can include: o Press releaseso Club announcementso Matchday content (pre-match previews; match reports & live blogs; and post-match reaction and features)o Short-form and long-form featureso Marketing collateraloRetail & commercial promotionsoSupporter-focused updates - Produce engaging, emotive and innovative feature content that celebrates and showcases the important stories on our respective teams, and the wider club. - Commission and maintain the weekly editorial content schedule. - Manage a staffing schedule to ensure events/matches are appropriately covered. - Play a key role in the delivery of club and Premier League initiatives, such as those centring on Palace for All, Palace for Life Foundation, and Equality, Diversity & Inclusion campaigns. - Support with the production process of the Men’s and Women’s matchday programmes. - Proofread and edit contributors’ work where necessary.
Digital Management
- Manage the website’s structure, with a key focus on keeping the newly redeveloped website and App homepages, tabs and news pages fresh and relevant to drive consumption. - Ensure that App Push notifications are delivered at an appropriate frequency to target audience(s) and maximise traffic and commercial goals. - Using Google Analytics and App analytics dashboards, the ideal candidate will monitor content consumption daily and adjust focus to drive growth. - Support colleagues in Marketing to ensure that ensure that campaigns / content / announcements are appropriately targeted to the desired audience(s) on digital channels. - Support the Head of Marketing in directing the continual development ofcpfc.co.ukand the App, including working with our digital agency partners and raising support tickets.
Other
- Work approximately two-thirds of Men’s first-team matchdays (with subsequent time off in lieu to be agreed with the Head of Marketing): home and away matches, including those in the Europa League. - Line manage the Editorial Executive & Programme Editor; Marketing & Communications Executive (leading on Palace Women); and Editorial Executive (leading on Palace Academy), including matchday rotas, time off and expenses. - Develop and maintain working relationships and key contacts across the club. - Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager. - Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.
Experience, Skills and Qualifications:
You have
- A minimum of four years’ experience as a journalist/editor/sub-editor of a high-traffic digital platform (ideally working in professional football or digital media). - Experience of managing and delivering content in high-pressure environments, such as live sporting events. - Sound editorial judgement and an understanding of sensitivities around digital club content. - The ability to vary copy to fit audiences, platforms and our club house style. - Excellent communication skills. - Strong time management, organisational and prioritisation skills. - An eye for detail. - The ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously as we operate in a fast-moving environment with regular, tight deadlines. - Line management experienced preferred.
You are
- An outstanding copywriter. - A best-in-class storyteller. - A collaborator, team player by nature. - Able to work to tight deadlines, at pace and juggling multiple workflows. - Proactive and inquisitive – a self-starter with initiative. - Hard-working and committed. - Flexible to work weekends and occasional out-of-hours work. - As part of the role, you are required to work on approximately two-thirds of our Men’s first-team matchdays (with subsequent time off in lieu to be agreed with the Head of Marketing), including some travel. - Additional out-of-hours and matchday work may be required from time to time.
Benefits:
- Complimentary match day ticket - Reward and Discount Scheme through our Tech Scheme and Simple Health app - Health and Wellbeing benefit scheme - 20% Discount in our Retail Stores - Discounts in various gyms through GymFlex - Volunteering Day - 1 Workday off to support a charity of your choice. - Travel Season Ticket loan - Holiday allowance: 25 Days

job.title: Pre-Academy Manager
job.location: Copers Cope Road, Beckenham, London, BR3 1NZ, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Academy Training Ground, BR3 1NZ

Contract Type:   Full-time

Deadline:            1st October 2026

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

Crystal Palace Football Club is seeking an experienced, forward-thinking and highly organised Pre-Academy Manager to lead the identification, engagement and development of high-potential players aged 6-8 across the club's London recruitment network. The successful candidate will oversee the Pre-Academy coaching and games programme, creating a clear pathway from grassroots football into the Pre-Academy and ultimately the Academy U9 programme.

Reporting to the Head of London Recruitment, the postholder will bring recruitment, staffing, fixtures, facilities and parent engagement together under one accountable lead. Although the primary focus is U6-U8, the manager will maintain visibility across the wider Foundation Development Phase and support targeted recruitment activity for older age groups when required.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead and manage the identification and recruitment of high-potential players for the U6, U7 and U8 Pre-Academy programme.

  • Oversee the Pre-Academy Development Centre coaching and games programme, ensuring consistent standards across all venues.

  • Alternate suitable Friday activity between structured training and Talent ID games, allowing new players to be assessed in a realistic environment.

  • Regularly assess player progress and potential, maintaining clear records and providing constructive feedback to players, parents and coaches.

  • Set appropriate squad-number caps, group sizes and 5v5 or 6v6 formats for grassroots fixtures based on age, pitch availability and recruitment purpose.

  • Own the planning and delivery of fixtures, festivals and Talent ID events, including dates, pitch bookings, staffing, equipment, player invitations and post-event reviews.

  • Coordinate appropriate refereeing, medical, security and safeguarding provision for fixtures and events.

  • Build, maintain and enhance relationships with grassroots clubs, private academies, schools and community organisations across London, with particular focus on priority recruitment areas.

  • Develop innovative ways to keep players and parents engaged, informed and connected to Crystal Palace.

  • Provide the Head of London Recruitment with regular reports on the player pipeline, attendance, progression, conversion, releases, event outcomes, centre performance and staffing.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • FA Level 2 / UEFA B License

  • Talent ID Level 1

  • Significant experience in Academy recruitment, Pre-Academy football, Foundation Phase coaching or elite youth development.

  • Strong understanding of identifying potential in players aged 6–8 and of long-term player development.

  • Experience of leading staff, programmes, fixtures, festivals or Talent ID events.

  • Extensive knowledge of, and a strong network within, London grassroots football, including clubs, private programmes, schools, players and private academies.

  • FA Safeguarding Children Certificate and an appropriate first-aid qualification.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to build trusted relationships with children, parents, coaches, scouts and senior staff.

  • Strong organisation, planning, record-keeping and decision-making skills.

  • A proactive, energetic and innovative approach to Pre-Academy recruitment and development.

  • FA Safeguarding Certificate.

  • FA Emergency First Aid.

  • Excellent communicator, enthusiastic, and energetic personality.

  • Boundary-pushing Pre-Academy visionary.

Benefits:

  • Complimentary match day ticket

  • Reward and Discount Scheme through our Tech Scheme and Simple Health app

  • Health and Wellbeing benefit scheme

  • 20% Discount in our Retail Stores

  • Discounts in various gyms through GymFlex

  • Volunteering Day - 1 Workday off to support a charity of your choice.

  • Travel Season Ticket loan

  • Holiday allowance: 25 Days 

Our commitment to Equality

At Crystal Palace Football Club, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion is spirited and continues to grow due to the working environment, which makes all staff feel appreciated and welcomed. Crystal Palace Football Club do this by encouraging good relations and practices towards different groups and are committed to promoting employment opportunities that celebrate diversity.

We are committed to attracting, recruiting, and retaining the most talented candidates and the club intends to ensure that everyone who wishes to engage with the club, whether as matchday fans, staff, players, board members, participants in Foundation programmes and any other person engaged with the club's activities, has a real and equal opportunity to do so.


Reasonable Adjustment

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Employer. We guarantee an interview to all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria for the role, ensuring equitable opportunities for everyone.

If you require disability-related adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact DLO@cpfc.co.uk (DLO inbox is for disability-related queries only, if you wish to gain further information regarding this vacancy, please contact cpfc.recruitment@cpfc.co.uk). We are here to help you through the whole recruitment process including trying to apply for a vacancy, getting in touch with us through the process, and/or helping with access in case you are required to come in for an interview.


Safeguarding

Crystal Palace Football Club is committed to safeguarding and ensuring the welfare and protection of children and vulnerable people and expects all staff to share this commitment. As such, the post holder will be required to undergo any relevant security checks, including a comprehensive background check, Enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) to ensure the safety and protection of children and vulnerable individuals.

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees.

About this role:

Crystal Palace Football Club are looking for scouts to join our National scouting department to monitor and identify players across the country in the U14 - U18 age groups.

We are recruiting scouts for various regions of the UK (each role will be allocated specific regions).

Ideal applicants will have strong travel access to their local area and be able to travel extensively within cross over regions to attend matches and assess talent.

Responsibilities:

  • Ability to watch a minimum of up to four live games per week ( Combination of live & video reporting when needed)

  • Flexible and committed to work unsocial hours, weekend, and evenings

  • Identify, recommend, and monitor potential recruitment targets for the age range outlined by the academy

  • Submit reports in an efficient and timely manner

  • Develop an extensive knowledge of all academy players within your designated area and nationwide.

  • Utilise modern scouting methods with regards to reporting, recording, and tracking potential player targets

  • Represent Crystal Palace FC in a professional and honest manner

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience of scouting Professional Football Academies at CAT 1- CAT 4 levels ( Essential )

  • FA Level 2 Talent ID (Essential)

  • Knowledge of the PL and EFL games programme (Essential)

  • FA Level 3 Talent ID (Desirable)

  • Must Hold Valid Driving License (Essential)

  • Flexible and willing to travel (Essential)

  • IT Competent, ability to use Wyscout / Eyeball / Scoutastic (Essential)

  • Organised and time conscious with report deadlines

  • Must be up to date with relevant child protection guidelines and hold relevant certificates (Essential)

job.title: Head of Finance
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   Full-time

Deadline:            4th October 2026

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

Reporting to the CFO, the Head of Finance will be responsible for overseeing and managing the Finance Team's day-to-day operations, ensuring the smooth and efficient delivery of all transactional and financial activities across the Club. The postholder will provide accurate, timely and commercially focused financial insight, support sustainable decision-making, and ensure effective financial controls, planning, reporting and compliance across the Club and its associated entities.

Responsibilities:
Financial Planning, Control, Compliance and Risk

  • Lead and oversee the annual budgeting & forecast process, working collaboratively with budget holders and stakeholders.

  • Lead financial analysis and planning to support strategic decision-making and business planning.

  • Provide financial modelling, scenario analysis and recommendations for strategic initiatives.

  • Ensure financial controls, processes and delegated authorities are maintained.

  • Support compliance with applicable statutory, tax, accounting and football regulatory requirements.

  • Identify, assess and mitigate financial risks, escalating material issues appropriately.

  • Oversee the preparation, monitoring and management of the Club’s cash flow forecasts, ensuring sufficient liquidity to meet operational commitments and supporting effective working capital management.

  • Lead and oversee the preparation and submission of accurate and timely financial compliance reports to the Premier League and UEFA, ensuring adherence to applicable financial regulations, reporting requirements and deadlines.

  • Coordinate with external auditors and support the timely completion of audits.

  • Ensure financial practices are ethical, transparent and consistent with Club policies.

Budgeting, Forecasting and Management Reporting

  • Review monthly management accounts and analyse performance against budget and forecast.

  • Prepare clear variance analysis and coordinate corrective actions with budget holders.

  • Develop and maintain annual forecasts and reforecasting processes.

  • Produce weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual KPI reports relevant to the Head of Finance remit.

  • Provide timely financial performance reports to the Executive Team, Board and relevant committees.

  • Identify financial opportunities and risks through proactive engagement with budget holders.

  • Monitor the impact of payroll, margins, overheads and other key drivers on financial performance.

Finance Team & Day-to-Day Operations

  • Manage and oversee the day-to-day operations of the Finance Team, ensuring the timely and accurate delivery of financial reporting, ensuring high standards within the finance team.

  • Ensure appropriate financial controls and processes are maintained across all transactional activities.

  • Support, develop and provide guidance to the Finance Team, ensuring operational efficiency, accountability and adherence to Club policies and procedures.

  • Lead, support, mentor and develop the finance team.

  • Set clear objectives, standards and development plans for direct reports.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

Essential

  • Professional accounting qualification such as ACA, ACCA or CIMA.

  • Experience within professional football, sport, entertainment or another comparable industry.

  • 3 years’ post-qualified experience in relevant finance roles.

  • Extensive experience in financial planning, budgeting, forecasting and management reporting.

  • Strong knowledge of financial controls, accounting principles, risk analysis and compliance.

  • Experience working in a fast-paced, complex or commercially focused environment.

  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel and financial/accounting systems, including ERP platforms.

  • Strong analytical, data interpretation, communication and presentation skills.

  • Ability to influence and collaborate with senior stakeholders and budget holders.

Desirable

  • Experience managing capital, construction, stadium or redevelopment projects.

  • Knowledge of Premier League, UEFA, FA or other relevant football financial regulations.

  • Experience managing or developing a finance team.

  • Experience negotiating or reviewing contracts with suppliers, partners or other third parties.

Benefits:

  • Complimentary match day ticket

  • Reward and Discount Scheme through our Tech Scheme and Simple Health app

  • Health and Wellbeing benefit scheme

  • 20% Discount in our Retail Stores

  • Discounts in various gyms through GymFlex

  • Volunteering Day - 1 Workday off to support a charity of your choice.

  • Travel Season Ticket loan

  • Holiday allowance: 25 Days
