Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Host Broadcast Operations Coordinator supports the planning, coordination and delivery of Host Broadcast operations across all venues and central broadcast facilities, including the International Broadcast Coordination Centre (IBCC).

Working under the direction of the Head of Broadcast and in alignment with the FIFA Zürich Project Lead – Senior Host Broadcast Production Manager, the role contributes to the implementation of broadcast operations and IBCC-related activities. 

The position supports coordination between FIFA project requirements, Host Broadcast Production delivery, and IBCC operations, ensuring aligned planning, consistent communication, and effective service delivery across all operational areas. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Support the planning, coordination and implementation of Host Broadcast operations across all FIFA Women's World Cup™ venues and central broadcast facilities. 
  •  Assist the Head of Broadcast and FIFA Zürich Project Lead – Senior Host Broadcast Production Manager in coordinating operational planning, tracking project milestones and monitoring key deliverables. 
  • Support the Host Broadcast Operations Managers with venue planning activities, ensuring consistency of operational standards, documentation and implementation across all competition venues. 
  • Coordinate operational information, documentation and planning activities between FIFA departments, Host Broadcast partners and key service providers. 
  • Support the planning, coordination and operational readiness of the International Broadcast Coordination Centre (IBCC), including facilities, operational workflows, logistics and service delivery.
  • Assist with the development and maintenance of IBCC operational documentation, layouts, operational procedures and planning schedules. 
  • Coordinate information relating to Host Broadcast and IBCC requirements, ensuring timely communication and alignment between all stakeholders. 
  • Support planning meetings, workshops, venue inspections and operational readiness activities, including preparation of agendas, minutes, action tracking and follow-up. 
  • Assist in monitoring project risks, dependencies and operational issues, escalating where appropriate and supporting the implementation of agreed actions. 
  • Contribute to the preparation of operational reports, presentations and management updates for internal and external stakeholders. 
  • Support planning for tournament-time operations, ensuring operational documentation, staffing plans and broadcast requirements are maintained and up to date. 
  • Work collaboratively across FIFA, FIFA27, Host Broadcaster and service providers to ensure an integrated approach to Host Broadcast and IBCC operations. 
  • Undertake additional operational duties as required to support the successful delivery of the FIFA Women's World Cup™. 
  • Experience in broadcast, media and/or sports event environments
  • University degree in broadcast, media, event management or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience in project planning, broadcast operations, event operations, or coordination roles
  • Experience supporting multi-disciplinary teams across functional areas such as accommodation, logistics, accreditation and travel
  • Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail, particularly when working under pressure
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong administrative and reporting capabilities
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build and maintain effective working relationships across multiple teams and levels
  • Good problem-solving skills with the ability to use sound judgement and support operational decision-making
  • Knowledge of local markets and cultural environments is an asset

  • Experience in major international sporting events is desirable
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Senior Campaigns Manager
job.html_description:
As the organiser of some of the biggest and most iconic sport events in the world, we lead the way in the sport and event industry.

The Senior Campaigns Manager will play a key role in delivering FIFA’s social impact campaigns by sharing the lead in the overall conception, creation, delivery and management of results-driven and multiplatform initiatives, in line with FIFA’s Strategic Objectives for the Global Game: 2023-2027.

Reporting to the Team Lead Corporate Communications, the postholder will own and oversee the portfolio of FIFA social impact campaigns, serving as the main point of contact between functional areas and leading and managing the relationship with external stakeholders.

Join the team and support us on our mission.
These are your key tasks:
  • Plan and implement compelling social impact campaigns related to FIFA’s corporate mission
  • Project-manage all stakeholder involvement by acting as the main point of contact in relation to social impact campaigns, developing content proposals, agreeing on budgets and managing feedback
  • Project-manage all deliverables involving internal and external partners and execute campaign requirements with an emphasis on digital communication to promote individual stakeholder activities across FIFA’s platforms and events
  • Project-manage all requirements in terms of content production
  • Project-manage all campaign reporting and debriefs according to pre-agreed key performance indicators
  • Support the further promotion of social impact campaigns with plans, messaging and content around key milestones
  • Support the further promotion of social impact campaigns through the creation of multilingual toolkits for Member Associations and other stakeholders
  • Provide on-site support in relation to the implementation of social impact campaigns at FIFA events
  • Manage campaign-related content on owned FIFA channels
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • Passion for football
  • Proven experience (at least six years) working at an international and/or media organisation, with a specific campaign background
  • Solid experience coordinating successful campaigns
  • Media communications or public relations expertise and the ability to build and maintain interest over time
  • Ability to see the bigger picture and think not just for Corporate Communications but for the FIFA Communications Division and the organisation as a whole
  • Ability to liaise and communicate with and present to key stakeholders (internal and external)
  • Excellent communicator and listener
  • Willing to learn new skills and take on challenges
  • Cooperative team player
  • Bachelor’s degree in languages/communications/journalism/social studies (a master’s degree is a plus)
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills and management of messaging and the media
  • Ability to work to tight deadlines
  • Thorough understanding of global football activities and key football stakeholders
  • Excellent command of communications platforms
  • Expertise in video production and social media, as well as standard messaging and content creation
  • SAP knowledge would be an asset (for the purposes of finance/budgeting, procurement, governance and RFP process management)
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.

Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
  • Health and fitness: Regular football sessions for all abilities, plus on-site gym.
  • Home office: Up to two days of home office per week if work permits and home office allowance for all.
  • Language courses: Offered to all staff to aid personal and professional growth.
  • Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
  • Pension: Flexible pension benefits with generous employer contributions.
  • Relocation assistance: A dedicated team will be on hand to support your relocation.
  • Sustainability: We support all employees using public transport.
  • Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.
  • Volunteering: Make an impact beyond your regular role and bond with colleagues by volunteering with one of our partners.

job.title: Digital Product Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Digital Product Manager will be the driving force behind FIFA’s digital direct-to-consumer experiences for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Whilst the role will be based in Rio, the successful candidate will act as an integral member of the global Product & Design team, defining fans’ digital journey across FIFA’s owned and operated platforms, notably including FIFA.com and FIFA’s official mobile app.

Reporting to Head of Brand & Marketing, the primary responsibility will involve taking the lead in evolving FIFA’s fan-facing websites and apps specifically for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. This will include developing digital activations that support tournament goals and objectives, as well as delivery of commercial value for FIFA’s partners.

With the biggest, most ambitious FIFA Women’s World Cup™ on the horizon, this is your chance to help shape the next generation of digital experiences and grow the Women’s game!


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Strategic Vision: Play a leading role in defining and developing FIFA’s digital consumer-facing proposition, specifically ensuring products and experiences reflect local fan behaviours and consumption habits, as well as aligning cultural nuances and emerging trends across Brazil and South America.
  • Fan Engagement: Support FIFA’s audience growth goals by optimizing acquisition, engagement and retention journeys across owned platforms, as well as contributing to first-party data strategies.
  • Value Generation: Partner closely with Commercial and Marketing teams to develop scalable digital activations and integrations that deliver measurable value to fans and partners alike.
  • Tournament Planning & Delivery: Become an integral enabler of tournament-time digital operations, delivering high-traffic match moments, live content publishing, rapid issue resolution and cross-functional coordination during competition periods.
  • Collaboration: Operate as an integral member of Digital Delivery, working alongside Product Managers located across Europe and acting as the department’s key representative within FIFA27.
  • Governance & Communication: Providing clear, consistent updates to senior management and key stakeholders. Participation in cross-functional steering groups to maintain a balance between critical tournament milestones and product scope delivery.
  • Drive Innovation: Champion a consumer-first mindset; exploring opportunities for innovation and application of AI-driven solutions to enhance content personalization and discovery, improve operational efficiency and create new fan engagement experiences that resonate with fans globally and locally.
  • Data-driven Performance:  Establish and track key performance indicators, using a blend of behavioural insights and user research to inform product development priorities, optimise product performance and exceed tournament goals and objectives.

Education & Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer sciences, business management or related discipline
  • Relevant product development philosophies, e.g. Agile, are essential
  • Relevant project management qualifications, e.g. PRINCE2, highly beneficial
Work Experience:
  • Product management experience, demonstrating end-to-end experience across the digital product lifecycle; from UX/UI design and roadmap development to rigorous testing and release management.
  • Experience working in a direct-to-consumer business, ideally within sports, media or related industries.
  • Experience leading complex projects will be highly beneficial, demonstrating aptitude for balancing personal development of others with empowerment to “get the job done”.
  • Exceptional communication skills - both written and verbal – to succinctly and confidently interact with a wide range of stakeholders up to and including senior FIFA management.
  • Demonstrable experience working autonomously and/or with ambiguity; with an ability to adapt swiftly to organisational change or leverage short-term opportunities.
Competencies:
  • Confidence leading multiple projects with autonomy, often with colleagues and/or suppliers located in different territories and time zones.
  • Passion for developing consumer experiences and thinking big picture; complimented with a demonstrable understanding of digital product development and design principles.
  • Data-driven with an aptitude for harnessing data, forming KPIs, and leveraging consumer insights to make informed decisions.
  • Comfortable working with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams across FIFA, each with varying degrees of digital maturity and technical understanding.
  • Willingness to travel to other FIFA offices and venues, typically in Zurich, as well as relocating to another location for a period of time, e.g. during FIFA Women’s World Cup in 2027.
Languages:
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Proficiency in another official FIFA language, such as Spanish, is a benefit.
Technology:
  • Strong knowledge of digital direct-to-consumer ecosystems, including mobile and video.
  • Solid understanding and passion for digital innovation, including application of AI
  • Experience with industry-standard solutions, e.g. Figma, Asana and Confluence
Requirements:
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Senior Brand Manager
job.html_description:
As the organiser of some of the biggest and most iconic sport events in the world, we lead the way in the sport and event industry.

Join the team and support us on our mission.

The Senior Brand Manager contributes to shaping and executing a sustainable and profitable plan for FIFA’s tournament brands, aligned with the overarching FIFA Brand Strategy and designed to support the organisation’s global vision and strategic objectives, under the leadership of the Head of Brand & Creative Services.
The candidate is the brand project lead of Tier 1 Men tournaments, responsible for developing and delivering the tournament brand platform and full suite of assets as well as supports on the comprehensive integration of the brand partners across the 360-activation plan. Notably, the candidate will be responsible of leading the brand development and deployment for the FIFA World Cup 2030.

These are your key tasks:
  • Champions the strategic development of integrated brand positioning and tournament narratives, ensuring each major competition reflects FIFA’s global vision while resonating with diverse audiences and markets.
  • Partners closely with internal stakeholders, and local organising partners to create distinctive brand platforms that are insight-driven, future-focused, and aligned with FIFA’s overarching identity system.
  • Integrates brand strategy with audience intelligence and market data, leveraging research, fan insights, and performance metrics to shape brand narratives, guide creative direction, and optimize campaign effectiveness across global markets.
  • Develop the tournament brand assets full suite in close collaboration with tournament project teams, commercial and media partnerships, various stakeholders across the organisation and local organizing/hosting stakeholders. Ownership over process and timelines, from brief to execution.
  • Manages the delivery of brand tournament related assets (including official marks, official event look of the games, official mascots, official trophies …), printed/digital materials, and brand manuals to the highest standards of quality and consistency.
  • Ensures adequacy and brand consistency of any brand development across touchpoints. Expertise in Brand Events dressing (event look management) is mandatory.
  • Anticipates and proposes commercially relevant branded propositions to enhance commercial offering to partners. Anticipates partners delivery timelines and supports partners rights delivery needs.
  • Translates brand strategy into compelling creative direction hand in hand with senior creative partners both in house and in agency, overseeing the articulation of core themes and storytelling frameworks that drive consistency and emotional impact across all activation channels.
  • Safeguards and evolves FIFA’s brand equity across internal and external partners, ensuring strategic alignment, creative integrity, and cross-functional execution excellence throughout the brand lifecycle.
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • Experience in a global brand management & brand delivery function, preferably in large sports organisations
  • Proven experience leading brand development and strategic planning process
  • Adjacent experience in partner rights delivery, event dressing operations preferred
  • Experience in leading go-to-market, 360 brand launch plans
  • International experience in global sports events delivery is a strong plus
  • Note: This is not a creative role – this is a brand management role
  • University degree or equivalent in business, sports or events management
  • Fluent in English
  • Proficient in Word / PowerPoint / Excel
  • Events Branding deep understanding
  • Partnership rights delivery deep understanding
  • Business driven with strong analytical skills
  • Goal oriented and result-driven, strong decision making skills
  • Has a sense of creativity and aesthetic sensitivity
  • Well-structured and great organizational skills
  • Ability to manage multiple projects in cross-functional collaboration
  • Strong written and verbal skills, able to present strategy and concept to partners and
  • management
  • Entrepreneurial spirt with innovative mind-set
  • Flexibility
  • Self-Motivation
  • Empathy
  • Negotiating skills
  • Political savvy
  • Teamwork abilities
  • Ability to travel as required (30%)
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.

Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
  • Health and fitness: Regular football sessions for all abilities, plus on-site gym.
  • Home office: Up to two days of home office per week if work permits and home office allowance for all.
  • Language courses: Offered to all staff to aid personal and professional growth.
  • Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
  • Pension: Flexible pension benefits with generous employer contributions.
  • Relocation assistance: A dedicated team will be on hand to support your relocation.
  • Sustainability: We support all employees using public transport.
  • Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.
  • Volunteering: Make an impact beyond your regular role and bond with colleagues by volunteering with one of our partners.

job.title: Uniforms Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA27 established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”). 


The Uniforms Manager is responsible for the planning and operational delivery of the corporate FIFA27 Business Casual uniform as well as the FWWC2027 Tournament Dedicated and FIFA Formal uniform programmes in line with the overall FIFA Uniform Strategy and the approved usage and entitlement matrix. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Responsible for project management and implementation of the FWWC2027 uniform programme including issuance operations that support both workforce and volunteers
  • Ensure all FIFA27 workforce have uniform according to the entitlement and usage matrix
  • Effectively collaborate with key FIFA Zurich and FIFA27 stakeholders including Workforce Planning, Volunteer Management, Host City Management, Logistics, Accreditation and Partnership Rights Delivery
  • Create strategy, process and flows for the full project plan for FWWC2027 uniform programme capturing risks and mitigations throughout
  • Develop the operational plan, setting up affiliated systems, identify functional distribution spaces, engage with stakeholders, contract local suppliers to deliver the FWWC2027 uniform programme, across all the Uniforms Distribution Centers
  • Oversee FIFA27 uniform budget, including creating accurate forecasts for each FIFA27 related event e.g. FWWC2027 Draw
  • Manage relationships with external uniform suppliers that may be required, ensuring compliance in line with Framework Agreement and enforcing contractual obligations 
  • Recruit and effectively train and manage the uniforms team (both workforce and volunteers) during planning and delivery periods ensuring best practices are clearly defined and the service level provided across all Uniform Distribution Centers is consistent
  • Manage stock levels and keep up-to-date records of each uniform item during pre-tournament (e.g. Business Casual uniform/ formal items that may be required for side events) and tournament time.
  • Communicate the agreed FIFA27 Uniform Guidelines and Usage Policy at each FIFA tournament and event 
  • Ensure the uniform guidelines are upheld and enforced across all client groups including FIFA Formal Uniform eligibility
  • Plan uniform distribution to all related FWW2027 additional events, e.g. Final Draw, 
  • Work with relevant FIFA27 stakeholders to agree and provide guidelines to Suppliers who are not entitled to Tournament Dedicated Uniforms Other duties as necessary to ensure the smooth running of the FWWC2027 Uniform operations.

  • Knowledge of event planning and event project management processes

  • Excellent time management skills and ability to balance competing priorities

job.title: Ticketing General Public Customer Care Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting to the Ticketing Customer Relationship Senior Manager, the Ticketing General Public Customer Care Manager owns the design, implementation and performance of the customer care strategy for General Public ticket buyers across the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™ ticketing and hospitality operation.  

The role translates FIFA's ticketing requirements and the tournament's sales strategy into a working service model (service levels, escalation paths, vendor standards) and leads the resources responsible for delivering it. Given the tournament's international buyer base, the role carries direct accountability for service quality to overseas clients, including language coverage, time-zone alignment and cross-border payment and fraud edge cases.


  • Define and own the customer care strategy and operating model across every channel (contact forms, call center, chatbot, email, and any added over time), setting the direction that Coordinators, Specialists and outsourced teams execute day to day. 
 
  • Own the end-to-end relationship with outsourced customer care and call center providers — contract terms and SLAs, onboarding and setup, ongoing performance management, and renewal or renegotiation decisions when service falls short. 
 
  • Define the training curriculum and certification standards for customer care and call center staff, aligned to the sales strategy and FIFA ticketing regulations, and hold providers and team leads accountable for delivery quality and pass rates. 
  • Step into direct customer care delivery (back office and onsite) only for cases requiring Manager-level authority — media-sensitive escalations, VIP-adjacent complaints surfacing through the General Public channel, or capacity gaps during peak on-sale periods and match days. 
 
  • Design and own the escalation governance framework across channels and teams, and act as the final internal escalation point before matters reach the Senior Manager. 
 
  • Set the quality control framework and standards and own the corrective-action decisions when the QA team flags deviations from service requirements. 
 
  • Own the case management strategy inside the CRM — workflow design, automation rules, and the logic for what's handled automatically versus manually — partnering with the CRM/Digital team on system configuration. 
 
  • Build the business case for, and drive adoption of, productivity and satisfaction improvements — tooling, process redesign, agent enablement — across customer care and call center operations. 
 
  • Identify and report patterns and risks to the Senior Manager and relevant FIFA stakeholders, own the mitigation processes, and escalate anything beyond the team's authority to resolve. 
 
  • Act as Customer Care's point of accountability toward FIFA functional areas (Legal, Sustainability, Data Protection, Finance, etc.), translating their requirements into operational process and owning any compliance gaps that surface. 
 
  • Define the KPI framework for customer care and call center performance, and use CRM and other systems' output to make staffing, resourcing and vendor-performance decisions — reporting outcomes to the Senior Manager. 
 
  • Lead the Quality Assurance team: set methodology and standards, and use QA findings to drive corrective action across the wider operation, in-house and outsourced. 
 
  • Own the governance model for the multilingual customer care knowledge base — standards, versioning, ownership — with day-to-day administration executed by the team. 
SKILLS FRAMEWORK  
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyse one’s behaviour, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes. 
 
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculate risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.    
 
INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts. 
 
INITIATIVE: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents.  
  
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans. 
 
EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS 
 
Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent in relevant areas.      
 
WORK EXPERIENCE 
 
  • Minimum five years experience in leading large teams, including in-house staff and external service providers, with international and different cultural backgrounds under the same goal.   
  • Minimum three years experience in leading Ticketing Customer Care teams on major international sports events, including recruitment, training, and the delivery of the project.  
  • Planning, managing, and conducting ticketing customer care strategies and processes for world-scale projects, experience in International Sports Events, including previous FIFA World Cups.  
  • Venue and onsite operations experience for ticketing and/or Sport Events.   
  • Experience in similar role during previous FIFA World Cups.  
  • Team-leading skills, able to lead multicultural teams.   
  • Communication and problem-solving skills.   
 
LANGUAGES 
 
Fluent in English and Portuguese, spoken and written. 
Spanish and/or additional languages is highly advantageous. 
 
TECHNOLOGY 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Monday) and planning software and online collaboration tools   
  • CRM software for case management, including automatic and manual management of the cases.    
Certifications & Requirements 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Right to work in Brazil

job.title: Senior Business Intelligence Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Senior Business Intelligence Manager will lead the intelligence and performance measurement agenda for Brand, Marketing & Promotions, transforming data, research and consumer insights into actionable recommendations that support the growth and success of the tournament.

Reporting to the Head of Brand & Marketing in Brazil and to the Team Lead Business Intelligence & Marketing Strategy in Zurich, the role will act as a strategic business partner to Marketing leadership, building a comprehensive view of tournament performance across audience growth, brand health, fan engagement, digital behavior, marketing effectiveness and ticketing conversion. The role will serve as the primary link between the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ local business and FIFA’s central Business Intelligence office , which acts as the repository and governance hub for research, data, reports, methodologies and performance insights. The central Business Intelligence will ensure that relevant central intelligence is effectively translated and shared with local stakeholders, while also capturing local business needs, market context and emerging information requirements and communicating them back to the central office. 

The successful candidate will connect multiple data sources and business perspectives to understand not only what is happening, but why it is happening and what FIFA should do next. The role will establish clear measurement frameworks, identify growth opportunities and performance gaps, and provide senior leadership with the intelligence required to make faster and better-informed decisions.

With the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ set to become a landmark sporting event in Brazil and South America, this role will be central to understanding fan behavior, optimizing investment and turning audience interest into meaningful engagement, participation and attendance.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Strategy: Make sure that the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Marketing and Communication Strategy will be accordingly translated to Brand, Marketing & Promotions.
  • Business Intelligence: Using the strict connection with the FIFA’s central Business Intelligence office, establishing the data, research, KPIs and measurement frameworks required to assess tournament growth and marketing performance.
  • Tournament Performance Framework: Build and maintain an integrated measurement framework connecting the department’s strategic objectives to measurable KPIs across awareness, consideration, excitement, fan engagement, audience growth, registration, conversion and ticket sales. 
  • Audience & Fan Intelligence: Develop a deep understanding of existing and potential FIFA Women’s World Cup audiences in Brazil, starting with the general key audience segments as already defined, and identifying niches, motivations, barriers, behaviors and consumption patterns to inform marketing, content and fan engagement strategies
  • Ticketing & Conversion Intelligence: Partner closely with Ticketing, Digital and Marketing teams to analyze the fan journey from awareness and interest through registration and ticket purchase, identifying conversion opportunities, friction points and audience segments requiring additional marketing support. 
  • Marketing Effectiveness: Evaluate campaign and channel performance across paid, owned, earned and partner activity, establishing clear methodologies to assess reach, engagement, incremental impact, conversion and return on marketing investment. 
  • Research & Consumer Insights: In conjunction with the central BI office , lead the local research and insights agenda for Marketing, combining FIFA global research, brand tracking, quantitative and qualitative studies, social listening and behavioral data to identify emerging trends and support strategic decisions. 
  • Forecasting & Scenario Planning: Develop forecasts, scenarios and early-warning indicators to identify potential performance gaps and opportunities, particularly around audience growth, campaign effectiveness, fan acquisition and ticketing demand. 
  • Media & Communications Intelligence: Collaborate with Communications and Media teams to integrate earned media, PR, broadcast, social and cultural impact indicators into the broader assessment of tournament awareness and momentum. 
  • Digital & Fan Journey Analytics: Work closely with the central BI office, Digital Delivery and CRM teams to understand behavior across FIFA's digital ecosystem and optimize acquisition, engagement, registration and conversion journeys using first-party and behavioral data. 
  • Dashboards & Executive Reporting: Develop intuitive dashboards and executive-level reporting that highlight performance against targets, emerging trends, risks and opportunities. Ensure reporting prioritizes actionable insights rather than data volume. 
  • Investment Optimization: Provide data-driven recommendations to support marketing budget allocation, helping identify which audiences, channels, campaigns and initiatives are generating the greatest impact against tournament objectives. 
  • Leadership Communication: Present insights, opportunities, risks and recommendations clearly and confidently to senior FIFA leadership, translating analytical complexity into concise and compelling business narratives.
Education & Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Statistics, Data Analytics, Engineering or a related discipline. 
  • Postgraduate degree or MBA in Business, Marketing, Analytics or related fields is highly beneficial. 
  • Relevant qualifications in data analytics, consumer insights, market research or business intelligence are beneficial. 
Work Experience
  • Strong experience in Business Intelligence, Marketing Analytics, Consumer Insights, Growth Analytics, Strategy or related disciplines, ideally within complex consumer-facing organizations. 
  • Strong experience transforming data and research into strategic business recommendations, with demonstrated influence on marketing, commercial or customer decisions. 
  • Demonstrable experience designing KPI frameworks, performance measurement systems and executive dashboards across multiple business objectives and data sources. 
  • Experience analyzing consumer journeys, audience acquisition, engagement and conversion, ideally within sports, entertainment, media, ticketing, e-commerce or other direct-to-consumer environments. 
  • Strong experience in marketing effectiveness and campaign measurement across digital, paid media, CRM, social, content and/or brand activity. 
  • Experience working with consumer and market research, including brand tracking, audience segmentation and quantitative and qualitative methodologies. 
  • Experience combining multiple sources of information — including behavioral, transactional, digital, media and research data — into an integrated business perspective. 
  • Experience with forecasting, scenario modelling and performance target setting is highly desirable. 
  • Proven experience communicating complex analysis to senior executives and turning analytical outputs into clear recommendations and compelling business narratives. 
  • Experience working in large-scale events, sports, entertainment, media or culturally relevant consumer brands will be highly beneficial. 
  • Demonstrable ability to operate autonomously in fast-moving and ambiguous environments, balancing long-term intelligence strategies with immediate business needs. 
Competencies
  • Strategic Thinker: Able to connect data and analysis to broader business priorities and identify the implications behind the numbers. 
  • Commercial & Consumer Mindset: Strong understanding of the relationship between audience behavior, marketing investment, engagement and conversion. 
  • Insight Driven: Naturally curious and focused on identifying the “why” behind performance, rather than simply describing results. 
  • Storytelling with Data: Exceptional ability to translate complex information into simple, persuasive narratives for senior decision-makers. 
  • Business Partnering: Comfortable challenging assumptions, asking difficult questions and providing evidence-based recommendations to senior stakeholders. 
  • Big Picture & Detail: Able to move between executive-level strategy and granular analysis depending on the business requirement. 
  • Proactive & Action-oriented: Anticipates questions, identifies potential issues before they become critical and actively proposes solutions. 
  • Collaborative: Strong ability to work across functions, markets and levels of technical sophistication, creating alignment around common KPIs and business objectives. 
  • Curious & Innovative: Constantly explores new data sources, analytical approaches, AI capabilities and methodologies that can improve understanding of fans and tournament performance. 
  • Results-oriented: Focused on using intelligence to influence measurable outcomes rather than producing analysis as an end in itself. 
Technology
  • Advanced experience with Business Intelligence and data visualization platforms, such as Power BI, Tableau or Looker. 
  • Strong understanding of digital analytics platforms, such as Google Analytics 4 and/or Adobe Analytics. 
  • Strong working knowledge of SQL and experience working with large and diverse datasets. 
  • Experience with CRM, CDP, marketing automation and first-party data environments is highly beneficial. 
  • Familiarity with paid media, social analytics, media monitoring and social listening platforms. 
  • Experience with market research, brand tracking and consumer intelligence platforms. 
  • Knowledge of statistical analysis and modelling tools such as Python or R is beneficial, but not essential. 
  • Strong understanding of AI and its application to analytics, insight generation, forecasting and marketing optimization.
Requirements
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Implement and effectively manage the customer care strategies and processes across all the communications channels established, including but not limited to the contact forms, call centers, chatbot, emails, etc.      
  • Support the Customer Care Manager in managing the customer care team and the potential outsourced customer care and call center service providers for the implementation and effective delivery of the services, ensuring a proper setup of all the services required.      
  • Support the Customer Care Manager in ensuring proper training of all the customer care staff members and the call center teams, according to the sales strategy and the FIFA ticketing requirements and regulations;   
  • Perform customer care ticketing processes (back office and onsite) whenever required;   
  • Apply the escalation processes and ensure his proper implementation by the different teams;       
  • Plan and implement quality control procedures to ensure that any deviation from the requirements is detected and corrected as soon as possible;       
  • Support the proper implementation of effective processes and strategies for automated and manual case management using the respective CRM systems;    
  • Actively search and implement solutions to pro-actively increase the productivity of customer care and call center agents, and maximize customer information and satisfaction;   
  • Pro-actively identify and report on patterns and risks, and implement processes to mitigate them;     
  • Ensure that all the Customer Care processes are in compliance with the different FIFA functional areas requirements, including but not limited to Legal, Sustainability, Data Protection, Finance, etc.  
  • Analyze and report regularly on KPIs and the effectiveness of customer care and call center services, using CRM and other systems;    
  • Manage and train a small team in charge of performing quality assurance checks. 
  • Ensure an efficient administration and archive of all versions of customer care and call center knowledge base, in all languages.   
SKILLS FRAMEWORK  
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyse one’s behaviour, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes. 
 
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculate risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.    
 
INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts. 
 
INITIATIVE: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents.  
  
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans. 
 
EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS 
 
Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent in relevant areas.      
 
WORK EXPERIENCE 
 
  • Minimum three years experience in leading large teams, including in-house staff and external service providers, with international and different cultural backgrounds under the same goal. 
  • Minimum two years experience in leading Ticketing Customer Care teams on major international sports events, including recruitment, training, and the delivery of the project. 
  • Planning, managing, and conducting ticketing customer care strategies and processes for world-scale projects, experience in International Sports Events, including previous FIFA World Cups.    
  • Venue and onsite operations experience for ticketing and/or Sport Events. 
  • Experience in similar role during previous FIFA World Cups. 
  • Team-leading skills, able to lead multicultural teams.   
  • Communication and problem-solving skills.   
 
LANGUAGES 
 
Fluent in English and Portuguese, spoken and written. 
Spanish and/or additional languages is highly advantageous. 
 
TECHNOLOGY 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Monday) and planning software and online collaboration tools   
  • CRM software for case management, including automatic and manual management of the cases.  
Certifications & Requirements 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Right to work in Brazil

job.title: Travel Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Travel Manager leads end-to-end travel operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, including flights, accommodation and ground transportation.

The role requires hands-on experience with bookings, quotations, ticket issuance, reissuance, availability checks and fare rules, as well as coordinating complex group travel for major events.

Working closely with FIFA teams, airlines, suppliers and other stakeholders, the Travel Manager must combine strong operational knowledge with flexibility, empathy and a genuine service mindset.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage flight and hotel bookings, quotations, ticket issuance, reissuance, cancellations and refunds using Amadeus.
  • Apply airline fare rules, ticketing conditions, deadlines, penalties and baggage policies.
  • Coordinate travel for groups of over 100 people, including flights, accommodation, visas, ground transportation and itineraries.
  • Build strong relationships with airlines, hotels, travel agencies and transportation providers.
  • Negotiate rates, booking conditions and operational solutions while monitoring budgets and costs.
  • Support travellers during schedule changes, disruptions, emergencies and other unexpected situations.
  • Develop contingency plans and make quick, practical decisions in high-pressure situations.
  • Maintain accurate travel data, reports, passenger lists and operational documentation.
  • Coordinate travel requirements across multiple cities and client groups, including teams, delegations, guests, VIPs and workforce.
  • Provide responsive, patient and solution-oriented service throughout the travel journey.
  • Development of contingency plans for high level client groups
  • Proactive identification and mitigation of operational risks
  • Decision-making under high time pressure to ensure continuity of tournament operations while maintaining service levels and cost control
  • Acting as an advisory interface between FIFA Functional Areas, External Stakeholders, Suppliers, Host Country Authorities, and FIFA/FWWC27 Senior leadership
  • Preparation of executive-level briefings, recommendations, and decision papers related to travel strategy, pricing, and operational readiness
  • Support to FIFA Partnerships in managing expectations with commercial partners in high-demand or capacity-constrained environments

YOUR PROFILE

  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
  • Completed (business) travel agency education or business education with training in the travel industry
  • Further education in tourism, event or general management
  • Strong experience in the business travel industry (travel, accommodation and ground transportation) 
  • Excellent skills in GDS, preferably GDS Amadeus/ticketing and fare rules 
  •  Relevant experience in project and event management

job.title: Workforce Planning & Operations Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Working alongside the FIFA Workforce Management team based in Zurich and reporting to the FIFA27 Head of Workforce, the Manager, Workforce Planning & Operations is responsible for executing all workforce planning phases and processes, ensures the organisation has the right talent in the right roles at the right time.

Workforce Strategy & Planning
• Support the implementation of workforce planning and operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027)
• Coordinate and execute workforce planning activities across all workforce types (paid staff, freelancers, tournament-time hires, secondees, etc.)
• Work closely with the FIFA Workforce Management team to support an integrated planning process, ensuring resources align with operational needs and service levels
• Assist in defining workforce categories and supporting the development of entitlements for each group
• Maintain and update the centralised headcount plan, ensuring data accuracy and accessibility
• Support change management activities to enable continuity in workforce planning and execution
• Contribute inputs to workforce budgets, timelines, and planning cycles

Workforce Operations & Management
• Help develop and execute operational plans for workforce delivery during tournament time, including supporting site operations
• Assist in defining requirements for physical spaces, overlay, technology, and other workforce-related needs on site
• Develop workforce policies & procedures with key operational stakeholders (transport, accommodation, catering etc.) and core central business areas such as HR, technology, finance. 
• Define and map out key workforce planning & operational processes, understanding the cross-functional collaboration required.
• Support the coordination of business processes and system requirements for workforce operations tools
• Deliver role-specific and venue-specific training for workforce operations teams
• Support the day-to-day supervision, scheduling and coordination of workforce operations teams, including workforce and volunteers
• Provide operational support to venue managers during event delivery

  • Work Experience
    • Experience in workforce planning or operations, ideally within international events and/or the sports industry
    • Good working knowledge of workforce planning systems, tools, and practices
    • Experience supporting or coordinating operational venue teams at large-scale events
    • Understanding of data-driven decision-making and workforce planning processes in complex environments
    • Demonstrated ability to manage projects, prioritise tasks effectively, and work with a level of independence
    • Experience supervising team members and contributing to team performance through positive leadership and collaboration
    • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
    • Demonstrated adaptability, with experience supporting discussions, problem-solving, and stakeholder coordination
    • Experience working in a multicultural and/or multinational environment
    • Fluent in English, both written and spoken  
    • Fluent/Advanced Portuguese

  • Technology
    • Proficient in MS Office tools (Word, PowerPoint, Visio & advanced Excel) 
    • Proficiency in using project planning tools such as WeTrack and Monday.com
    • Experience with workforce system implementations advantageous

job.title: Legal Counsel Commercial Legal
job.html_description:
We govern the beautiful game and ensure it's run with transparency and integrity.

Join our team in Miami and support us on our mission.
The Legal Counsel will be an active member of the Commercial Legal Team working with various Senior Legal Counsels, the Head of Content & Media and the Director of Commercial Legal to
support the delivery of legal services relating to FIFA’s global operations.

The role of Legal Counsel will support some, or all, of the business functions within FIFA’s global operations, such as the following:

  • Assisting the commercial teams by advising on their everyday operations
  • Assisting in drafting, negotiating and advising on a broad range of commercial and media partnerships matters connected with FIFA’s revenue generating activities
  • Providing support regarding the interpretation of a range of media, rights, marketing, IP, retail and licensing, agency appointments, consumer promotions and technology agreements
  • Assisting in providing legal support related to Web3 activities, social media, digital content, gaming and e-sports related matters
  • Providing legal and contractual support to FIFA’s strategic and corporate development activities
  • Providing legal and contractual support on the exploitation of commercial opportunities on FIFA’s digital platforms
  • Supporting FIFA’s subsidiaries, including the FIFA Museum and the FIFA Foundation regarding the exploitation of commercial opportunities within FIFA’s commercial framework
  • Providing advice, guidance and support for all legal, regulatory and governance matters relating to FIFA’s commercial media activities
  • Providing legal support and counsel on development and production deal structures and documentation for internal and third-party projects, including advising on pre-production and coproduction deals
  • Assisting in managing, developing and maintaining FIFA's portfolio of non-live content related templates
  • Assisting and providing support for the FIFA Technology team in support of the upcoming major FIFA tournaments worldwide
  • Assisting and providing support for the FIFA Innovation team in support of the upcoming major FIFA tournaments worldwide
  • Providing legal support for music related matters (both live and recorded music)
  • Instructing and liaising with external counsel in connection with local law matters in various jurisdictions
  • Developing and maintaining FIFA’s template agreements
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

This role would suit someone with great communication skills who is a dedicated team player and excels in being professional with excellent legal skills.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • Ability to participate and be part of a high-performing team, fostering collaboration, driving results, and ensuring the successful achievement of organizational goals
  • First class written and spoken English language skills, consistent with drafting and negotiating complex, high value and nuanced English language agreements
  • Ability to provide and communicate effectively practical and solutions-based legal advice
  • Excellent understanding of the sports marketing, sports merchandising, licensing, retail, digital marketing, sponsorship, licensing, e-commerce and business intelligence industry landscapes
  • Excellent negotiation, drafting, problem solving and analytical skills
  • Structured, reliable, with a strong eye for detail
  • Ability to perform consistently within a high-performing team, fostering collaboration, driving results, and ensuring the successful achievement of organizational goals
  • Strong commercial acumen with an ability to transfer legal knowledge into commercially and operationally oriented solutions
  • Proactive, with a strong sense of personal responsibility and an ability to work autonomously on a wide variety of projects
  • Resilient with an ability to competently handle a large workload amid rapidly shifting priorities
  • Open-minded team player with an affinity for working within a variety of cultures and excellent communication skills
  • High degree of professionalism and confidence
  • Ability to be a good ambassador for FIFA in all manner of external facing situations, including during contractual negotiations, external workshops and during FIFA competition-related assignments
  • Ability to create, develop and maintain strong and reliable relationships with FIFA senior management as well as external legal and commercial counterparts
  • Willingness to operate outside of comfort zone
  • Takes initiative to reflect on how to improve and develop working styles and methods to assist internal clients
  • Juris Doctor (JD) degree from an accredited law school
  • Active bar membership is required
  • 4-6 years expertise in an in-house legal department or a top-tier law firm focusing on technology, media, sports or IP matters
  • Native level English (or equivalent), consistent with requirement to draft and negotiate complex and nuanced English language agreements and advice
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (French/Spanish/Portuguese) is an asset but not required
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Outlook / Word / PowerPoint / Excel / Teams
  • Comfortable with international travel
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.
 
Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
 
Health insurance: We offer generous medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage.
Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
Retirement: We offer generous 401(k) employer contributions.
Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
SKILLS FRAMEWORK  
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyse one’s behaviour, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes.
 
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculate risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.   
 
INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts.
 
INITIATIVE: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents. 
 
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans.
 
EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent in relevant areas.     

WORK EXPERIENCE 
 
  • Experience working within large, multicultural operational structures (in-house staff and external service providers), collaborating toward a shared operational goal. 
  •  Experience supporting Ticketing Customer Care operations on major international sports events, with exposure to recruitment, training and project delivery processes. 
  •  Experience planning, monitoring and analysing ticketing customer care strategies and processes for world-scale projects; prior exposure to International Sports Events, including previous FIFA World Cups, is an advantage. 
  •  Venue and onsite operations experience for ticketing and/or sport events. 
  •  Experience in an analytical or customer care operations role during previous FIFA World Cups or comparable major international sports events is advantageous. 
  •  Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, able to work effectively within multicultural teams. 
  •  Strong communication, analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 
LANGUAGES

Fluent in English and Portuguese, spoken and written.
Spanish and/or additional languages is highly advantageous.

TECHNOLOGY 
 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Monday) and planning software and online collaboration tools   
  •  CRM software for case management, including automatic and manual management of the cases.

job.title: Senior Legal Counsel Ethics
job.html_description:
We govern the beautiful game and ensure it's run with transparency and integrity.

Join our team in Miami and support us on our mission.
These are your key tasks:
  • Conducting autonomously ethics proceedings in accordance with the FIFA Code of Ethics;
  • Investigating ethics proceedings, including the review and analysis of financial records, the use of forensic audit techniques, and the development of financial investigative strategies;
  • Drafting communications and request for information to the interested/accused parties within an ethics proceeding;
  • Supporting the preparation of witness interviews and witness statements, and, when necessary, coordinating such tasks with other departments or external experts within the context of ethics proceedings;
  • Liaising with FIFA departments and subject-matter experts to secure support for FIFA Ethics Committee matters;
  • Supporting the relevant chairperson and members of the Ethics Committee by preparing case files, legal analyses, and draft decisions to facilitate effective deliberations;
  • Assisting the relevant chairperson of the FIFA Ethics Committee in the preparation of meetings;
  • Assessment of legal aid requests, witness protection, witness/victim’s psychological support, and when necessary, coordinating such tasks with other departments or external experts within the ethics proceedings;
  • Drafting final Reports within an ethics proceeding;
  • Analyzing testimonials and other documentary evidence, including financial and audit records, to weigh its credibility and probative value within the context and standards of the FIFA Code of Ethics;
  • Conduct legal analysis of FIFA precedent and CAS jurisprudence to support the drafting of final investigation reports and Ethics Committee decisions;
  • Drafting decisions of the Adjudicatory Chamber;
  • Contributing to the ongoing development of workflows, templates, and best practices to ensure efficiency and consistency;
  • Identify and recommend measures to prevent violations of the FIFA Code of Ethics and promote the safeguarding and integrity of football worldwide;
  • Close collaboration and support to the Head of Department in creating efficient ethics proceedings (i.e. determining processes, workflow, template creation, etc.);
  • Ensuring a worldwide recognition of the activity of the Investigation Department and the Judicial Bodies Subdivision;
  • Assistance in preparing any report related to the activities of the ethics department, including newsletters, status reports, etc.
  • Holding and participating in workshops with FIFA employees, member associations or confederations on Judicial Bodies-related issues.
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • Excellent legal drafting and presentation skills in English;
  • Proficiency legal drafting in Spanish or French is an asset;
  • Good knowledge of football governance as well as of FIFA’s regulations, and proven experience in FIFA’s Disciplinary and Ethics proceedings;
  • Ability to conduct analysis and draw out conclusions;
  • Strong ability to analyze financial data, audit findings, and forensic accounting reports to detect and understand irregularities;
  • Excellent editorial skills;
  • Good planning and organisational skills;
  • Solid IT-know how;
  • Ability to work unsupervised and precisely;
  • Ability to work well under pressure and to respect deadlines;
  • Good analytical skills;
  • Conscientiousness, accuracy and quality;
  • Punctuality;
  • Proactive approach;
  • Rigorous and consistent, particularly when handling large amounts of documents;
  • Team player with good interpersonal relations;
  • Excellent communication skills;
  • Cooperative and team-oriented mindset, fostering transparent communication and knowledge sharing;
  • Motivated, autodidact, dynamic and proactive personality;
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities;
  • Agility;
  • Ability to adapt to an international and multicultural environment;
  • Pleasant and empathetic;
  • Law University degree (Bar Exam);
  • Post-Graduate in Sport law is an asset;
  •  Training or certification in white-collar investigations (including forensic accounting, CPA, CFE, etc.) or prior experience in an audit firm is an asset;
  • Minimum 6-8 years of experience in similar positions, dealing with disciplinary and ethics regulations matters in a sports governing body;
  •  Experience handling cases of misappropriation of funds, bribery and corruption, and working alongside compliance, finance teams, or external auditors, is a strong asset;
  • Native/C2 in English;
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (F / ES) is an asset;
  • Proficient in Word / PowerPoint / Excel/Jira;
  • Ability to leverage AI tools to enhance investigative efficiency while ensuring accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance with applicable legal and ethical standards.
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.
 
Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
 
Health insurance: We offer generous medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage.
Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
Retirement: We offer generous 401(k) employer contributions.
Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.

job.title: Accounts Payable Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Responsible for coordinating and executing the Accounts Payable function of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ organization, ensuring the accurate, timely, and compliant processing of supplier invoices and payments. The role supports effective cash flow management, maintains strong internal controls, ensures compliance with FIFA policies, local regulations and accounting standards, and provides high-quality support to internal stakeholders and suppliers.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Coordinate the end-to-end Accounts Payable process, from invoice receipt through payment execution and filing.
  • Review supplier invoices and supporting documentation to ensure compliance with FIFA policies, procurement procedures, contractual requirements, and approval workflows.
  • Process supplier invoices accurately and timely within the ERP system (e.g., SAP).
  • Monitor invoice approval workflows and proactively follow up with budget owners and internal stakeholders to avoid payment delays.
  • Prepare and perform supplier payment runs, ensuring all payments are properly authorized prior to execution.
  • Maintain vendor master data and ensure supplier information is complete, accurate, and up to date.
  • Reconcile supplier statements and investigate discrepancies, resolving issues in collaboration with suppliers and internal departments.
  • Support cash flow planning by maintaining accurate payment schedules and providing payment forecasts to the Finance team.
  • Ensure appropriate accounting classification and coding of invoices in accordance with IFRS, local GAAP, and FIFA accounting policies.
  • Assist with month-end and year-end closing activities related to Accounts Payable, including accruals, reconciliations, and reporting.
  • Support external and internal audits by preparing documentation and responding to audit requests.
  • Monitor outstanding liabilities and identify opportunities to improve payment processes and controls.
  • Establish and maintain positive working relationships with suppliers, resolving payment-related inquiries in a professional and timely manner.
  • Liaise closely with Procurement, Accounting, Tax, and budget owners to ensure efficient financial operations.
  • Prepare Accounts Payable reports, analyses, and KPIs as requested by management.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of finance processes, internal controls, and system enhancements.
  • Assist the Head of Finance and management team with special projects and ad hoc requests.

Qualifications and Experience
Education
• Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field.
Experience
• Proven experience in Accounts Payable, Accounting, or Finance operations.
• Experience working with ERP systems, preferably SAP.
• Experience in an international organization or project environment is an advantage.
• Experience supporting large-scale events, projects, or matrix organizations is an advantage.
• Experience working with Procurement-to-Pay (P2P) processes is preferred.

Skills & Competencies

• Strong understanding of Accounts Payable processes and financial controls.
• Good communication skills and ability to communicate effectively in English (oral and written).
• Strong organizational and planning skills.
• High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
• Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
• Problem-solving mindset and proactive approach.
• Strong customer-service orientation with both internal and external stakeholders.
• Excellent analytical and reconciliation skills.
• High level of integrity, confidentiality, and responsibility.
• Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel.

Certifications & Requirements
  • Experience with SAP or equivalent ERP systems preferred.
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Digital Activations Manager
job.html_description:
As the organiser of some of the biggest and most iconic sport events in the world, we lead the way in the sport and event industry.

Join the team and support us on our mission.
These are your key tasks:
  • Lead the planning and delivery of designated regional Tournament Supporter activations across FIFA digital platforms, including CRM, paid media and social campaigns.
  • Support media planning, inventory coordination, reporting and media valuation across Digital Activations campaigns.
  • Manage day-to-day partner activation requirements, including agency coordination, asset approvals and stakeholder alignment.
  • Support reporting frameworks, optimisation initiatives and campaign effectiveness analysis in collaboration with internal media valuation specialists.
  • Drive the optimisation and standardisation of activation processes and campaign delivery workflows.
  • Coordinate cross-functional campaign implementation across Digital Marketing, working with Audience Growth, Editorial, Social, Content Production and Digital Experience teams.
  • Build and manage relationships across FIFA’s Commercial Division, including Partnerships Management, Product Development and Business Intelligence teams.
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • 5+ years’ experience in sports marketing, digital marketing, partnership activation, media planning or campaign management
  • Strong experience working across digital marketing channels, platforms and applying activation best practices
  • Proven experience coordinating cross-functional campaigns and managing multiple stakeholders in complex organisations
  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in Sports Business Management & Marketing, Business Development, and/or Innovation, Digital Products
  • Fluent in English
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (F / ES / GER) is an asset
  • Proficient in Word / PowerPoint / Excel
  • Proactive, collaborative and adaptable
  • Excellent communication, project management and organisational skills, with the ability to operate effectively in fast-paced international environments
  • Data-driven mindset with experience in campaign reporting, performance analysis and audience insights
  • A strong interest in football and the evolving digital and commercial landscape of the sport
  • Willingness to travel for work related projects (e.g. FIFA Tournament, FIFA Event, Partner Workshop etc)  
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.

Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
  • Health and fitness: Regular football sessions for all abilities, plus on-site gym.
  • Home office: Up to two days of home office per week if work permits and home office allowance for all.
  • Language courses: Offered to all staff to aid personal and professional growth.
  • Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
  • Pension: Flexible pension benefits with generous employer contributions.
  • Relocation assistance: A dedicated team will be on hand to support your relocation.
  • Sustainability: We support all employees using public transport.
  • Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.
  • Volunteering: Make an impact beyond your regular role and bond with colleagues by volunteering with one of our partners.
