job.title: Hospitality Operations & Infrastructure Venue Manager - 6 Host Cities (Brazil)
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. 

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Sitting within the Ticketing & Hospitality Department, Hospitality (along with Ticketing) aims to deliver the most engaging and innovative FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™ experience for all commercial partners, customers, guests and the FIFA football family.  

Reporting organizationally to the Head of FWWC27 Hospitality Operations, the Hospitality Operations & Infrastructure Venue Manager will help serve Hospitality efforts for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ that is hosting 32 teams across 8 venues.   

This role will be responsible for the supervision of the implementation of all stadium Hospitality infrastructure requirements and technical operations across all stadiums of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, and later assuming a fixed position as Rio de Janeiro Stadium Hospitality Operations & Infrastructure Venue Manager during tournament time. She/he will work closely with the Official Hospitality Provider and FIFA’s stadium operations and infrastructure functional areas to ensure contractual and requirements compliance. 

The main responsibilities and oversights of the Hospitality Operations and Venue Services Manager for the FIFA Women´s World Cup 2027™ include: 

  • Responsible for the management and operational readiness and delivery of the Affiliates and Commercial Hospitality programmes, reporting duties, maintenance/creation of operational and infrastructure documentations, etc;
  • Ensuring Infrastructure readiness and maintenance services of Hospitality areas, in close cooperation with the FIFA other functional areas, the Official Hospitality Provider (OHP) and Stadium Authorities;
  • Responsible for the on-site management of the Official Hospitality Provider (OHP) and their suppliers, and Hospitality Volunteers;
  • Checking and validating the Operational plans from the service-providing departments to Hospitality (Cleaning and Waste, Security, Medical, Signage, Transport, Fan Operations, Accreditation, Power, IT, TV, ticketing, etc.);
  • Ensuring excellent service to the FIFA Affiliates on site, overlooking the set-up and readiness of their facilities, monitoring service delivery from the Official Hospitality Provider (OHP) from the set-up phase through to match day delivery of services;
  • Ensuring contractual deliverables to the FIFA Commercial Affiliates and to the Official Hospitality Provider (OHP);
  • Overall on-site hospitality guest management;
  • Ensure service consistency throughout the different hospitality programmes across all matches in the venue;
  • Validating all on-site hospitality directional signage;  
  • Ensuring Health and Safety regulations are strictly observed and respected by the Official Hospitality Provider (OHP);
  • Ensuring Hospitality guest numbers are updated and shared with all relevant FIFA stakeholders;   
  • Ensuring that all stakeholders are appropriately accredited. Manage the distribution of SADs (supplementary access devices) to all relevant functional areas, restricting access to hospitality areas as needed;
  • Ensure the catering service runs as expected in the Affiliates and Commercial Hospitality programmes;
  • Handling all hospitality related issues on Match Day;
  • Attend the FIFA Daily Coordination Meeting at the Venue and hold daily Hospitality Team Meetings with the Official Hospitality Provider (OHP); 
  • Reporting on a daily basis to the FIFA HQ, reporting issues in good time.
Education & Qualifications 
  • Bachelor’s Degree or similar level of education in Event Management, Sports Hospitality Management, Project Management, etc.
Work Experience 

  • Minimum of 5 years of work experience in stadium hospitality or venue management, managing several venues simultaneously, preferably for major sports or entertainment events;
  • Proven experience with event overlay (including provision of temporary power and water), ticketing, dressing and signage, catering,  logistics and security operations;
  • Proven experience managing multiple service providers, particularly for Technical services, Cleaning and Waste services, Security Services, Access control Services, Accreditation, etc;
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills;
  • Strong customer-service attitude, even when under pressure;
  • Ability to work independently and in a team across simultaneous work streams;
  • Exquisite organizational skills;
  • Ability to lead, manage, and motivate a team.
 Languages 

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English. Additional languages considered an asset. 

Technology 

  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools;
  • Excellent knowledge of AutoCAD and literacy of architectural drawings.

job.title: Ticketing System Manager

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Reporting to Senior Ticketing Operations Manager, and working alongside the FIFA Ticketing team in Zurich, the Ticketing System Manager configures the ticketing system to ensure best in class solutions are available to sell and manage tickets for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027. The role offers support to ticketing system users, promotes the use of information management systems and carries out quality assurance measures.

· Manage regular meetings, trainings and other forms of learning/collaboration opportunities to support the local ticketing team in using the ticketing solution

· Promote the use and continuous improvement of information and knowledge management systems
· Support general ticketing operations for FIFA events

• Strong experience in operating / managing ticketing systems
• Proven experience working in similar roles at big scale sporting events
• Experience working in international and multicultural environments

• Strong ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams.

• Excellent communication skills, both within and across multiple functional areas.

Reporting to Senior Ticketing Operations Manager, and working alongside the FIFA Ticketing team in Zurich, the Ticketing System Manager configures the ticketing system to ensure best in class solutions are available to sell and manage tickets for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027. The role offers support to ticketing system users, promotes the use of information management systems and carries out quality assurance measures.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
· Managing the configuration of the ticketing system to offer frontend and backend solutions for ticketing system users, B2C and B2B clients · Coordinate backend operations in the ticketing system such as batch processes · Coordinate 1st level support and liaise with the FIFA Ticketing team and the service provider for 2nd and 3rd level support · Consult ticketing system users, review and prepare user manuals · Conduct functional and user acceptance tests of frontend and backend solutions including for ticketing system improvements · Manage regular meetings, trainings and other forms of learning/collaboration opportunities to support the local ticketing team in using the ticketing solution · Carry out quality assurance measurers to ensure error-free delivery of ticketing system solutions · Promote the use and continuous improvement of information and knowledge management systems · Support general ticketing operations for FIFA events
Education
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent level of education.
Experience
• Strong experience in operating / managing ticketing systems
• Proven experience working in similar roles at big scale sporting events
• Experience working in international and multicultural environments
Skills & Competencies
• Strong ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams.
• Detail-oriented, with focus on delivering high-quality projects.
• Excellent communication skills, both within and across multiple functional areas.
Certifications & Requirements
· Languages: Fluent in English and Portuguese · Right to work in Brazil · Fluent in English (spoken and written) · Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written) · Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Volunteer Operations Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting to the Volunteer Operations Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer Operations Coordinator will help bring together thousands of volunteers across the 8 Host Cities.

In this role, you will support the planning and delivery of the main milestones of the FIFA Volunteer Programme, in the areas of promoting, selecting, training, and tournament time. You will work closely with other Functional Areas and the 8 Host Cities of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. 

We are looking for someone with previous experience in volunteer operations or event operations, who understands the challenges and opportunities of a major global event delivery, and has a professional background working in Brazil.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Support the planning, coordination and the daily operations of the FIFA Volunteer Programme– including the provision of the volunteer services such as transport, catering, rewards and recognition.
  •  Work on the volunteer journey milestones, such as promotional events, selection, training, and tournament-time operations including the Official Draw and Tournament Playoffs
  • Contribute to volunteer headcount planning efforts working closely with all Functional Areas to collect volunteer requirements and volunteer shifts
  • Support working relationships with Host City teams, stadium authorities, and service providers to ensure smooth project delivery.
  • Help develop volunteer policies and procedures that follow FIFA standards and guidelines.
  • Support the planning and delivery of the readiness workshops for the FWWC27 Volunteer Management team to ensure all locations are prepared for operations.
  • Support procurement processes (including RFI and RFP) for all services needed for volunteer operations from launch through tournament time, in coordination with Volunteer Operations Manager – FIFA27.
  • Support work with Functional Areas to ensure all volunteer-related services are planned and delivered according to the FIFA standards ensuring a consistent volunteer experience across all 8 host cities 
  • Support the Volunteer Contact Center operations, ensuring effective training, alignment, and coordination with third-party service providers.
  • Support the planning, coordination, and execution of the Volunteer Training Journey throughout all phases of the programme.
Education: 
  • Master in Sports Management or Event Management or Project Management preferred.
Experience: 
  • Working experience in volunteer programmes supporting the volunteer journey, including promotion, recruitment, engagement and tournament time operations.
  • High level of proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Demonstrated ability to develop beneficial working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills, with a proven ability to prioritise tasks, multitask effectively, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience operating in complex, multi-stakeholder environment, with the flexibility and resilience to adapt to change and remain solution oriented.
  • Excellent communication skills in both English and Portuguese (written and verbal), with the ability to communicate clearly across diverse teams and cultures.
  • A collaborative and inclusive team player, capable of working effectively with colleagues both on-site and remotely, while fostering a positive and respectful working environment.
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Ticketing Digital Communications Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Ticketing Customer Relationship Senior Manager and working closely with the Ticketing Digital Communications Manager, the Ticketing Digital Communications Coordinator will help serve Ticketing and Hospitality efforts for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™. 

This role will coordinate the planning and execution of all customer communications and collaterals across the ticket sales process, in line with the applicable sales strategy and ticketing requirements, working closely with all other sub-teams and Functional Areas to ensure consistent delivery. 

The Ticketing Digital Communications Coordinator focuses particularly on the delivery of accurate, consistent, and relevant outputs to ensure that the customer has all the relevant information needed before, during, and after the purchase process for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™, within the right timing, the correct format and the appropriate language for each customer.

  • Coordinate the creation and delivery of all ticket sales collateral and customer communications, including drafting, reviewing, translating, implementing, and maintaining them to meet quality and timing requirements, in line with the established strategy and processes. 
  • Draft and review the sales collaterals and customer communications, which include but are not limited to: content for online ticketing portals and mobile apps, FIFA.com pages, FAQs portal, Standard Responses, Chatbot scripts, ticketing guides, call centre and IVR scripts, transactional emails and customer communications. 
  • Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to execute the review and translation of all content into relevant languages, following established processes and ensuring quality and timeliness. 
  • Maintain the ticketing glossary and respective translations, ensuring their correct and consistent implementation. 
  • Regularly liaise with the Customer Care team to review the effectiveness of the sales collaterals and the customer communications. 
  • Support the identification and implementation of solutions to proactively communicate with customers and contribute to customer information and satisfaction goals. 
  • Monitor and continuously update all sales collaterals and customer communications, to ensure accuracy, relevance, and consistency at all times during the ticketing customer journey process. 
  • Support the team to ensure timely and effective content management of online ticketing portals and mobile ticketing apps, including the execution of applicable user acceptance tests. 
  • Ensure all sales collaterals and customer communications are accurate, consistent, relevant, and compliant with the applicable sales strategy and ticketing requirements. 
  • Support the use of a CRM system and a Marketing Automation Tool to send transactional emails and mass communications to customers, including building and sending of audiences, workflows, emails, communications, and respective reporting of results. 
  • Ensure an efficient administration and archive of all versions of sales collaterals and customer communications, in all languages. 
  • Ensure adherence to specific operational deadlines and compliance with ticketing policies and regulations. 
SKILLS FRAMEWORK  
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyse one’s behaviour, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes. 
 
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculated risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.    
 
INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts. 
 
INITIATIVE: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents.  
  
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans. 
 
EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS 
 
Bachelor's or master's degree or equivalent in a relevant area such as Digital Marketing, Communications, or similar.    
 
WORK EXPERIENCE 
 
  • Minimum three years of experience creating and coordinating content for ticketing processes/solutions for events, ideally in the sports industry. 
  • Experience using content management and Marketing Automation Tools within large-scale projects, ideally inside ticketing and/or sports events, requiring strong communication and organizational skills. 
  • Coordinating projects related to content creation and/or translations that require attention to detail, ensuring accuracy and consistency. 
  • Venue and onsite operations experience for large-scale events, ideally in the sports industry, is nice to have. 
  • Communication and problem-solving skills. 
  • Translation experience, translating digital content and documents from English to Portuguese and vice-versa, would be an advantage. 
 
LANGUAGES 
 
Fluent in English and Portuguese, spoken and written.   
 
A native level of at least one of the following: French, Spanish, German or Arabic is nice to have. 
 
TECHNOLOGY 
 
Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools.
 
Marketing Automation Tools and Content management platforms.   
 
Experience with Ticketing Systems is nice to have.

Certifications & Requirements 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Right to work in Brazil

job.title: Recruitment & Reporting Analyst - People with Disabilities (PWD)
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

This is an exclusive job opportunity for people with disabilities, as part of our commitment to inclusive hiring.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Support the recruitment team in ensuring accurate and detail-oriented management of recruitment data, systems, and reporting tools, including spreadsheets, dynamic tables, and presentation materials that support hiring decisions, while attracting the best talents aligned with FWWC2027 values, conducting resume analysis and candidate screening.

Our selection process is accessible, and accommodations can be requested at any stage.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Data Management, Reporting & Analysis: 
    • Accurately input, update and maintain recruitment data across various systems and spreadsheets, ensuring precision and consistency;
    • Build and maintain dynamic/pivot tables to organize and cross-reference recruitment data;
    • Analyze recruitment reports and metrics, critically reviewing data to identify inconsistencies, trends and insights that support decision-making;
    • Prepare clear and well-structured PowerPoint presentations to communicate recruitment data and updates to stakeholders;
    • Update and standardize templates across systems;
  • Manage recruitment systems, tools and templates with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail, maintaining up-to-date records of all recruitment information in alignment with internal stakeholders; hiring managers, workforce planning, onboarding and payroll;
  • Analyze resumes, screen and shortlist candidates against role requirements, supporting the recruitment team throughout the end-to-end hiring process; sourcing, screening, interviewing, reference checks, offer support and onboarding;
  • Provide support to functional areas and hiring managers about recruitment policies and procedures, clarifying recruitment processes, tools and workforce plan;
  • Support employer branding actions, raising awareness about FWWC2027 and maximizing candidates' access to job advertisements;
  • Comply with all FIFA and FWWC2027 hiring and recruitment policies and procedures and local legislation.
  • Bachelor's degree completed or on going in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology or related field;
  • Previous experience in recruitment processes, such as resume screening and candidate assessment, is a plus;
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy, particularly when working with spreadsheets and data entry; does not need to be an advanced Excel user, but must be highly reliable;
  • Good working knowledge of HR/recruitment systems and applicant tracking systems;
  • Proficiency in MS Excel, including building and interpreting pivot tables;
  • Ability to prepare clear, well-organized PowerPoint presentations;
  • Analytical mindset, able to review and critically assess data to support decision-making;
  • Familiarity with employee administration and compliance requirements;
  • Proactive and organized, able to work independently as well as part of a team;
  • Knowledge of HR best practices, employment laws, and regulations;
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills;
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion;
  • Technology: Familiarity with MS Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) is desirable; prior exposure to HR systems and online collaboration tools will be considered a plus;
  • Right to work in Brazil;
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written);
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written);
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Senior Legal Counsel Regulatory Governance & Compliance
job.html_description:
We govern the beautiful game and ensure it's run with transparency and integrity.

Join our team in Miami and support us on our mission.
These are your key tasks:
  • Handle all matters concerning regulatory governance, in particular in relation to the FIFA Statutes and the FIFA Governance Regulations, and cooperate with the Member Associations Governance and Services Department in governance matters of Member Associations.
  • Provide substantial comments and feedback to regulatory projects, legal documents and general matters related to all FIFA Regulations, commentaries/explanatory notes, memos and similar.
  • Provide responses to regulatory enquiries from all internal and external football stakeholders.
  • Handle complex investigations into possible breaches of FIFA Regulations, notably the FIFA Regulations on the Status and Transfer of Players, FIFA Football Agent Regulations, FIFA Clearing House Regulations, and others.
  • Gather and assess evidence, prepare case files and reports for disciplinary proceedings before the FIFA judicial bodies.
  • Have an active role in the general management of such investigations: drafting correspondence, reports, methodology guidelines, setting up a database of relevant decisions and jurisprudence, and actively participating in working groups to improve the efficiency and legal accuracy of the processes, among others.
  • Monitor the international transfer system and the activities of all involved stakeholders for possible breaches of FIFA Regulations.
  • Manage and supervise administrative cases of minor infractions.
  • Develop and administer compliance education programs for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Develop creative approaches to tackle non-compliant behaviours, including through cooperation with external stakeholders and organisations.
  • Research and analysis of the jurisprudence of FIFA and CAS.
  • Mentor other team members, advising on substantive legal matters, as well as efficient ways to allocate time and resources. 


We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • At least 5 years post-qualification experience, either in a law firm, sports governing body, football stakeholder or sports organisation.
  • Accuracy and detail orientation, combined with a pragmatic approach when solving problems.
  • Autonomy and excellence, positively impacting the efficiency and quality, resulting in an optimal service to the stakeholders.
  • Strong sense of responsibility and accountability.
  • Critical judgement: ability to separate essential issues from side-issues and to set the right priorities when allocating resources to investigate regulatory breaches.
  • Self-confidence and diplomacy.
  • Solution orientation and innovation skills, with great ability to embrace changes and new technologies and processes.
  • Fluent in English.
  • Proficiency in at least one other FIFA language (F / ES).
  • Proficient use of MS Office Applications.
  • Readiness for stand-by duties.
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.
 
Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
 
Health insurance: We offer generous medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage.
Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
Retirement: We offer generous 401(k) employer contributions.
Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.

job.title: Dressing and Signage Design Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Dressing and Signage Design Manager reports to the Senior Dressing and Signage Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. 
The FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing and Signage Design Manager will be responsible for the overall management of the design workflow across the Dressing and Signage Project. The role is not principally a designer role, although the ability to design and artwork would be beneficial, the role will be to manage the workload of in-house and freelance design and artworking teams, and the workload for supplier-based artworking teams. The role will also be responsible for the sign-off of all event dressing and signage artworks prior to them entering the production phase. 

The successful candidate will work with the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ Dressing and Signage appointed suppliers to develop a robust sign off procedure for the full product design, artwork and production processes using a combination of existing content management systems and in some cases custom solutions.  They will be required to develop a comprehensive understanding of the brand for both tournaments and knowledge on how this can be translated successfully into elements suitable for dressing and signage. 

The role will be responsible for the design of all Dressing and Signage at the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ including but not exclusive to the following workstream assets: 
  • Stadium Dressing 
  • Stadium Wayfinding 
  • Non-competition Venue Dressing 
  • Non-competition Venue Wayfinding 
  • Functional Area Signage and commodities 
  • Kit of Parts dressing 
  • Venue Concessions 
  • Fleet Buses 
The successful candidate will ensure all deliverables align with FIFA's exacting standards while optimizing operational efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • To manage the design and artwork of all printed and digital materials required for the Dressing and Signage and function. 
  • To manage the creation of any mock-ups or visualisations that are required for the Dressing and Signage Function. 
  • To manage a network of in-house freelance designers and the workload for appointed supplier based design teams. 
  • To work with suppliers to create templates for all artworks, with all production considerations catered for such as required bleed etc. 
  • To work with other functional areas to create template visualisations of spaces across official sites. 
  • To be the initial and primary member of the artwork sign of team ensuring all artworks meet the design guidelines and principles for the respective competitions. 
  • Develop and manage a robust design and artworking process with the Dressing and Signage appointed suppliers, maximizing use of their content management systems where possible. 
  • Acting as the focal point for all Dressing and Signage design and artwork related queries and inputting into team meetings and reporting where necessary. 
  • Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods. 
  • Strong experience in a Design management role in a fast paced environment, ideally with tangible experience in delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. 
  • An understanding of the technical aspects of print and production on dressing and signage projects advantageous (i.e. print/production methods, materials and the end purpose of designed assets). 
  • Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events or projects. 
  • Experience in the development and integration of Design Processes using content management systems. 
  • Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organisations and departments. 
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field. 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. 
  •  The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential. 
  • The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on-site attendance during the tournament period. 
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Bilingual – Brazilian Portuguese and English. 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
job.plain_text_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Dressing and Signage Design Manager reports to the Senior Dressing and Signage Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders.
The FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing and Signage Design Manager will be responsible for the overall management of the design workflow across the Dressing and Signage Project. The role is not principally a designer role, although the ability to design and artwork would be beneficial, the role will be to manage the workload of in-house and freelance design and artworking teams, and the workload for supplier-based artworking teams. The role will also be responsible for the sign-off of all event dressing and signage artworks prior to them entering the production phase.
The successful candidate will work with the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ Dressing and Signage appointed suppliers to develop a robust sign off procedure for the full product design, artwork and production processes using a combination of existing content management systems and in some cases custom solutions. They will be required to develop a comprehensive understanding of the brand for both tournaments and knowledge on how this can be translated successfully into elements suitable for dressing and signage.
The role will be responsible for the design of all Dressing and Signage at the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ including but not exclusive to the following workstream assets:
- Stadium Dressing - Stadium Wayfinding - Non-competition Venue Dressing - Non-competition Venue Wayfinding - Functional Area Signage and commodities - Kit of Parts dressing - Venue Concessions - Fleet Buses
The successful candidate will ensure all deliverables align with FIFA's exacting standards while optimizing operational efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- To manage the design and artwork of all printed and digital materials required for the Dressing and Signage and function. - To manage the creation of any mock-ups or visualisations that are required for the Dressing and Signage Function. - To manage a network of in-house freelance designers and the workload for appointed supplier based design teams. - To work with suppliers to create templates for all artworks, with all production considerations catered for such as required bleed etc. - To work with other functional areas to create template visualisations of spaces across official sites. - To be the initial and primary member of the artwork sign of team ensuring all artworks meet the design guidelines and principles for the respective competitions. - Develop and manage a robust design and artworking process with the Dressing and Signage appointed suppliers, maximizing use of their content management systems where possible. - Acting as the focal point for all Dressing and Signage design and artwork related queries and inputting into team meetings and reporting where necessary. - Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods.
- Strong experience in a Design management role in a fast paced environment, ideally with tangible experience in delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. - An understanding of the technical aspects of print and production on dressing and signage projects advantageous (i.e. print/production methods, materials and the end purpose of designed assets). - Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events or projects. - Experience in the development and integration of Design Processes using content management systems. - Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organisations and departments. - Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field. - Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. - The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential. - The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on-site attendance during the tournament period. - Right to work in Brazil. - Bilingual – Brazilian Portuguese and English. - Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: CHEF(FE) DU DÉPARTEMENT MARKETING - Fédération Sénégalaise de Football
job.html_description:
Dans le cadre du renforcement de son organisation et du développement de ses activités, la Fédération Sénégalaise de Football recrute un(e) Chef(fe) du Département Marketing.

Sous l’autorité du Secrétaire Général, le/la Chef(fe) du Département Marketing est chargé(e) de définir, piloter et mettre en œuvre la stratégie marketing et commerciale de la Fédération, avec pour objectif de renforcer la valeur de la marque FSF, développer ses ressources propres, accroître son attractivité auprès des différents publics et partenaires.

Il/elle assure le pilotage stratégique et opérationnel du département et coordonne l'ensemble des initiatives liées au développement commercial, à la valorisation de la marque et à l'activation des opportunités marketing de la Fédération.
Définition et pilotage de la stratégie marketing
  • Élaborer la stratégie marketing de la FSF en cohérence avec ses orientations stratégiques et ses objectifs de développement.
  • Définir les priorités, plans d'action et indicateurs de performance du département.
  • Développer une vision globale de la valorisation des actifs, compétitions, équipes nationales, événements et propriétés de la Fédération.
  • Assurer une veille permanente sur les tendances du marketing sportif, du sponsoring, de l'entertainment et du développement des marques.
  • Identifier de nouveaux leviers de croissance et de valorisation pour la FSF.

Développement des revenus et des partenariats
  • Définir et piloter la stratégie de développement des revenus issus des activités marketing et commerciales.
  • Identifier, prospecter et développer des partenaires et sponsors nationaux et internationaux.
  • Concevoir des offres de sponsoring et de partenariat innovantes et adaptées aux différents marchés.
  • Piloter les négociations commerciales et contribuer à la conclusion des accords de partenariat.
  • Développer et entretenir un portefeuille stratégique de partenaires.
  • Assurer le suivi de la performance et de la rentabilité des partenariats.
  • Identifier de nouvelles opportunités de monétisation et de valorisation des actifs de la FSF.

Développement commercial et hospitalités
  • Développer les opportunités commerciales liées aux compétitions, événements et activités de la FSF.
  • Concevoir et structurer des offres commerciales et d'hospitalité à destination des entreprises, partenaires et publics ciblés.
  • Optimiser les revenus issus des différentes offres et propriétés commerciales de la Fédération.
  • Développer des expériences à forte valeur ajoutée pour les partenaires et parties prenantes.
  • Mettre en place des outils de suivi, d'analyse et de reporting de la performance commerciale.

Développement et valorisation de la marque FSF
  • Définir et piloter la stratégie de développement et de valorisation de la marque FSF.
  • Renforcer le positionnement, la visibilité et l'attractivité de la marque au Sénégal, en Afrique et à l'international.
  • Développer des initiatives permettant d'accroître la valeur et la notoriété de la marque FSF.
  • Veiller à la cohérence de l'identité, du positionnement et de l'utilisation de la marque sur l'ensemble des supports et propriétés de la Fédération.
  • Développer des stratégies d'activation et d'engagement autour de la marque FSF et de ses différentes propriétés.

Management et pilotage du département
  • Définir l'organisation, les objectifs et les priorités du département.
  • Encadrer, animer et développer les équipes placées sous sa responsabilité.
  • Répartir les missions, assurer le suivi des performances et accompagner la montée en compétences des collaborateurs.
  • Élaborer et suivre le budget du département.
  • Mettre en place des outils de pilotage et de reporting permettant de mesurer les résultats et l'impact des actions engagées.
  • Assurer une coordination étroite avec les autres directions et départements de la Fédération.

Représentation et développement de l'écosystème
  • Représenter la FSF auprès des entreprises, partenaires, agences, médias, institutions et acteurs de l'écosystème sportif et économique.
  • Développer un réseau stratégique de contacts au niveau national, africain et international.
  • Identifier et développer des collaborations susceptibles de contribuer au rayonnement et au développement de la Fédération.
  • Participer aux événements, rencontres et forums professionnels pertinents pour le développement de la FSF.
  • Formation supérieure de niveau Bac+4/5 en marketing, commerce, management, communication, business development ou domaine équivalent.
  • Expérience significative à un poste de responsabilité dans le marketing, le développement commercial, le sponsoring, les partenariats ou la gestion de marque.
  • Une expérience confirmée dans le sport, l'événementiel, les médias, le divertissement ou un environnement similaire constitue un atout majeur.
  • Expérience avérée dans le développement et la gestion de partenariats commerciaux.
  • Solides compétences en négociation et en développement des affaires.
  • Bonne maîtrise des enjeux de stratégie de marque et de marketing sportif.
  • Expérience en management d'équipe et en pilotage de projets.
  • Capacité à élaborer une stratégie tout en assurant son déploiement opérationnel.
  • Forte orientation résultats et développement des revenus.
  • Excellentes capacités relationnelles, de représentation et de négociation.
  • Maîtrise du français et bonne maîtrise de l'anglais professionnel

job.title: Production specialist
job.html_description:
As the organiser of some of the biggest and most iconic sport events in the world, we lead the way in the sport and event industry.

Join the team and support us on our mission.
These are your key tasks:

In-House printing production
  • Run and schedule the in-house print facility (digital and large-format printing, finishing, binding) to meet deadlines.
  • Maintain equipment and consumables, and set quality standards for all finished output.
  • Handle urgent, last-minute print requests for events, often same-day.
  • Track costs and turnaround time, and uphold health and safety standards in the print area.
Merchandise order coordination
  • Create and deliver on-brand print and digital assets, from concept to final production.
  • Support events, campaigns, and internal communications with high-quality creative solutions.
 Corporate internal online shop (External Partner Management)
  • Act as main point of contact for the vendor operating the corporate online shop. 
  • Brief new products, manage the catalogue, and approve artwork before launch.
  • Monitor service levels and fulfilment, and run regular performance reviews with the vendor.
 Graphic design
  • Create on-brand print and digital assets.
  • Prepare and review production-ready artwork.
  • Deliver design solutions for events, campaigns, and internal communications. 
General
  • Manage supplier relationships and support contract discussions.
  • Track production status, costs, and performance metrics.
  • Resolve operational issues and support junior team members or freelancers.
  • Provide support during major events, including outside standard working hours.

We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • 3-5 years of experience in print production and graphic design.
  • Proven ability to deliver in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments.
  • Experience managing external suppliers or agencies. 
  • Experience in sport, events, entertainment, or similar industries is an asset.
  • Native/Fluent in English
  • Working proficiency in German
  • Professional-level command of Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop) or equivalent design tools. 
  • Hands-on experience operating and maintaining print production equipment.
  • Familiarity with e-commerce or online shop administration platforms is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent vocational qualification in graphic design, print media, production, or a related field.
  • Highly organised, able to work autonomously across multiple concurrent orders and deadlines.
  • Commercially aware, with sound judgement on cost and quality trade-offs.
  • Clear, confident communicator, comfortable briefing designers, suppliers and senior stakeholders.
  • Calm under pressure, hands-on and detail-oriented.
  • Thrives under tight, last-minute deadlines; reprioritizes quickly when urgent requests arise.
  • Flexible and available to support events outside standard hours when required.
  • Collaborative team player who takes ownership and follows through.
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.

Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
  • Health and fitness: Regular football sessions for all abilities, plus on-site gym.
  • Home office: Up to two days of home office per week if work permits and home office allowance for all.
  • Language courses: Offered to all staff to aid personal and professional growth.
  • Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
  • Pension: Flexible pension benefits with generous employer contributions.
  • Relocation assistance: A dedicated team will be on hand to support your relocation.
  • Sustainability: We support all employees using public transport.
  • Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.
  • Volunteering: Make an impact beyond your regular role and bond with colleagues by volunteering with one of our partners.

job.title: Senior Legal Counsel, Disputes & Litigation
job.html_description:
We govern the beautiful game and ensure it's run with transparency and integrity.

Join our team in Miami and support us on our mission.
These are your key tasks:
  • Responsible for the conduct of all external disputes and contentious matters involving FIFA, including civil and criminal matters and arbitration cases (note: this does not include the conduct of any sports-related matters in the CAS); 
  • Providing legal advice and guidance across all functional areas at FIFA related to contentious matters, including advising on litigation risks and outcomes; 
  • Conduct of settlement negotiations in the context of disputes;
  • Managing multiple cases in Switzerland and internationally; 
  • Engagement and instruction of external counsel, and responsibility for budgets for external legal spend; and
  • Attending court hearings, reviewing, drafting and commenting on documents.  
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • Fully qualified to practise law (admitted to the Florida bar or eligible to register as Florida Authorized House Counsel) having completed academic and practical training
  • 8+ years of legal practice PQE
  • Substantial professional experience of working with and drafting legal documents in English
  • Excellent negotiation, drafting, problem solving and analytical skills
  • Enhanced expertise: 8 years expertise "on the job" in a recognised firm or in a similar role in an in-house legal department
  • Demonstrable interest in or experience of sports, media, sponsorship and regulatory matters, including and interest in the interplay between sports and competition law
  • First class written and spoken English language skills, consistent with drafting and negotiating complex, high value and nuanced English language agreements
  • Comfortable providing advice and recommendations to senior leadership
  • Ability to provide and communicate effectively practical and solutions-based legal advice 
  • Excellent negotiation, drafting, problem solving and analytical skills
  • Structured, reliable, highly organised with a strong eye for detail 
  • Ability to work as part of a high-performing team, fostering collaboration, driving results, and ensuring the successful achievement of organizational goals.
  • Proactive, with a strong sense of personal responsibility with an ability to work autonomously on a wide variety of projects
  • Resilient, with an ability to competently handle a large workload amid rapidly shifting priorities
  • Open-minded team player with an affinity for working within a variety of cultures and excellent communication skills
  • High degree of professionalism and confident demeanour
  • Ability to be a good ambassador for FIFA in all manner of external facing situations, including during court hearings, mediations and negotiations, external workshops and during FIFA competition-related assignments
  • Ability to create, develop and maintain strong and reliable relationships with FIFA senior management as well as external legal and commercial counterparts
  • Willingness to operate outside of comfort zone
  • Takes initiative to reflect on how to improve and develop working styles and methods to assist the organisation and internal clients
  • Native level English (or equivalent), consistent with requirement to draft and negotiate complex and nuanced English language agreements and advice. 
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (French/Spanish/German) is an asset but not necessary
  • Proficient in Word / PowerPoint / Excel
  • Willingness to travel
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.
 
Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
 
Health insurance: We offer generous medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage.
Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
Retirement: We offer generous 401(k) employer contributions.
Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.

job.title: Senior Digital Communications Product Manager
job.html_description:
As the organiser of some of the biggest and most iconic sport events in the world, we lead the way in the sport and event industry.

Join the team and support us on our mission.
These are your key tasks:
  • Lead product leadership and strategy by defining, designing, and delivering FIFA’s digital content products across all owned platforms, managing the full product lifecycle and aligning product strategies with divisional goals. Drive innovation and consistency by developing product roadmaps, calendars, and budgets that balance creativity and efficiency, providing strategic insights that shape FIFA’s digital vision and translating priorities into actionable initiatives that deliver measurable engagement and value.
  • Ensure effective product delivery and implementation by managing all product requirements—such as text, video, graphics, and statistics—for corporate and competition coverage across digital platforms, ensuring delivery quality and adherence to schedule and budget. Coordinate with editorial, technical, and communications teams to manage product rollouts through sprint planning, briefings, and reviews, validating progress through user‑acceptance testing and post‑deployment checks. Define and supervise business needs for core digital tools and features (e.g., SEO, search, video players, APIs) to guarantee high editorial and technical standards.
  • Drive collaboration and stakeholder engagement by leading requirements‑gathering sessions and workshops with colleagues and key business stakeholders, translating needs into a clear and prioritised product backlog. Facilitate cross‑divisional coordination to align content creation and platform delivery, ensure communications perspectives are represented in cross‑functional projects (e.g., CMS, CRM, and regional platforms), and develop strong partnerships with internal teams to secure alignment, support, and shared accountability.
  • Oversee content operations and platform excellence by collaborating with content teams to coordinate multilingual, multimedia, photographic, and statistical content across FIFA digital platforms, ensuring brand and editorial consistency. Manage communications‑specific products and oversee CMS management and live support, and ensure effective tagging and organisation of data and assets within the FIFA Digital Hub (FDH). Support video production for corporate and competition activities, maintaining the highest editorial and compliance standards.
  • Promote digital innovation and continuous improvement by fostering a digital‑first culture that replaces outdated processes with modern, scalable solutions. Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies and AI‑based tools to enhance efficiency and user experience, conduct research and benchmarking to inform ongoing optimisation, and ensure all products deliver exceptional experiences for both content creators and audiences. Maintain accurate documentation and reporting, while championing user‑centric design, continuous improvement, and scalable digital product ecosystems across the FIFA Communications Division.
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • 7+ years of digital product management experience, with at least 3 years in a senior or lead role
  • Proven track record delivering large-scale digital products (web, mobile apps, platforms)
  • Experience working with global, cross-functional teams
  • Strong understanding of Agile and modern product development practices
  • Proven Experience in working with headless CMS 
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent professional experience
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Data-driven mindset with experience using analytics tools and experimentation
  • Experience working in football, sports, media or entertainment industry
  • Background in managing content platforms
  • Proven record of successful deliveries of various complexities within global and multi-cultural organisations
  • Solid technical background with understanding or hands-on experience in implementation
  • Experience in requirements gathering for applications and subsequent translation of requirements in user stories 
  • Excellent English skills, including writing, communication, and presentation
  • An outstanding team spirit with an entrepreneurial mindset that thrives when being challenged
  • Ability to foster long-term relationships with key professionals
  • Attention to detail
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.

Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
  • Health and fitness: Regular football sessions for all abilities, plus on-site gym.
  • Home office: Up to two days of home office per week if work permits and home office allowance for all.
  • Language courses: Offered to all staff to aid personal and professional growth.
  • Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
  • Pension: Flexible pension benefits with generous employer contributions.
  • Relocation assistance: A dedicated team will be on hand to support your relocation.
  • Sustainability: We support all employees using public transport.
  • Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.
  • Volunteering: Make an impact beyond your regular role and bond with colleagues by volunteering with one of our partners.

job.title: Venue Technology Manager (Salvador)
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Venue Technology Manager is responsible for supporting the Technology team with venue specific technology related deliverables for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 TM (FWWC 2027) within Brazil. The role entails coordinating with all relevant parties the planning, implementation, readiness and operations of all Event Technology services pertinent to the tournament and / or associated events within Brazil.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Responsible to ensure all aspects of Technology, Telecommunications and Broadcast Technology Services are implemented in accordance with the pre-agreed FIFA Technology requirements at the assigned venue(s)
  • Manage a strong diverse Venue Technology team composed of paid staff, contractors and volunteers for operating the technology services at the assigned venue(s) 
  • Collaborate with stakeholders’ groups, clients, providers, and government entities in relation to ensuring the delivery of technology services across all venues, in accordance with the defined governance structure
  • Manage and contribute to the venue technology working groups in accordance with the agreed governance structure across all aspects of the tournament programme (planning, implementation, readiness and operations) 
  • Manage the technology demand / needs requirements for technology services across the tournament space (Technology Equipment Allocation Process) 
  • Plan the delivery of suitable end user technology equipment and services to all FWWC 2027 departments and FIFA constituent groups, including hardware, services and consumables 
  • Facilitate the collection and distribution of technology requirements of all client groups involved in the FWWC 2027 across all client groups, including, Media, Broadcast, Commercial, Football Technology etc. 
  • Ensure that all information pertaining to infrastructure, services and spaces needed for the delivery and support of all technology services are communicated to, and understood by, venue/site authorities and respective delivery teams 
  • Provide guidance and direction to relevant teams on matters relating to the structural build-out and technology services implementation, including the commissioning and final decommissioning of tournament venues  
  • In collaboration with assigned personnel and Stadium partners, relevant parties (private and governmental) enable / support the timely delivery of venue technology services. 
  • Identify and report on the progress of all critical dependencies in accordance with the reporting methodologies. 
  • Manage the asset tracking and management of deployed technology equipment 
  • Track the progress of structural build-out and IT implementation leading up to the timely availability of components and services and including the commissioning and final decommissioning of the venues. 
  • Develop regular progress, risk and issue management reports in accordance with the governance structure / reporting methodologies and, or PMO systems 
  •  Follow-up with various stakeholders, providers, and government entities in relation to ensuring delivery of technology services / dependencies as per agreed requirements, service levels etc. 
  • Support and ensure the team adhere to the IT Service management protocols 
  • Ensure positive attitude from the Venue Technology teams and good relationship with all the parties, including FIFA teams, Local FIFA Subsidiary (LFS) areas/projects, end-users, suppliers, Host Country/ City counterparts
  • Manage the on-site IT Technicians and support teams during tournament time operations, including end-of-day reporting and incident escalation to Technology Command Centre. 
Education
  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field
Experience
  • Overall IT experience and in a similar role
  • Experience in the Sports / major event industry is a must
  • Proven track record of successful delivery of complex IT programs and projects
Skills & Competencies
  • Manager with proven track record in similar projects
  • Good knowledge of venue technology services across major sporting events 
  • Have up to date knowledge and project management expertise in all event related technologies, including, all types of technology business solutions, community access TV (CATV), radio communications, wired communication, printing, broadcast contribution network, spectrum, audio and visual. 
  • Ability to always maintain a professional demeanor. Consistently interacts professionally and works productively with all levels of employee. 
  • Excellent cross group collaboration skills and demonstrated ability to lead virtual teams across groups, conflict management and driving consensus to deliver on program milestones  
  • Good Leadership skills and able to manage and motivate other team members 
  • Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills
  • Ability to adapt speech to audience coming from a broad spectrum of disciplines and with various levels of technical knowledge
  • Leadership and accountability across all areas of relevance  
  • Strong political acumen and adaptable to a wide range of working environments
Certifications & Requirements
  • Right to work in Brazil 
  • Fluent in English
  • Native or Fluent in Portuguese
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset
Location: Salvador (BA) - Brazil

job.title: Team Lead Ticketing Inventory Management & Operations
job.html_description:
As the organiser of some of the biggest and most iconic sport events in the world, we lead the way in the sport and event industry.

Join the team and support us on our mission.
These are your key tasks:
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team responsible for ticket inventory management, seating map configuration, and ticketing operations.
  • Oversee the creation, maintenance, and optimization of ticket inventories, quotas, category structures, seating maps, and ticket flow configurations within the ticketing system.
  • Manage seat allocation and seat assignment processes, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery.
  • Plan and deliver onsite ticketing operations at FIFA events, including ticketing infrastructure and electronic access control solutions.
  • Lead and coordinate onsite ticketing teams, including managers, supervisors, volunteers, and external service providers.
  • Develop, implement, and continuously enhance operational policies, procedures, and governance frameworks.
  • Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders and FIFA ticketing teams in host countries to ensure consistent and efficient delivery.
  • Conduct venue inspections, stadium readiness assessments, and seat validation activities to maintain inventory accuracy and operational excellence.
  • Identify and drive opportunities to improve operational efficiency, enhance service quality, and maximize revenue potential.
  • Support the planning and successful delivery of ticketing operations across FIFA tournaments and events worldwide.
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in ticketing operations, including onsite delivery at major international sporting events or other large-scale events.
  • Proven leadership experience with the ability to coach, motivate, and develop diverse, high-performing teams.
  • Strong expertise in ticket inventory and quota management, seating map configuration, and ticket flow management.
  • Experience managing event staff, contractors, volunteers, and external providers in a live event environment.
  • Strong operational mindset with excellent planning, organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment while managing multiple priorities and complex operational challenges.
  • Proactive, self-driven, flexible, and accountable, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of results.
  • Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with experience working in international and multicultural environments.
  • Fluent in English; additional French and/or Spanish language skills are a strong advantage.
  • Proficient in MS Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
  • Willingness to travel extensively
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.

Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
  • Health and fitness: Regular football sessions for all abilities, plus on-site gym.
  • Home office: Up to two days of home office per week if work permits and home office allowance for all.
  • Language courses: Offered to all staff to aid personal and professional growth.
  • Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
  • Pension: Flexible pension benefits with generous employer contributions.
  • Relocation assistance: A dedicated team will be on hand to support your relocation.
  • Sustainability: We support all employees using public transport.
  • Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.
  • Volunteering: Make an impact beyond your regular role and bond with colleagues by volunteering with one of our partners.

job.title: Ticketing CRM QA/UAT Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Ticketing Customer Relationship Senior Manager, the Ticketing CRM Sales Channels Manager will support Ticketing and Hospitality efforts for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™. 

This role will be responsible for develop and implement QA/UAT strategies, user acceptance tests for all ticket sales, distribution and communication channels.  

Ticketing CRM Sales Channels Manager must ensure compliance with the applicable sales strategy and the FIFA ticketing requirements. Ticketing CRM Sales Channels Manager focuses particularly on the delivery of user acceptance tests to ensure an efficient ticketing operation for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. 

Key Responsibilities 
   
  • Review and understand business requirements, functional specifications, and technical documentation related to the sales channels. 
 
  • Produce and implement test scripts, from a customer relationship perspective, to verify compliance of the systems with the ticket sales strategy and requirements. 

 

  • Develop and implement Quality Assurance and User Acceptance Test strategies, collaborate with stakeholders to define QA/UAT objectives, methodologies, and best practices; 

 

  • Plan and implement processes for the delivery of user acceptance tests for all ticket sales, distribution and communication channels, in pre-production and production environments, including but not limited to: online ticketing portals, mobile ticketing apps, back-office ticketing systems, bespoke CRM and Marketing Automation tools, general and single sign-on integration; 

 

  • Set the desired outcomes within test scripts, select and communicate with test participants and define testing and reporting timelines; 

 

  • Liaise with internal and external stakeholders for the communication of UAT results and management of fixes and change requests; 

 

  • Use issue tracking system to report on UAT results, support and change requests; 

 

  • Pro-actively identify and report on patterns and risks; 

 

  • Identify opportunities to improve development and testing processes to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and overall quality. 

 

  • Plan and implement quality control procedures to ensure that any deviation from the requirements is detected and corrected as soon as possible and that any system deviation from the requirements is detected as soon as possible, at all times during the ticketing process; 

 

  • Drive the implementation of test automation frameworks and tools to streamline testing processes and improve efficiency. Evaluate automation opportunities and prioritise test cases for automation to maximise productivity. 

 

  • Actively research and implement solutions to pro-actively increase the productivity of the sales channels team; 

SKILLS FRAMEWORK  
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyse one’s behaviour, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes. 
 
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculate risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.    
 
INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts. 
 
INITIATIVE: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents.  
  
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans. 
 
EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS 
 
Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent in relevant areas.      
 
WORK EXPERIENCE 
 
  • 3-5 years’ experience in: Quality Assurance and User Acceptance Test strategies 
  • Planning and delivery of a similar project 
  • Leading and managing small teams 
  • Delivery of user acceptance tests 
  • Experience in ticketing system 
  • Customer Service  
  • Excellent communication and relationship management 
  • Good numeracy 
  • Courtesy and Cooperation 
  • Accountability and Transparency 
  • Analysis and Innovation 
  • Flexibility and Adaptability 
  • Perseverance and Dedication 
  • Proactivity and Organisation 
  • Time Management and Prioritisation 
 
LANGUAGES 
 
Fluent in English and Portuguese, spoken and written. 
Spanish and/or additional languages is highly advantageous. 
 
TECHNOLOGY 
 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools 
  • CRM software for case management, including automatic and manual management of the cases 
  • JIRA 
  • Confluence 
 
Certifications & Requirements 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Right to work in Brazil
