ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyse one’s behaviour, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes.
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculate risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.
INCLUSIVITY:Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts.
INITIATIVE: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.
INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.
LEADERSHIP:Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents.
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans.
EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent in relevant areas.
WORK EXPERIENCE
- 3-5 years’ experience in: Quality Assurance and User Acceptance Test strategies - Planning and delivery of a similar project - Leading and managing small teams - Delivery of user acceptance tests - Experience in ticketing system - Customer Service - Excellent communication and relationship management - Good numeracy - Courtesy and Cooperation - Accountability and Transparency - Analysis and Innovation - Flexibility and Adaptability - Perseverance and Dedication - Proactivity and Organisation - Time Management and Prioritisation
LANGUAGES
Fluent in English and Portuguese, spoken and written.
Spanish and/or additional languages is highly advantageous.
TECHNOLOGY
- Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools - CRM software for case management, including automatic and manual management of the cases - JIRA - Confluence
Certifications & Requirements
- Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro - Right to work in Brazil

job.title: Senior Legal Counsel Commercial Legal
job.html_description:
We govern the beautiful game and ensure it's run with transparency and integrity.

Join our team in Miami and support us on our mission.
The Senior Counsel will be an active member of the Commercial Legal Team working in a “team first” approach to support the delivery of legal services relating to FIFA’s global operations.

The role of Senior Legal Counsel will support as follows:
  • Reporting to the Commercial Legal team leads
  • Assist in supporting on legal matters relating to FIFA’s Innovation and Technology operations
  • Provide legal support in the following areas:
    • FIFA’s direct to consumer media offerings, (including distribution and syndication and advertising sales)
    • hardware and software procurement
    • the collection of match data
    • ensuring appropriate ownership, protection and exploitation of FIFA-proprietary technology developments and collaborations
    • website and other consumer-facing T&Cs in the digital environment
    • FIFA’s data and artificial intelligence initiatives
    • FIFA’s innovation portfolios (including VR/XR and AI related matters)
  • General commercial legal support to FIFA’s strategic and corporate development activities
  • Support as point of contact for legal matters for FIFA’s Football, Technology and Innovation Department
  • Providing strategic liaison with FIFA’s Data Protection department to ensure seamless integration into FIFA digital products
  • Providing detailed knowledge of FIFA’s rights and obligations in connection with its digital and technology programmes, including the implementation and protection thereof; including the provision of legal and contractual input on FIFA’s existing commercial commitments and future commercial possibilities
  • Providing commercial transactional support and guidance regarding the interpretation of relevant commercial agreements, including the assessment of relevant business and strategic risks, and commercial regulatory matters
  • Developing and maintaining suitable template agreements
  • Support in the delivery of ad hoc advice on issues relating to technology related activities
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

This role would suit someone with great organisational and communication skills who is a dedicated team player and excels in being professional with excellent legal skills.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • Ability to participate and be part of a high-performing team, fostering collaboration, driving results, and ensuring the successful achievement of organizational goals
  • First class written and spoken English language skills, consistent with drafting and negotiating complex, high value and nuanced English language agreements
  • Ability to provide and communicate effectively practical and solutions-based legal advice
  • Excellent understanding of the digital and technology industry landscapes
  • Excellent negotiation, drafting, problem solving and analytical skills
  • Structured, reliable, well-organised with a strong eye for detail
  • Proactive, with a strong sense of personal responsibility with an ability to work autonomously on a wide variety of projects
  • Resilient with an ability to competently handle a large workload amid rapidly shifting priorities
  • Open-minded team player with an affinity for working within a variety of cultures and excellent communication skills
  • High degree of professionalism and confident demeanour
  • Ability to be a good ambassador for FIFA in all manner of external facing situations, including during contractual negotiations, external workshops and during FIFA competition-related assignments
  • Ability to create, develop and maintain strong and reliable relationships with FIFA senior management as well as external legal and commercial counterparts
  • Willingness to operate outside of comfort zone
  • Takes initiative to reflect on how to improve and develop working styles and methods to assist the organisation and internal clients
  • Juris Doctor (JD) degree from a top-tier accredited law school
  • Active bar membership is required
  • Minimum of 7 years expertise "on the job" in the industry in an in-house legal department or a top-tier law firm focusing on relevant matters
  • Native level English (or equivalent), consistent with requirement to draft and negotiate complex and nuanced English language agreements and advice
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (French/Spanish) is an asset but not necessary
  • Proficient in Word / PowerPoint / Excel
  • Comfortable with international travel
  • Readiness for stand-by duties and special projects
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.
 
Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
 
Health insurance: We offer generous medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage.
Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
Retirement: We offer generous 401(k) employer contributions.
Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.

job.title: Ticketing Training Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Ticketing Training Coordinator plays a key role in the preparation of all required training programmes for the Ticketing department prior to, and during, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. Reporting organizationally to the Senior Ticketing Operations Manager, the successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring tournament time Ticketing Workforce are effectively prepared to deliver in their role. 

The Ticketing Training Coordinator will be required to lead activities related to learning needs analysis, training design, training delivery, logistical planning and reporting.

Training is expected to be delivered across a variety of mediums including – e-learning, face to face, self study and additional knowledge base resources.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The key responsibilities and oversights of the Ticketing Training Coordinator include:   
  • Develop, design, and or adapt existing e-learning content using Rapid Authoring Tool(s) such as Adobe Captivate or similar. 
  • Collaborate with Ticketing Operations experts to gather information and ensure the accuracy of training modules. 
  • Support other Ticketing teams in their training planning in relation to the e-learning tool. 
  • Support Ticketing Operations teams in designing and delivering face to face training content and supporting resources. 
  • Integrate and manage e-learning content within the Learning Management System (LMS). 
  • Ensure all e-learning modules are accessible and user-friendly for a diverse audience. 
  • Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of training programs through assessments and feedback. 
  • Provide technical support and troubleshooting for e-learning modules and LMS issues.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of all training materials and development processes. 
  • Coordinate with the IT department to ensure seamless operation of e-learning platforms. 
  • Ensure compliance with organizational standards and industry regulations in all training content. 
  • Conduct regular reviews and updates of e-learning content to maintain relevance and effectiveness. 
  • Stay updated with the latest trends and best practices in e-learning and instructional design. 
  • Support general ticketing operations for other FIFA events as required.
Education/ Experience 
  • Bachelor degree or similar level of education  
  • 1-3 years of professional experience 
  • Experience in training design and delivery
  • Experience in delivering e-learning as a training solution and managing LMS systems 
  • Highly accurate and detail-oriented working style, technology minded, efficient and accountable team player 
  • Native-level fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English; proficiency in additional languages is valued 
 Skills & Competencies 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Sharepoint, Teams) and online collaboration tools 
  • Proficient in e-learning Rapid Authoring Tools
  • Knowledge and understanding of Learning Management Systems (LMS)
  • Able to think creatively and ‘outside of the box’ to deliver solutions in a fast-faced- environment 
  • Ability to work independently, managing multiple priorities 
  • Skilled in facilitating collaboration between various business areas 
  • Ability to adapt to working with different environment and time zones 
Certifications & Requirements 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Availability to work extended hours during test events and tournament time
  • Experience working in international, multicultural environments preferred

job.title: IPTV & CATV Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Senior Telecom Manager, the CATV/IPTV Manager will be a key member of the FWWC27 Technology team, and work in close collaboration with the Technology teams based in Brazil and Zurich and other key individuals responsible for delivering the CATV and IPTV solutions required for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Manage the CATV/IPTV service planning, delivery, and operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. The service includes:
    o   CATV and IPTV systems in Stadia and IBCC
    o   Streaming to various platforms
    o   VOD services 
    o   TVs in all FWWC27 Venues
  • Organize procurement of CATV/IPTV services, manage the selected supplier
  • Review Legacy and Overlay CATV/IPTV design documentation and ensure it meets FIFA requirements.
  • Actively participate in the scope and R&R definition, liaison with different stakeholders, including Host Broadcaster, Stadia, CATV/IPTV suppliers etc.
  • Lead the CATV/IPTV infrastructure design, implementation and integration, ensuring it meets FIFA Standards and requirements
  • Overseeing the effective and efficient usage of Legacy Network services. 
  • Ensure the Project scope, timelines and budget are respected by all the stakeholders. Track the progress of CATV/IPTV Infrastructure implementation, report status, issues and risks related to Infrastructure projects and operations, according to Technology governance and keep counterparts aligned  
  • Liaise with and / or support other projects in clarifying requirements, adhering to robust change management protocol.  Deliver technical guidance, coaching & mentoring to team members, including preparation of good practice and educational material for personnel

Education
  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering or related field
Experience
  • Strong experience in CATV/IPTV
  • Experience in the Sports / major event industry
  • Proven track record of successful delivery of complex CATV/IPTV Infrastructure Projects
  • Experience in Management of distributed international team of telecom experts and professional
Skills & Competencies
  • Manager with experience in similar projects
  • Good knowledge of venue technology services across major sporting events 
  • Strong IT skills and relevant knowledge in CATV/IPTV/Streaming Services, including infrastructure design, implementation, integration and connectivity. 
  • Should have broad understanding of CATV/IPTV, Streaming and Broadcast Infrastructure and Information Technologies in Sport Events and sufficient experience in design, commissioning and operation of following protocols/technologies: H.264/H.265 encoding, Multicast, SRT, RTMP, DVB, fiber convertors, etc.
  • Ability to always maintain a professional demeanour. Consistently interacts professionally and works productively with all levels of employee 
  • Excellent cross group collaboration skills and demonstrated ability to lead virtual teams across groups, conflict management and driving consensus to deliver on program milestones  
  • Good Leadership skills and able to manage and motivate other team members 
  • Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills
  • Ability to adapt speech to audience coming from a broad spectrum of disciplines and with various levels of technical knowledge
  • Leadership and accountability across all areas of relevance  
  • Strong political acumen and adaptable to a wide range of working environments
Certifications & Requirements
  •  Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset
  • Willing to travel within Brazil (up to 30%), with some trips with a long duration (15 days or more)
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Access Management Systems & Applications Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Reporting to the Access Management Senior Manager, the Access Management Systems & Applications Manager will be a key member of the FIFA WOMEN´S WORLD CUP 2027 Access Management team. You will be responsible for developing and managing a range of tools to assist in the planning and delivery of access operations of the FWWC2027 at all stadiums and the IBCC.  Such tools will include:


•             Access Management System (AMS).


Working closely with the Access Management Senior Manager, FIFA Corporate Access Manager and IT, help develop the AMS in its functionalities, reporting systems and set up. 


The Access Management Systems & Applications Manager will manage 1 Coordinator, whose primary function will be to support the Manager. Together you will train and provide support to the venue team in each Host City as well as deal with the system provider, Fortress.   


The Access Management Systems & Applications Manager will be an active member of the Access Management (ACS) HQ team throughout the planning phases and the tournament period.

The main responsibilities and oversights of the Access Management Systems & Applications Manager for the FIFA WOMEN´S WORLD CUP 2027 include: 

•             Help develop the AMS. 
•             Setup the AMS for the Tournament 
•             Provide training and training materials on the system to ACS, ACR and SEC staff.
•             Be the central focal point for issue resolution on the AMS system. 
•             Oversee the distribution and collection of the AMS physical devices. 
•             Provide central support as part of ACS Main HQ team during the tournament.
Education:
·        Bachelor’s degree or similar level of higher education in IT & Systems, Sport Venue Management, Safety and Security or similar. 
·        Qualifications or extensive experience in access management systems. 
·        If experience is compensating, lower degree is welcome to apply.
·        Qualifications in IT systems.
·        FIFA access management knowledge is a plus. 
·        Effective interpersonal communication, influencing and negotiation skills.
·        Strong problem solving and analytical skills.
·        Stature and professional experience necessary to interact as tough partner with senior colleagues.
·        Good judgement, superb integrity, maturity, and fairness in dealing with people.

 Experience:

·        Minimum experience of 4 years in the sport event industry, with access management systems, ticketing systems or similar for large scale events.
·        Experience in delivering training.  
·        Single-sport, multi-venue event experience.
·        Management and leadership of a team in high pressure tournament operations. 
·        Demonstratable ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and under pressure

 
Skills & Competencies:
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyze one’s behavior, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes.
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculated risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.
INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts.
INITIATIVE: Capacity to do things on one’s own initiative and to influence the course of events, assume responsibilities, and achieve objectives with a minimum of supervision and control.
INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.
LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents.
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans.

Certifications & Requirements

·        Access Management Systems, Ticketing Systems. 
·        Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools

Requirements
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: CHARGÉ(E) DES RESSOURCES HUMAINES - Fédération Sénégalaise de Football
job.html_description:
Dans le cadre du développement et du renforcement de ses activités, la Fédération Sénégalaise de Football souhaite renforcer son organisation par le recrutement d’un(e) Chargé(e) des Ressources Humaines.

Le/la Chargé(e) des Ressources Humaines intervient principalement dans l’accompagnement des recrutements, ainsi que dans le suivi administratif des salariés et la gestion de la paie, en veillant au respect des procédures internes et des obligations sociales en vigueur.
Accompagnement au recrutement
  • Participer à l’identification des besoins en recrutement ;
  • Rédiger et diffuser les offres d’emploi ;
  • Réceptionner et effectuer un premier tri des candidatures ;
  • Participer à l’organisation et au suivi des entretiens ;
  • Assurer le suivi administratif des recrutements et des dossiers des nouveaux collaborateurs ;
  • Participer à l’intégration administrative des nouveaux salariés.

Gestion administrative et paie​
  • Préparer et suivre les éléments variables nécessaires à l’établissement de la paie ;
  • Collecter et contrôler les informations relatives aux salaires, absences, congés et autres éléments de rémunération ;
  • Participer au suivi des déclarations et cotisations sociales ;
  • Assurer le suivi administratif des dossiers auprès de la CNSS, de l’IPRES et de l’IPM ;
  • Participer au suivi des affiliations, déclarations et prestations liées à la couverture sociale et médicale des salariés ;
  • Veiller à la mise à jour des dossiers individuels du personnel ;
  • Assurer le suivi des contrats de travail et des documents administratifs liés aux salariés ;
  • Répondre aux demandes courantes des collaborateurs relatives à leur paie et à leur situation administrative

Suivi RH
  • Tenir à jour les tableaux de suivi RH et les données relatives au personnel ;
  • Assurer le classement et l’archivage des documents administratifs ;
  • Répondre aux demandes courantes des collaborateurs concernant leurs dossiers administratifs et leur paie ;
  • Apporter un appui aux différents sujets RH selon les besoins de la Fédération.
  • Formation supérieure en Ressources Humaines, Gestion, Administration du personnel ou domaine similaire ;
  • Une première expérience en gestion administrative RH, paie ou recrutement serait appréciée ;
  • Bonne connaissance des principes de gestion de la paie et des obligations sociales au Sénégal ;
  • Bonne maîtrise des outils bureautiques, notamment Excel ;
  • Organisation, rigueur et discrétion ;
  • Bon relationnel et sens du service ;
  • Capacité à travailler avec méthode et à respecter les délais ;
  • Une connaissance du fonctionnement de l’IPRES, des IPM et de la CSS constitue un atout.

job.title: Non-Competition Venue Dressing Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Dressing and Signage Manager for non-competition venues reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing and Signage Manager for non-competition venues is responsible for leading the venue branding, look and signage operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all non-competition FIFA Official Sites. 

This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™, ensuring that the look and feel is up to FIFA quality standards.  
Non-competition venues are crucial to the successful delivery of a successful FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™, the below list is a non-exhaustive list of venues that the successful candidate may be responsible for: 
  • Team Base Camp Training Sites 
  • Team Base Camp Hotels 
  • VIP Hotels 
  • Accreditation Centres 
  • Ticketing Centres 
  • Volunteer Centres 
  • Airports 
  • International Broadcast Centre (IBC) 
  • Outside Presentation Facility (OPF) 
  • Main Operations Centre (MOC) 
The successful candidate will be responsible for directly overseeing the dressing and signage planning and implementation at all FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ non-competition venues Brazil. They will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met within their cluster and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations within their cluster, ensuring that all are managed successfully and efficiently while monitoring budgetary spend within agreed limits. They will ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. The role will collaborate closely with the wider Dressing and Signage team to maximise creativity and ensure consistency across all non-competition venues. 
There will also be a potential need to relocate to another Host City for up to three months to take the role as Venue Dressing and Signage Managers during event periods at an assigned stadium. 

Key Responsibilities 
  • Contributing to the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups who require the services of non-competition venues at the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™. 
  • Overseeing the turnkey planning and delivery of non-competition venue dressing and signage across the tournament.  
  • Collaborating with the other Venue Dressing and Signage Managers and ensuring that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament official sites.  
  • Working closely with the Stadium Dressing Managers and the Wayfinding and Signage Managers as well as other Functional Area Managers, to maximise efficiencies across the wider project.  
  • Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all non-competition venues. 
  • Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of dressing and signage operations and reporting updates into the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly. 
  • Providing strategic input into the non-competition venue dressing planning process and offering expertise when required.  
  • Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department.  
  • Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimised at all stages of the project.  
  • Liaising with non-competition owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans.  
  • Presenting to senior team members, management and other FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional areas as and when required.  
  • Attending department-specific and organisation site visits at assigned stadiums and other stadiums or official sites.  
  • Inputting into the site-specific dressing and wayfinding signage strategies utilising expertise from previous events and directives from management.  
  • Acting as the non-competition venues point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers during the implementation phase of the project.  
  • Participating in the creative design process for the non-competition venues.  
  • Assisting with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required.  
  • Ensuring the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against.  
  • Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities.  
  • Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods.
  • Strong experience in delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. or a minimum 4 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities.  
  • A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.) 
  • Budget management experience on complex and multi-faceted events and projects.  
  • Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events. 
  • Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events. 
  • Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments.  
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions. 
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field. 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. 
  • The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential. 
  • The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on-site attendance during the tournament period. 
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Bilingual – Brazilian Portuguese and English. 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

- Strong experience in delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. or a minimum 4 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities. - A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.) - Budget management experience on complex and multi-faceted events and projects. - Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events. - Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events. - Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments. - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions. - Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field. - Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. - The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential. - The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on-site attendance during the tournament period. - Right to work in Brazil. - Bilingual – Brazilian Portuguese and English. - Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Ticketing CRM Communication Channels Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Ticketing CRM Communication Channels Manager, the Ticketing CRM Communications Channels Coordinator will support Ticketing and Hospitality efforts for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™. 


This role will be responsible for updating and managing text content, such as (but not limited to) FAQs, standard responses, and chatbot scripts, within our back-office tools.  Ticketing Communication Channels Specialist must ensure compliance with the applicable sales strategy and the FIFA ticketing requirements.  


The Ticketing Communication Channels Specialist focuses particularly on ensuring content accuracy, effectiveness, and alignment with sales communication strategies for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.    


  • Maintain and update text-based content, including FAQs, chatbot scripts, and other sales communication materials, within back-office systems. 
 
  • Ensure all content is accurate, up-to-date, and aligned with company messaging and brand guidelines. 
 
  • Regularly review and update content based on CRM sub-teams feedback and business needs. 
 
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales strategy and requirements, sales collaterals and communications, and customer care teams, to gather requirements concerning the content to be updated and respective timeline. 
 
  • Work closely with subject matter experts to ensure content accuracy and relevance. 
 
  • Coordinate content review and approval processes to ensure timely updates and deployments. 
 
  • Support the configuration and testing of FAQs, chatbot and other communication channels within back-office tools, flagging optimization opportunities to the relevant owners. 
 
  • Ensure that the communication channels accurately respond to user queries and provide relevant information or assistance. 
 
  • Monitor communication channel performance metrics and flag optimisation opportunities to improve user experience and engagement. 
 
  • Support training sessions for internal teams on using back-office tools and accessing sales communication content. 
 
  • Share observations and feedback on FAQs, chatbot and other communication channel performance to support best-practice recommendations for sales effectiveness. 
 
  • Conduct regular quality assurance checks on content and functionalities to identify and resolve content-level issues or errors. 
 
  • Identify and escalate technical issues related to the communication channels, collaborating with IT teams to support the implementation of solutions. 
 
  • Any other duties that may be assigned. 
SKILLS FRAMEWORK  
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyse one’s behaviour, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes. 
 
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculate risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.    
 
INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts. 
 
INITIATIVE: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents.  
  
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans. 
 
EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS 
 
Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent in relevant areas.      
 
WORK EXPERIENCE 
 
  • 1-3 years’ experience in managing and updating content for various platforms 
  • Familiar with digital marketing tools and analytics platforms 
  • Familiar with HTML, CSS, and basic web development 
  • Experience in planning and delivery of a similar project 
  • Experience in Customer Service  
  • Excellent communication and relationship management 
  • Team player with excellent interpersonal skills 
  • Ability to work with cross-functional teams 
  • Courtesy and Cooperation 
  • Accountability and Transparency 
  • Analysis and Innovation 
  • Flexibility and Adaptability 
  • Perseverance and Dedication 
  • Proactivity and Organisation 
  • Time Management and Prioritisation 
LANGUAGES 
 
Fluent in English and Portuguese, spoken and written. 
Spanish and/or additional languages is highly advantageous. 
 
TECHNOLOGY 
 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and online collaboration tools  
  • CRM software for case management, including automatic and manual management of the cases  
  • Chatbot  
  • FAQs portals  
  • JIRA  
  • Confluence  
  • Ticketing systems 
Certifications & Requirements 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Right to work in Brazil

job.title: Workforce Planning & Operations Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Working alongside the FIFA Workforce Management team based in Zurich and reporting to the FIFA27 Head of Workforce, the Manager, Workforce Planning & Operations is responsible for executing all workforce planning phases and processes, ensures the organisation has the right talent in the right roles at the right time.

Workforce Strategy & Planning
• Assist with the implementation of workforce planning and operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027)
• Support the coordination of workforce planning activities across all workforce types (paid staff, freelancers, tournament-time hires, secondees, etc.)
• Work with the Workforce Management team to help align workforce plans with operational requirements
• Provide administrative support in maintaining workforce categories and entitlements data
• Maintain and regularly update the centralised headcount tracker, ensuring accuracy of data
• Support change management activities by tracking updates and communicating changes to relevant stakeholders
• Assist in collecting and preparing inputs for workforce budgets, timelines, and planning activities

Workforce Operations & Management
• Support the delivery of operational workforce plans during tournament time, including assisting with site operations
• Help gather and document requirements for workforce spaces, equipment, and operational needs on site
• Support the documentation and maintenance of workforce policies, procedures, and operational guidelines
• Assist in mapping and documenting workforce planning and operational processes
• Provide administrative and coordination support for workforce systems and tools
• Support the delivery of workforce training sessions, including preparation of materials and logistics
• Assist with scheduling and coordination of workforce operations teams, including staff and volunteers
• Provide on-the-ground operational support to venue managers during event delivery
• Help communicate workforce processes and procedures to ensure consistency
• Track workforce service levels and support reporting on entitlements and delivery

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement
• Liaise with cross-functional teams (e.g., Accommodation, Travel, Transport) to support workforce needs
• Maintain regular communication with functional areas to gather and update operational requirements
• Provide coordination support between workforce teams, HR, and other stakeholders

  • Work Experience
    • Ideally experience with exposure to workforce planning, operations, events, or a related field
    • Basic to intermediate understanding of workforce planning systems, tools, and processes
    • Experience supporting or assisting with operational teams, preferably in event or venue environments
    • General understanding of data and its use in workforce planning and decision-making
    • Ability to organise tasks, manage priorities, and work with guidance in a structured environment
    • Experience collaborating with team members and contributing to a positive team environment
    • Good communication skills, both written and verbal
    • Demonstrated adaptability and willingness to support problem-solving and coordination activities
    • Experience working in or interacting with multicultural and/or multinational environments is an advantage
    • Fluent in English, both written and spoken
    • Portuguese language skills (basic to advanced) are an advantage

  • Technology
    • Proficient in MS Office tools (Word, PowerPoint, Visio & advanced Excel) 
    • Proficiency in using project planning tools such as WeTrack and Monday.com
    • Experience with workforce system implementations advantageous

job.title: Warehouse & Distribution Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
 This role will be responsible for delivering Warehouse & Distribution Logistics operations to support a number of stadiums/venues, ensuring a seamless and efficient delivery of services throughout the tournament.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Act as the lead Logistics representative for FIFA functions and external stakeholders for Warehouse Logistics operations.
  • Develop and implement the Warehouse strategy to align with Logistics service levels and ensure cost effective storage solution for FWWC27.
  • Lead the overall planning, implementation, operational process across all Warehouse Logistics operations to achieve a seamless supply chain solution.
  • Produce standard operating procedures, workflow charts and communication strategies for Distribution operations.
  • In collaboration with the Venue Logistics, Materials and Warehouse work streams, coordinate all move orders (from warehouses to venues, venue-to-venue and venue to warehouse.) Remain in constant communication with Venue Logistics to ensure the needs of the venue and functional areas are being met in a timely manner. 
  • In conjunction with Security personnel, ensure a secure delivery corridor of goods to and from venues. 
  • Determine delivery methods to minimize redundant costs and training requirements. 
  • Control the load schedules, supervise drivers, set project goals, evaluate and manage employee performance. 
  • Initialize driver training, including hands-on driver trainings and route testing.  
  • In conjunction with Transportation, oversee the establishment of tournament delivery routes inclusive of venue-to-venue routes, and delivery drive times and other metrics involving routes to venues. 
  • Education: Engineering, Administration, Economics, International relations or other related areas
  • Experience: Strong experience in warehouse, distribution and/or logistics operations, including transport planning and supply chain coordination; strong experience in customs and freight in Brazil.
  • Skills & Competencies:
    • Collaborative mindset, adaptable and willing to work to tight and changing timelines.
    • Proficient in analytical thinking and data skills.
    • Demonstrates positive attitude, patience, persistence, and determination.
    • Experience working in a multi-cultural, multi-national environment.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Consolidation manager
job.html_description:
As the organiser of some of the biggest and most iconic sport events in the world, we lead the way in the sport and event industry.

Join the team and support us on our mission.
These are your key tasks:
  •  Preparing FIFA’s annual consolidated financial statement including balance sheet, profit and loss, cash flow statement and notes in accordance with the International Financial Reporting Standards
  • Preparing a monthly consolidated financial reporting and quarterly financial forecast to allow management to make decisions in a timely manner and for the purpose of planning, analysis and benchmarking
  • Supporting IFRS-related projects and complex accounting transactions, and corresponding financial audit questions of FIFA’s consolidated financial statement
  • Preparing financial analyses, reconciliations, and management reports to support strategic decision-making and ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial information.
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • Minimum 4 years experiences in an organisation within the finance consolidation/reporting department or a finance consultancy/audit company
  • Proven records in consolidation and IFRS, ideally within a multicultural organisation or IFRS desk review experience within an international audit company
  • University degree in business administration and a higher education within Finance & Accounting, preferably with experience as Certified Public Accountant (CPA) 
  • Pragmatic/solution oriented
  • Team-oriented
  • Self-motivated
  • Critical judgement
  • Discreet/ honest
  • Integral business understanding
  • Innovative, efficient and very communicative 
  • Strong identification with FIFA’s ideals and philosophy
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.

Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
  • Health and fitness: Regular football sessions for all abilities, plus on-site gym.
  • Home office: Up to two days of home office per week if work permits and home office allowance for all.
  • Language courses: Offered to all staff to aid personal and professional growth.
  • Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
  • Pension: Flexible pension benefits with generous employer contributions.
  • Relocation assistance: A dedicated team will be on hand to support your relocation.
  • Sustainability: We support all employees using public transport.
  • Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.
  • Volunteering: Make an impact beyond your regular role and bond with colleagues by volunteering with one of our partners.

job.title: Ticketing Commercial Partners & Local Market Customer Relations Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Ticketing Customer Relationship Senior Manager, the Ticketing Commercial Partners & Local Entities Customer Care Manager will help serve Ticketing and Hospitality efforts for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. This role will be responsible for planning and management of the customer care strategies and processes for Group Sales Customers to specifically fulfil all FIFA’s Commercial Partners and Local Entities ticketing requirements and ensure a smooth and successful ticketing operation for these key FIFA stakeholders.  

The Customer Care Manager must ensure compliance with the applicable sales strategy and the FIFA ticketing requirements, policies and regulations whilst providing support to all FIFA’s Commercial Partners with ticketing issues and enquiries. Focuses particularly on the delivery of effective ticketing customer care for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.   


  • Plan and implement effective customer care strategies and processes across all the established communications channels (email, phone and any other ticketing bespoke systems);    
 
  • Perform user acceptance tests for ticket sales, distribution and communication channels in pre-production and production, concentrating on mobile ticketing processes to ensure effective customer care and management of Commercial Partners and Local Entities’ requirements    
 
  • Train and manage a small team, in line with the sales strategy and FIFA ticketing requirements, policies and regulations; including regular quality assurance checks;  
 
  • Perform customer care ticketing processes (back office and onsite) whenever required;   
  
  • Build, manage and maintain successful relationships with all FIFA Commercial Partners and Local Entities (Partners, Sponsors, Licensees, Host Cities, etc.) whilst resolving all issues and enquiries;     
 
  • Manage and monitor the ticket quota and requests allocated to FIFA Commercial Partners and Local Entities;      
 
  • Issue all necessary ticketing communications and be able to translate into required languages, where applicable;   
 
  • Present ticketing information and deliver training to Commercial Partners and Local Entities, and other stakeholders both in person and online; 
 
  • Plan effective communication and escalation processes and ensure implementation within the team;   
 
  • Plan and implement quality control procedures to ensure that any deviation from the ticketing requirements and system requirements is detected and corrected as soon as possible;   
 
  • Actively research and implement solutions to pro-actively increase the productivity of the group sales customer care team, and maximize customer information and satisfaction;   
 
  • Analyse and report regularly on KPIs and the effectiveness of customer care being delivered 
 
  • Pro-actively identify and report on patterns and risks, and implement processes to mitigate them; 
 
  • Ensure that all customer care processes are in compliance with the different FIFA functional areas requirements, including but not limited to Legal, Sustainability, Data Protection, Finance, etc.; 
 
  • Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to ensure the relevant customer care information is available and share applicable knowledge; 
 
  • Ensure an efficient administration and archive of all versions of customer care and knowledge base, in all languages; 
 
  • Report on the implementation of sales strategy and ticketing requirements; plus results of testing of ticket sales, distribution and communication channels including mobile ticketing;
 
  • Ensure adherence to specific operational deadlines and project plans and compliance with ticketing policies, regulations and GDPR.
SKILLS FRAMEWORK  
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyse one’s behaviour, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes. 
 
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculate risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.    
 
INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts. 
 
INITIATIVE: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents.  
  
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans. 
 
EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS 
 
Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent in relevant areas.      
 
WORK EXPERIENCE 
 
  • Planning and delivery of a similar project during a previous FIFA World Cup; 
  • Planning and delivery of Customer Care for corporate customers/business stakeholders; 
  • Leading and managing small teams; 
  • Delivery of user acceptance tests; 
  • Ticketing; 
  • Venue and onsite operations experience for major sports event, including a previous FIFA World Cup; 
  • Customer Service;   
  • Excellent communication and relationship management;  
  • Good numeracy;  
  • Courtesy and Cooperation;  
  • Accountability and Transparency;

job.title: Cybersecurity Manager
job.html_description:
As the organiser of some of the biggest and most iconic sport events in the world, we lead the way in the sport and event industry.

Join the team and support us on our mission.
These are your key tasks:
  • Design, build, test, implement and coordinate operation of security systems within the FIFA environment. 
  • Support FIFA Product Managers, as well as other FIFA functions to ensure FIFA’s new and existing digital products comply with cybersecurity standards and guidelines. 
  • Lead vulnerability & patch management, coordinate penetration tests, third party risk management and plan concrete action to remediate the findings. 
  • Provide security architecture expertise and consulting/advisory to support business and IT solutions in designing and implementing secure solutions. 
  • Review AI based solutions, concepts, and processes.
  • Review current security measures, recommend enhancements, identify areas of weakness, and respond promptly to possible security breaches.
  • Lead coordination of Cloud Security standards and compliance monitoring as well as the remediation plan.
  • Coordinate regular system tests and ensure the continuous monitoring of information security.
  • Execute the Cybersecurity Programme as defined in the Roadmap. 
  • Actively participate to investigations on Cybersecurity incidents. 
  • Support incident response and crisis preparedness (incl. simulations and technical exercises).
  • Plan, execute and deliver on time, on scope and within budget on projects directly assigned to her/him.
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • Proven track record in crafting comprehensive security policies and procedures, guiding technology teams through secure and continuous deployment practices.
  • Familiar with compliance initiatives and security frameworks such as NIST, ISO, GDPR, PCI DSS and FedRAMP.
  • Experience in securing Cloud Technologies and in Secure Development Lifecycle Experience with professional execution of cyber security projects as a project manager as well as excellent and step-by-step communication.
  • Client oriented, efficient and effective. 
  • Ability to conform to shifting priorities, demands and timelines Excellent planning, documentation and organizational skills Self-disciplined and self-starter and able to work independently.
  • At ease at working in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field.
  • Professional certifications in the area of cybersecurity (CISSP, CISM, CISA) would be an advantage.
  • 5-7 years of experience in a similar role.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience in: vulnerability scanning and auditing tools; enterprise-scale cloud, network, firewall, endpoint detection and response architectures and products.
  • Broad understanding of Firewalls and Network Security (Palo Alto, Fortigate etc.).
  • Broad understanding of mail security practices (DMARC, DKIM, SPF etc.). 
  • Broad understanding of in cloud security principles and frameworks.
  • Broad understanding of log management and aggregation (SIEM).
  • Broad understanding of cybersecurity incident management.
  • Fluent in English; Proficiency in any other FIFA language (F / ES / GER) is an asset.
  • Willingness to travel to specific events.
  • Readiness for stand-by duties during specific events.
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.

Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
  • Health and fitness: Regular football sessions for all abilities, plus on-site gym.
  • Home office: Up to two days of home office per week if work permits and home office allowance for all.
  • Language courses: Offered to all staff to aid personal and professional growth.
  • Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
  • Pension: Flexible pension benefits with generous employer contributions.
  • Relocation assistance: A dedicated team will be on hand to support your relocation.
  • Sustainability: We support all employees using public transport.
  • Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.
  • Volunteering: Make an impact beyond your regular role and bond with colleagues by volunteering with one of our partners.

job.title: CHEF(FE) DU DÉPARTEMENT DES SYSTÈMES D’INFORMATION ET DE LA TRANSFORMATION NUMÉRIQUE - Fédération Sénégalaise de Football
job.html_description:
Dans le cadre de la modernisation de son administration, de l’amélioration de sa performance et du développement de nouveaux services numériques, la FSF poursuit la transformation de ses systèmes d’information et de ses processus.

Dans cette dynamique, la FSF recrute un(e) Chef(fe) du Département des Systèmes d’Information et de la Transformation Numérique, chargé(e) de définir et de mettre en œuvre la stratégie informatique et numérique de la Fédération, tout en accompagnant les différentes directions et départements dans leur transformation digitale.
Définition et pilotage de la stratégie SI et numérique
  • Élaborer la stratégie des systèmes d’information et de la transformation numérique de la FSF.
  • Définir une feuille de route pluriannuelle en matière de technologies, de digitalisation et d’innovation.
  • Traduire les orientations stratégiques de la Fédération en projets et solutions numériques concrets.
  • Identifier les besoins des directions et départements et proposer des solutions adaptées.
  • Assurer la cohérence et l’évolution de l’architecture globale du système d’information.
  • Mettre en place une gouvernance permettant de prioriser les projets et investissements numériques.
  • Assurer une veille sur les évolutions technologiques et leurs applications potentielles au secteur sportif.

Pilotage des systèmes d’information
  • Superviser la gestion et l’évolution des infrastructures informatiques, réseaux, serveurs, équipements et services numériques.
  • Garantir la disponibilité, la performance et la continuité des systèmes d’information.
  • Définir et faire appliquer les standards et procédures informatiques.
  • Superviser la gestion des comptes, accès, habilitations et droits utilisateurs.
  • Assurer la maintenance et l’évolution des infrastructures technologiques.
  • Mettre en place des indicateurs de performance des systèmes d’information.

Cybersécurité et protection des données
  • Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique de cybersécurité de la FSF.
  • Identifier et anticiper les risques liés aux systèmes d’information.
  • Mettre en place des dispositifs de prévention, de détection et de gestion des incidents de sécurité.
  • Garantir la sauvegarde, la disponibilité et la protection des données.
  • Superviser les dispositifs de continuité et de reprise d’activité informatique.
  • Sensibiliser les collaborateurs aux bonnes pratiques de sécurité numérique.
  • Veiller au respect des règles et réglementations applicables en matière de protection des données.

Transformation numérique des processus
  • Identifier les processus administratifs et métiers pouvant être digitalisés, automatisés ou optimisés.
  • Piloter la dématérialisation des processus internes.
  • Accompagner les directions et départements dans l’adoption de nouveaux outils numériques.
  • Développer une culture digitale au sein de l’administration de la FSF.
  • Identifier les opportunités offertes par l’intelligence artificielle, l’automatisation, la data et les nouvelles technologies.
  • Mesurer l’impact et la performance des initiatives de transformation numérique.

Pilotage des projets digitaux et développement numérique
  • Superviser le portefeuille des projets numériques de la Fédération.
  • Définir les objectifs, périmètres, budgets, ressources, délais et indicateurs de chaque projet.
  • Superviser la conception, le développement, l’intégration et le déploiement des solutions numériques.
  • Garantir l’interopérabilité des différentes plateformes et applications.
  • Superviser le développement et l’évolution des sites web, applications, plateformes et outils digitaux de la FSF.
  • Veiller à l’expérience utilisateur et à l’adéquation des solutions avec les besoins des utilisateurs.
  • Assurer le suivi des projets jusqu’à leur déploiement et leur évaluation.

Data et aide à la décision
  • Développer une approche structurée de la gestion et de la valorisation des données de la Fédération.
  • Contribuer à la mise en place d’une gouvernance des données.
  • Favoriser la centralisation, la fiabilisation et la sécurisation des données.
  • Développer des outils de reporting et de tableaux de bord permettant d’améliorer la prise de décision.
  • Identifier les opportunités liées à la data et à l’analyse prédictive dans le développement du football.

Management et coordination
  • Encadrer et coordonner les deux services du département.
  • Définir les objectifs, plans d’action et indicateurs de performance des équipes.
  • Assurer l’évaluation et le développement des compétences des collaborateurs.
  • Favoriser la collaboration entre les équipes SI, les directions métiers et les différents départements de la FSF.
  • Assurer la coordination avec les prestataires, intégrateurs, fournisseurs et partenaires technologiques.
  • Promouvoir une culture de l’innovation, de la performance et de l’amélioration continue.

Gestion des ressources et des partenaires
  • Élaborer et suivre le budget du département.
  • Évaluer les besoins en équipements, logiciels, infrastructures et prestations.
  • Participer aux processus de sélection et d’évaluation des fournisseurs et prestataires IT.
  • Négocier ou contribuer à la négociation des contrats technologiques.
  • Veiller à la qualité des prestations fournies et au respect des engagements contractuels.
  • Optimiser les investissements et coûts liés aux systèmes d’information.
Formation
  • Diplôme de niveau Bac+5 en informatique, systèmes d’information, ingénierie informatique, transformation digitale, cybersécurité ou domaine équivalent.
  • Une formation complémentaire en management, gestion de projet ou stratégie digitale constitue un atout.

Expérience professionnelle
  • Minimum 7 ans d’expérience professionnelle dans le domaine des systèmes d’information, du digital ou des technologies.
  • Expérience significative dans le management d’équipes et le pilotage de projets SI ou numériques.
  • Expérience avérée dans la conduite de projets de transformation digitale.
  • Une expérience dans une organisation institutionnelle, sportive, multisites ou de taille significative constitue un atout.

job.title: Ticketing Sales & Strategy Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Ticketing Sales Strategy Manager, the Ticketing Sales & Strategy Coordinator will help serve Ticketing and Hospitality efforts for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™. This role will assist the planning and the definition of the process relative to the creation of all the customer's communications and collaterals across the ticket sales process, under the applicable sales strategy and ticketing requirements, and work closely with all the other sub-teams or Functional Areas.  

The Data Engineer Specialist designs data pipelines and reports to analyze customer behavior using KPI dashboards and ensure data quality. They collaborate cross-functionally to gather and implement requirements for reports that enable the CRM team to monitor the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™ project. 
  •  Design, develop, and maintain efficient data pipelines to support the Sales Strategy team in setting up various reports for monitoring project evolution, including the ingestion, processing, and transformation of large volumes of data from various sources.  
  •  Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Sales Strategy, Sales Collaterals and Communications, and Customer Care, to gather requirements and timelines, and translate them into technical solutions.   
  •  Define and track KPI dashboards with the Sales Strategy team to continuously review and report on customer behaviors, ensuring a comprehensive understanding of the information.  
  •  Liaise with internal and external stakeholders or providers to obtain the necessary data for building required reports.  
  •  Ensure the quality and availability of data, performing data profiling, cleansing, and validation processes.
 SKILLS FRAMEWORK  
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyse one’s behaviour, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes. 
 
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculated risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.    
 
INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts. 
 
INITIATIVE: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents.  
  
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans. 
 
EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS 
 
Bachelor's or master's degree or equivalent in a relevant area such as Digital Marketing, Communications, or similar.    
 
WORK EXPERIENCE 
 
Minimum three years of experience creating and managing content for ticketing processes/solutions for events, ideally in the sports industry.   
 
Using content management and Marketing Automation Tools within large-scale projects, ideally inside ticketing and/or sports events, that require strong communication and organizational skills.   
 
Managing projects related to content creation and/or coordinating translations that require attention to the details, ensuring accuracy and consistency.  
 
Venue and onsite operations experience for large-scale events, ideally in the sports industry is nice to have.   
Communication and problem-solving skills.    
 
Translations experience to translate digital content and documents from English to Portuguese and vice-versa would be an advantage. 
 
LANGUAGES 
 
Fluent in English and Portuguese, spoken and written.   
 
A native level of at least one of the following: French, Spanish, German or Arabic is nice to have. 
 
TECHNOLOGY 
 
Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools  
 
Marketing Automation Tools and Content management platforms.   
 
Experience with Ticketing Systems is nice to have 


Certifications & Requirements 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Right to work in Brazil

job.title: Venue Safety & Security Manager – 8 Host Cities (Brazil)
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Venue Safety & Security Manager (VSSM) is responsible for the operational planning and delivery of safety and security across all official non-competition sites within their designated host city or host city cluster for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. This includes team base camps, training sites, official hotels, transport hubs and other designated locations, including off-city sites requiring travel. Reporting to the Manager, Non-Competition Sites, the VSSM provides senior-level operational leadership and acts as the primary safety and security liaison at host city level. The role ensures compliance with FIFA regulations, local statutory requirements and tournament operational plans, while maintaining structured coordination with public security authorities, site authorities and private security suppliers. The VSSM must demonstrate senior standing and credibility, particularly in engagements with law enforcement and public security agencies.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Plan and deliver safety and security operations across all designated non-competition sites within the assigned host city (venue) or cluster.
  • Ensure implementation of the Safety & Security Strategy, Operational Plan, site operating plans and all relevant tournament planning documents as relevant to each venue and site
  • Conduct just-in-time planning activities including deployment planning, supplier site induction, readiness planning, training and briefings
  • Develop, review and update dot plans, deployment plans, rosters and standing instructions for private security suppliers
  • Review and update site-specific risk assessments and ensure mitigation measures are implemented
  • Manage operational delivery through appointed private security supplier(s) and other allocated workforce groups
  • Establish and maintain effective working relationships with local government authorities, police, law enforcement agencies and other public security partners
  • Act as the principal liaison for public security authorities in the host city for non-competition sites
  • Coordinate secure team and referee movements between official sites and stadiums in collaboration with public security partners
  • Liaise and cooperate with site authorities, hotel management, training site operators and transport stakeholders
  • Liaise and cooperate with FIFA Safety & Security Officers (FSSOs), Team Security and Referee Security Liaison Officers (TSLOs/RSLOs) deployed in the host city
  • Attend and contribute to planning meetings, joint exercises and inter-agency coordination sessions
  • Conduct site inspections to ensure compliance with planning, overlay requirements and security standards
  • Escalate safety and security issues to the Manager, Non-Competition Sites and ensure appropriate follow-up and corrective action
  • Ensure all safety and security staff under supervision are fully briefed on site-specific procedures and tournament regulations
  • Provide daily reporting to tournament HQ during operational periods
  • Attend debriefs and submit written reports and operational assessments as directed
  • Manage time flexibly and ensure attendance at official site activities involving teams, including travel to off-city base camps as required
  • Attend planning meetings, training sessions, exercises and debriefs as directed
Education
  • Higher education in security management, public safety, risk management or a related field
  • Relevant professional qualifications or licensing required by local or state legislation
Experience
  • Strong experience managing safety and security operations in major events, public security or comparable environments
  • Strong background in law enforcement, public security authority or senior private security leadership
  • Demonstrated experience liaising with public authorities and multi-agency partners
  • Experience managing operational security delivery across multiple sites
  • Experience managing staffing budgets and supplier performance
  • High level of spoken and written English

Skills & Competencies
  • Senior-level stakeholder engagement and negotiation skills
  • Strong operational leadership and decision-making capability
  • Ability to build credibility with public security authorities
  • Structured planning and risk assessment capability
  • High level of integrity and professional conduct
  • Ability to operate independently across dispersed geographic areas
  • Calm and decisive under pressure
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese
  • Strong IT literacy 

Certifications & Requirements
  • Willingness to travel nationally and work extended hours during tournament periods
  • Valid driving licence (mandatory)
  • Ability to obtain and maintain required security clearances (if required)
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Academy Driver (Part-Time)
job.plain_text_description:
The Academy Driver is responsible for providing a safe, reliable and professional driving service across. the Academy. Reporting to the Head of Academy Operations, the role includes, management of part-time drivers (exclusively Academy), and to work alongside the Club Driver & Fleet Compliance Manager ensuring all vehicles are maintained and presented to a professional standard. The Academy Driver delivers a consistent, reliable service to ensure safe transport of Academy players, staff and guests.
This will be a part-time (20-hour) role, with hours split across a 7-day week.
Responsibilities
- Provide transport for identified registered players to and from our Motspur Park training site. - Provide transport for trialist players to and from airports, train stations, accommodation, and club activities. - Support the player induction process when identifying players in need of transport support. - Act as a guide for visits to Motspur Park and Craven Cottage. - Assist the club on 1st team match days for corporate driving requirement. - Support the Academy across key events and wider activities. - Promote the work of Fulham Academy amongst the London football community. - Always represent Fulham Football Club to a high standard in line with club values.
Requirements
- Hold a full clean driving licence - Interact with others in a positive manner - Strong understanding of the local area - Positive ability to work within a diverse organisation - Self-starter who takes pride in the delivery of a professional service - Bi-Lingual (Desired) - D1 driving licence (Desired)

job.title: Academy Kit Assistant
job.html_description:
The Academy Kit Assistant supports the smooth day-to-day running of the Academy by preparing, maintaining, and distributing training and match kit for players and staff. 

This role is 20hrs per week.

Responsibilities

Essential and Desirable
  • Organised and reliable.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Positive team player with a flexible approach to working evenings and weekends.
  • Full Driving License
  • Able to work in a fast-paced football environment while maintaining high professional standards.

Requirements

The following is a non-exhaustive list of the responsibilities of the role:  
 
  • Prepare and distribute training and match kit.
  • Ensure all kit and equipment is clean, organised, and ready for use.
  • Assist with stock control, kit issuing, and inventory management.
  • Support academy training sessions, fixtures, and tournaments as required.
  • Maintain high standards within the kit room and storage areas.
  • Work closely with academy staff to meet operational needs.
