job.title: Director, Video Production
job.location: 1350 NW 55 Street, Fort Lauderdale, FL, 33309, US
job.html_description:
Description

Inter Miami CF is seeking a Director of Video Production, who will lead a team of shooter/editors, manage their workload, interface with multiple departments across the Club, solicit feedback and manage expectations during the creative process. The individual in this role must be an experienced videographer as well as manager of people, who can prioritize multiple projects at once and understands the professional sports landscape and the type of content it requires. We are seeking an excellent visual storyteller who has a fresh and edgy creative style. 


 

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Lead, manage, and mentor a team of videographers of varying levels and skillsets.
  • Lead full-cycle video productions including capture and editing of all Club video needs, such as: Matchday coverage,
  • Digital/Social pieces, In-stadium videoboard pieces, corporate partnership fulfillment, and ticket sales video needs
  • Collaborate with all in-house departments, external agencies, and corporate partners on video projects
  • Take video briefs from start to finish (brainstorming, planning, production, post-production, delivery).
  • Manage & organize video archives for all footage (Media Asset Management)
  • Elevate our visual storytelling in alignment with the Club’s brand guidelines and marketing initiatives
  • Manage lighting and audio setups for interviews and other shoots.
  • Maintain, organize and catalogue club-owned video & lighting equipment
  • Maintain strong relationships with outside vendors and continue to grow production vendor database
  • All other related duties as assigned.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree with 7-10 years of relevant experience in a similar position.
  • Experience managing a team of direct reports
  • Experience with a professional sports team is a plus.
  • Deep knowledge of cinema cameras and lenses (Sony systems).
  •  Advanced use of Adobe Creative Cloud (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Audition) required.
  • Experience in producing short-form and long-form videos required.
  • Lighting and set design production knowledge
  • Exceptional creative abilities; looking to push the envelope and develop and implement fresh ideas.
  • Understanding of brand awareness.
  •  Superior organization, project management skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast paced, team environment.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to effectively communicate, both written and verbally.
  • Self-starter with the ability to multi-task and meet deadlines with minimal supervision.
  •  Exceptional knowledge and passion for the sport and culture of fu´tbol preferred.
  • Physical ability to lift heavy equipment is required.
  • Flexibility to travel domestically and internationally and work nights and weekends as required.
  • Applicant must provide a link to reel or previous work in order to be considered.

 

Compensation: 

  • Inter Miami CF offers a competitive compensation package, medical, dental, vision, disability insurance, life insurance and 401k retirement plan.

Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.


All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check. 


Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law

job.title: Guest Services Representative
job.html_description:
Description

RESUME REQUIRED FOR CONSIDERATION


As a member of Inter Miami’s Guest Services team, you will provide unique fan experiences while promoting a welcoming environment during all events hosted at our new home, Nu Stadium. Our focus is to ensure all fans have a safe and memorable experience by offering world-class customer service. We strive to make everyone feel welcome. As part of our guest services team, you will support us in ensuring every guest experiences the highest level of service and engagement at our venue. 


This is your opportunity to make a mark on matchdays, celebrate culture, and inspire fans across the globe. We are looking for highly enthusiastic and dedicated individuals to provide an exceptional service experience for all guests that visit our venues. This position will encompass the following roles: Ticket Taker, Usher, Premium Area Hosts, Gate Host, & Response Team. 


Essential Duties & Responsibilities 

  • Maintain a positive mindset and strong people skills. 
  • Work well with others and function in a team atmosphere. 
  • Be customer-focused, proactive, and an empathetic problem solver 
  • Resolve guest complaints and conflicts in a timely and effective manner. 
  • Demonstrate a guest-service-oriented disposition and professional appearance. 
  • Attention to detail, adaptability, and the ability to resolve high-pressure situations.  
  • Ability to perform tasks in a stationary position for extended periods of time. 
  • Maintaining a presentable, clean, and safe environment for all guest-facing areas. 
  • Exhibit excellent communication, customer service, and conflict resolution skills 
  • Retain an extensive knowledge of Miami Freedom Park, policies, ticketing procedures, and emergency procedures. 
  • Additional related duties as assigned 

Position Summary 

This is a PART – TIME position with work hours based on the event scheduled at Miami Freedom Park and Chase Stadium. 

  • Location - Primarily at Miami Freedom Park (Miami), with occasional availability at IMCF Stadium (Fort Lauderdale)  
  • Average hours per shift: 5 to 6 hours per shift 
  • Average events per month – 2 to 4 (Subject to event schedule) 
  • Event Season - The event season typically runs from February through November.  

 

Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.


Pre-Employment Requirements  

All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check. 


Equal Opportunity Statement  

Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law

Requirements

  • Must be able to work evenings and required to work weekends 
  • Must work ALL Inter Miami CF Home Matches 
  • Minimum high school diploma or equivalent. 
  • Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish. 
  • Previous sports experience preferred but not required. 
  • Positive attitude and strong customer service and interpersonal skills. 
  • All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check.

job.title: Account Executive, Membership Sales
job.html_description:
Description

  

The Account Executive is responsible for generating new business by selling Inter Miami ticket inventory. It includes the selling of all specified seating categories through cold-calling, face-to-face appointments, and networking with a focus on business-to-business relationships.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Prospect, establish, research, and close sales leads through cold-calling, appointments, and networking.
  • Meet or exceed weekly/monthly sales and prospecting goals.
  • Work closely with Ticket Operations and Member Services departments to achieve sales/prospecting goals.
  • Maintain a high level of customer service.
  • Participate in various sales, team, and community events as assigned.
  • Represent the organization at various networking events.
  • Active role in the Inter Miami game day experience.
  • Maintain accurate records in support of sales efforts as defined by the organization.
  • All other responsibilities as required.

Requirements

  • Minimum 1-2 years of sales experience in professional or collegiate sports (or related industry) is preferred.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills required. Bilingual skills a plus.
  • Exceptional reliability, interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills required.
  • Exhibit good judgment and maintain a positive attitude.
  • Ability to work non-traditional hours, in non-traditional settings, within a team atmosphere.
  • Strong interest in soccer and sports is a plus.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) is preferred.
  • Knowledge of ticketing CRM (Salesforce and Archtics is preferred).
  • Experience in the Florida marketplace preferred but not necessary.

 

Compensation: Inter Miami CF offers a competitive compensation package, medical, dental, vision, disability insurance, life insurance and 401k retirement plan.


Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.


All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check. 


Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law

job.title: Sr. Coordinator, Digital
job.location: 1350 NW 55 Street, Fort Lauderdale, FL, 33309, US
job.html_description:
Description

 

The Senior Digital Coordinator will play a pivotal role in enhancing the club’s digital presence and will work closely with all departments to develop and execute digital strategies that drive fan engagement, increase brand awareness, and support the club's overall objectives. This role requires a passion for sports, exceptional communication skills, and a strong understanding of digital and social.  


Essential Duties & Responsibilities: 

  • Assist with all current and future digital platforms for Inter Miami , Inter Miami II, Academy, Foundation and Stadium channels including Instagram, Twitter, Facebook, TikTok, Snapchat, Youtube, Threads. 
  • Assist with content creation, scheduling, and posting across social profiles.  
  • Matchday coverage for all Inter Miami CF matches (home and away, travel to 30%+ of away games) 
  • Create digital content at training/games/events (e.g., Instagram Stories, App video, TikTok) while working closely with players to capture content on a daily basis 
  • Oversee and operate the influencer program.  
  • Monitor and identify key social trends to bring to life on club channels  
  • Serve as mentor/supervisor to Coordinators  
  • Execute digital strategy and assist with planning to execution. 
  • Work with all departments to plan digital calendar for in-season and off-season for all current and future digital platforms  
  • Ideate/execute engaging digital media that drives value to our platforms and partners. 
  • Support Club revenue streams by increasing sponsorship inventory 
  • All other duties as required. 


Requirements

  •  Must be able to produce quality photo and video with a mobile device. 
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, digital media, journalism, communications or a related field preferred. 
  • A highly organized self-starter. 
  • Creative, and ambitious to build a world-class club and industry leading digital media organization. 
  • Strong passion and understanding of fútbol and fútbol culture. 
  • Strong writing and editing skills, with the proven ability to write for social media. 
  • Familiarity with digital trends and technology, sports and popular culture. 
  • An ‘ideas’ person who is able to work extremely well within a team to come up with creative solutions and identify new opportunities, often in a high-pressure, fast-changing environment. 
  • Experience in juggling a number of work-intensive projects simultaneously, ability to meet and perform under tight deadlines and to think clearly under pressure. 
  • Willingness to take initiative, own responsibilities, and raise standard of excellence. 
  • Possess exceptional interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills and strong attention to detail. 
  • Project management skills: prioritization, planning, problem solving, expectation setting and delivering on commitments to teammates and management. 
  • Experience working with Adobe Creative Suite is a plus. 
  • Strong PC skills (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint). 
  • Familiarity with analytics tools (Google Analytics, Web Trends, Omniture, etc.) and interpreting data. 
  •  Must be available to regularly commute and work on-site at both Miami Freedom Park and Inter Miami CF Stadium, as business needs require. 
  • Flexibility to travel and work nights and weekends as required. 
  • Ability to attend all home match-days (including weekends) 

 

Compensation & Benefits 

Inter Miami CF offers a competitive compensation package, including medical, dental, vision, disability insurance, life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan. 


Pre-Employment Requirements 

All applicants must successfully pass a pre-employment background check. 


Equal Opportunity Statement 

Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Groundskeeper (Inter Miami Training Facility)
job.location: 1350 NW 55 Street, Fort Lauderdale, FL, 33309, US
job.html_description:
Description

Inter Miami CF is looking for a passionate and dedicated Groundskeeper to join our Turf & Grounds team. In this full-time role, you’ll play a vital part in maintaining world-class playing surfaces and facilities that meet the highest professional standards. Working alongside the Director of Turf & Grounds, you’ll help ensure our players, fans, and guests experience excellence—right from the ground up. 


Essential Duties & Responsibilities: 

  • Assist with all turf management aspects including mowing, edging, chemical/fertilizer application, aerification, irrigation, pest management, etc.
  • Assist in equipment and irrigation repair and maintenance.
  • Assist with administrative duties such as correspondence, filing and research.
  • Execute other projects as assigned.


Requirements

  • Bachelor's or associate's Degree in a turf management-related field is preferred.
  • Ability or willingness to learn how to operate necessary equipment to complete required tasks.
  • Availability for home matches and other events throughout the season (primarily evenings and weekends).
  • Interest and experience in competitive sports is preferred.
  • Must possess strong organizational skills and high attention to detail.
  • Must possess a strong work ethic and good demeanor.

Physical Demands:

  • Ability to lift 50 pounds of weight frequently throughout the assigned workday.
  • Ability to work in various degrees of outdoor weather conditions, including but not limited to extreme heat or rain.
  • Ability to work in various positions, including but not limited to, stooping, standing, bending over, sitting, kneeling, and squatting for extended periods of time.


Equal Opportunity Statement 

Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. 


Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.

job.title: Coordinator, Stadium Operations
job.html_description:
Description

The Coordinator, Stadium Operations supports the execution of all stadium operations functions at Nu Stadium in Miami, ensuring events are delivered efficiently and to a high standard. This role plays a key part in coordinating event setups and breakdowns, maintaining operational readiness, and supporting a seamless experience for all events.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, hands-on, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment, with the ability to support and guide part-time staff while maintaining strong operational standards.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Assist with the preparation, setup, and breakdown of equipment and materials for all events at Nu Stadium 
  • Maintain and track assigned inventory of event and operational equipment 
  • Support and help lead part-time stadium staff on both event and non-event days, including event conversions and operational tasks 
  • Serve as a setup lead for select events, ensuring timely and accurate execution 
  • Assist with general facility upkeep to maintain a clean, safe, and operational environment 
  • Support cross-functional teams as needed to ensure successful event delivery 
  • Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned

Requirements

  • Work flexible/varied hours as scheduled, including nights, weekends, overnights, and holidays. 
  • Bachelor's Degree in Sport Management/Administration or similar field.
  • Stadium/Event Operations experience is a plus.
  • Ability to interact with stakeholders professionally and confidently at all levels in the organization.
  • Must be a self-starter who is able to multi-task, be a quick learner, and be able to work in stressful environments independently and within the group.
  • Must possess strong organizational skills and high attention to detail.
  • Bilingual preferred (Spanish)

Physical Demands:

  • Must be able to move and/or lift to 50 pounds.
  • This position requires work inside and outside of the building and some exposure to adverse conditions.
  • Ability to work in various positions, including but not limited to, stooping, standing, bending over, sitting, kneeling, and squatting for extended periods of time. 

Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.

job.title: Manager, Fan Strategy & Experience
job.html_description:
Description

The Manager, Fan Strategy & Experience is responsible for leading engagement with Inter Miami CF’s core supporter community, “La Familia,” serving as a key connection point between the Club and its most passionate fans. This role oversees all aspects of supporter group coordination, including game day operations, ticketing, away match travel, and the overall matchday environment.


The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of the Club’s culture, a collaborative and team-oriented mindset, and exceptional organizational skills. This individual demonstrates a high level of ownership, a strong work ethic, and a deep appreciation for the sport and fan experience, with a focus on driving engagement and delivering a best-in-class experience for supporters.

 

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary point of contact between the club and its official supporter groups (La Familia), building strong relationships and ensuring alignment with club initiatives 
  • Oversee supporter group operations on game days, including pre-game, in-game, and post-game activities to ensure a safe and engaging environment 
  • Partner with Guest Services and Security to plan and manage the experience for visiting team supporters, including coordination with league representatives to ensure safety and compliance 
  • Coordinate with visiting teams to support traveling fans, including ticketing, designated seating areas, and overall event planning 
  • Support the growth and engagement of supporter groups by helping develop programs, benefits, and experiences that enhance membership value 
  • Manage ticketing needs for supporter groups and other key audiences, including season tickets, group sales, and single-game access, in collaboration with internal ticketing teams 
  • Work cross-functionally with Guest Services to enhance the overall fan experience at the stadium 
  • Partner with Community and Foundation teams to support and execute community-focused initiatives and events 
  • Assist the Ticketing team with fan engagement initiatives such as membership events, sales activations, and conducting stadium tours 
  • Collaborate with Marketing to develop and support fan-focused digital content and storytelling initiatives 
  • Partner with Event Presentation to elevate the in-stadium experience and fan engagement during matches 
  • Develop and lead outreach initiatives, including future street team programs, to expand the club’s presence in the community 
  • Support additional responsibilities and special projects as assigned

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in sports administration, sports marketing, hospitality, or a related field 
  • Strong understanding of MLS and international fútbol is a plus  
  • Bilingual proficiency, including Spanish, is a plus 
  • Very strong interpersonal and communication skills with a passion for the brand 
  • Ability to coordinate multiple tasks and creatively solve day-to-day challenges 
  • Extremely organized with high attention to detail 
  • Strong work ethic and ability to work collaboratively as part of a team with a results-driven mindset 
  • Strong organizational skills with proven experience managing multiple projects and timelines 
  • Knowledge of marketing, promotions, event planning, and game production 
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and Outlook 
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays

 Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.

job.title: Coordinator, Event Presentation
job.html_description:
Description

Inter Miami CF is seeking a Coordinator of Event Presentation who will be responsible for providing organizational support to the production control room and Director of Broadcast and Event Presentation. 


Essential Duties & Responsibilities: 

  • Assist in planning, outsourcing, and execution of Private Stadium Events like client parties or meetings, ceremonial Galas. Review all audio/video requests needed throughout the facility.
  • Oversee Control Room Content for Matchday with ingesting and testing of videoboard graphics. Follow-up with respective departments such as Partnerships, Marketing and others who run in-game content. 
  • Assist in rendering and loading LED Content for all stadium matches and events. 
  • Act as producer of home and away radio broadcast setup and execution, including remote coordination and transmission support 
  • Act as the primary liaison between the Venue and outside Production Companies and Broadcast Services
  • Communicate with Rights Holders to understand their contracted requirements, and work with internal departments to ensure all outside Broadcast Support and Rights Holders are accommodated 
  • Assist with MLS Next PRO match productions, with camera setups, sending A/V feeds, working control room equipment. 
  • Assist in the scheduling and management of the Control Room Matchday Staff. 
  • Act as Control Room Operator on equipment if and when needed. 
  • Clip video of any Presentations, Anthem performances, special requests, etc., from all matches and Stadium Events, and provide to respective personnel if / when available or requested. 
  • All other duties as assigned.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree with 1 – 2 years of relevant experience in a similar position. 
  • Experience with a professional sports team (a plus). 
  • Knowledge of Control Room equipment such as on-air graphics systems, replay systems (a plus).
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast paced, team environment. 
  • Lighting, set design, and A/V knowledge (a plus).
  • Understanding of brand awareness. 
  • Superior organization, project management skills and attention to detail. 
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to effectively communicate, both written and verbally. 
  • Self-starter with the ability to multi-task and meet deadlines with minimal supervision. 
  • Physical ability to lift heavy equipment is required.
  • Flexibility to work nights, weekends and holidays as required.


Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.

job.title: Director, Digital Marketing
job.location: 800 S Douglas Road, Coral Gables, FL, 33134, US
job.html_description:
Description

  

About Us: Miami is the future—a hyperglobal, yet local community fueled by intersection and interconnection. It stands at the gateway of the Americas and welcomes millions from around the world, creating an energy and culture unlike anywhere else on the planet. Some of us are born and raised here. Some of us came long ago and were embraced like family. And still, others have just arrived. But we all, at heart, share the same qualities: courage, tenacity, ambition, dedication to our community, and a passion for the joy of life. We fly in the face of conventional thinking and take pride in disrupting the status quo. We are here to change the game. 

Inter Miami CF will celebrate all that makes Miami extraordinary. We will be multilingual and omnicultural. We will harness the city’s great history and unmatched culture to create new traditions, rituals, and symbols that are admired around the world. We will bring world class futbol to this world class city, once and for all. Futbol that is as creative, exciting, unique, and multicultural as we are. Futbol that makes people everywhere wish they could be here. 


Libertas. Unitas. Fortuna. Freedom. Unity. Fortune. This is us. This is Miami.

Club Internacional de Fútbol Miami is the 25th Major League Soccer franchise and began play in 2020. For more information, please visit us at www.intermiamicf.com.


Position Summary:

We are seeking a dynamic and strategic Director of Digital Marketing to lead our club’s digital initiatives. The role is crucial in developing and executing a comprehensive digital strategy to drive digital growth, fan engagement, and revenue generation. The successful candidate will oversee multiple digital platforms, including the club's website and social media channels, manage the digital marketing budget, and collaborate with various departments to ensure cohesive and innovative digital solutions.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Create and execute a digital strategy aligned with the club's overall objectives.
  • Set clear goals for digital growth, fan engagement, and revenue generation.
  • Analyze market trends and audience behavior to inform strategy adjustments.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders such as Ticketing, Public Affairs, and Sales to align digital initiatives with club objectives.
  • Oversee the digital marketing budget, ensuring effective allocation of resources across various digital channels for maximum ROI.
  • Oversee the club’s official website to ensure it is user-friendly, up-to-date, and reflects the club's branding.
  • Manage and grow the club's presence on social media platforms including Instagram, TikTok, Twitter, and Facebook.
  • Develop strategies for content creation, community management, and fan engagement across platforms.
  • Plan and produce compelling digital content that aligns with the club's brand storytelling.
  • Work closely with the Director of Content, Creative, and Production teams to drive audience engagement.
  • Use data and creativity to build and maintain the club’s brand through impactful, relevant content for both the audience and partners.
  • Monitor and analyze key digital performance metrics such as website traffic, social media engagement, and the effectiveness of campaigns.
  • Interpret complex data to extract meaningful insights.
  • Provide regular reports and insights to the club’s leadership team, using data to guide strategic decisions and optimize digital marketing efforts.
  • Plan and manage digital advertising campaigns, including paid social media ads, search engine marketing (SEM), and display ads.
  • Ensure campaigns are optimized for maximum reach and ROI.
  • Use fan data to create personalized experiences and targeted marketing campaigns.
  • Implement strategies for collecting and analyzing fan data to increase engagement and loyalty.
  • Stay updated with the latest digital trends and technologies.
  • Implement innovative tools and platforms to enhance the club’s digital presence and improve the fan experience.
  • Oversee the development and optimization of the club’s mobile app and other digital tools to ensure they meet user needs and increase engagement.
  • Work closely with marketing, sales, ticketing, creative, and Comms teams to ensure digital strategies are integrated with broader club initiatives.
  • Collaborate with sponsors and partners on digital campaigns and activations that align with the club’s objectives.
  • Partner with Ticketing and Sales teams to create digital campaigns that promote ticket sales, special offers, and packages.
  • Leverage data to identify opportunities for driving online sales and ticketing promotions.
  • Work with the Sales department to integrate digital strategies that support ticketing promotions, Matchday packages, and merchandise sales across digital platforms.
  • All other duties as assigned.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Digital Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in marketing, with at least 5 years in sports marketing.
  • Proven experience managing marketing teams and working cross-functionally across departments.
  • In-depth knowledge of social media platforms, content marketing, SEO, CMS, email marketing, and digital advertising.
  • Proficiency in using data analytics to measure marketing effectiveness and optimize campaigns.
  • Ability to think strategically in developing Digital initiatives that resonate with diverse audiences.
  • Up-to-date with the latest trends and best practices in digital marketing and technology.
  • Exceptional communication skills in both English and Spanish.
  • Strong passion for soccer and an understanding of the MLS landscape.
  • Ability to work nontraditional hours in nontraditional settings, including holidays, nights, and weekends.
  • Willingness to travel 20% - 30% for Away games 

  

Equal Opportunity Statement

Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.


Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.
job.plain_text_description:
Description
About Us:Miami is the future—a hyperglobal, yet local community fueled by intersection and interconnection. It stands at the gateway of the Americas and welcomes millions from around the world, creating an energy and culture unlike anywhere else on the planet. Some of us are born and raised here. Some of us came long ago and were embraced like family. And still, others have just arrived. But we all, at heart, share the same qualities: courage, tenacity, ambition, dedication to our community, and a passion for the joy of life. We fly in the face of conventional thinking and take pride in disrupting the status quo. We are here to change the game.
Inter Miami CF will celebrate all that makes Miami extraordinary. We will be multilingual and omnicultural. We will harness the city’s great history and unmatched culture to create new traditions, rituals, and symbols that are admired around the world. We will bring world class futbol to this world class city, once and for all. Futbol that is as creative, exciting, unique, and multicultural as we are. Futbol that makes people everywhere wish they could be here.
Libertas. Unitas. Fortuna. Freedom. Unity. Fortune. This is us. This is Miami. Club Internacional de Fútbol Miami is the 25th Major League Soccer franchise and began play in 2020. For more information, please visit us at www.intermiamicf.com.

job.title: Manager, Partnership Activation
job.location: 800 S Douglas Road, Coral Gables, FL, 33134, US
job.html_description:
Description

The Manager, Partnership Activation, is responsible for managing all partner related activities including activation and execution of all contractually obligated sponsorship elements. This person will build strong relationships with current partners to aid in the renewal and retention of partners and work to continuously increase the level of service and support offered by the team to corporate partners.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities: 

  • Provide the highest level of service to all existing corporate partners.
  • Gather, plan and execute all contractual elements for each partner.
  • Conceptualize, develop, and map out programs that focus on achieving our partners goals.
  • Act as a sponsorship agency-like consultant internally and on behalf of clients.
  • Collect and maintain partner KPIs, ensuring a focus on partner objectives, tracking ROI and ROO, media and promotional valuations, results, measurements, etc.
  • Create an annual partner activation strategy plan for designated partner accounts to align with the commercial partnerships department and Inter Miami CF goals and objectives. This will include the development of big-idea creative activation programs and co-branded marketing opportunities.
  • Lead all upsell and renewal efforts for assigned corporate partners.
  • Develop strong, long-term relationships with clients. Learn and understand the nuances of the business of each of the organization’s partners and help them achieve marketing goals through the use of Inter Miami CF assets.
  • Plan and manage VIP hospitality events, unique experiences, and special events for partners.
  • Participate in cross functional department meetings and provide regular updates to leadership.
  • Route through the appropriate review and approvals processes all collateral material featuring the Club’s logo for correct usage, i.e., sponsor artwork, radio copy, public address script, videos, logos, print, web, and other relevant items.
  • Produce designated accounts partner recaps, assist in compiling all proof of performance and research data and lead assigned partner recap meetings..
  • Work all home games and assist with on-site partner activations.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • Minimum 3+ years of extensive and proven integrated marketing experience with demonstrated success in the media, sports partnerships, fulfillment or entertainment fields required.
  • Strong understanding of MLS and international fútbol a plus.
  • Fluency in Spanish a plus. 
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills are essential for interactions with clients, operational leaders and other senior executives.
  • Ability to coordinate multiple tasks and creatively solve day-to-day challenges.
  • Extremely organized with a high attention to detail.
  • Strong work ethic – must be a team player with a “get the job done” attitude.
  • Strong organizational skills with proven experience managing multiple projects and timelines.
  • Knowledge of marketing, promotions, event planning and game production preferred.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office applications, including Power Point, Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including but not limited to evenings, weekends and holidays.

job.title: Retail Sales Associate (Nu Stadium)
job.html_description:
Description

As a Retail Sales Associate, you’ll help fans show their pride and take home a piece of Inter Miami CF. Be part of the energy in our shops and pop-ups at Nu Stadium.


What You'll Do: 

  • Deliver a world-class fan experience in our stadium retail store,on game days only.
  • Engage and assist fans with enthusiasm, sharing your knowledge of the club and merchandise.
  • Operate point of sale systems efficiently to ensure smooth and accurate transactions.
  • Provide product information and communicate in-store promotions clearly.
  • Keep the store organized and visually appealing throughout the shift.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned to support store operations.

Requirements

  • Prior retail experience preferred.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Must be available to work during home matches, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
  • Ability to work approximately 6-to-8-hour shifts on Inter Miami CF match days.
  • Physical ability to lift, move, and organize inventory in both indoor and outdoor settings.
  • Dependable transportation required.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) candidates are a plus.
     

All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check.


Must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States. 


Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law

job.title: Senior Manager, Procurement
job.location: 800 S Douglas Road, Coral Gables, FL, 33134, US
job.html_description:
Description

About the Company: Inter Miami CF (IMCF or the Club) is a Major League Soccer club competing in the Eastern Conference, owned by Miami Beckham United and playing at its newly developed permanent stadium (Nu Stadium) at Miami Freedom Park, a 25,000-seat stadium within a 131-acre master-planned site featuring a 55-acre public park, structured parking, and over one million square feet of mixed-use retail, entertainment, commercial, and hospitality development. The Club operates a growing and complex business spanning professional sports, live events, stadium operations, retail, food and beverage, sponsorships, and media which is supported by a lean Finance and Accounting function responsible for accounting, financial planning and analysis, cash management, procurement, and investor relations across multiple legal entities.


Position Summary:

  

The Senior Manager, Procurement will be the Club's inaugural dedicated procurement leader, responsible for architecting, implementing, and enforcing the end-to-end source-to-pay (S2P) function across Miami Beckham United (MBU). This is a rare opportunity for a seasoned procurement professional to design a procurement operating model from the ground up in a high-growth, high-visibility organization entering its most consequential phase of commercial scale.


The Senior Manager, Procurement will be responsible for enabling cost containment, cost reduction, and cost control across all third-party spend at MBU. This role will design and enforce the Club's purchase order policy, approval authority matrices, vendor onboarding standards, payment governance, and compliance reporting. The Senior Manager, Procurement will operate as the enforcement arm of the Club's Cost Control Policy Framework, with explicit authority relating to non-compliant spend.

In addition to policy authorship and enforcement, this role will build the Club's vendor management infrastructure, including vendor master data integrity, competitive bidding programs (RFI/RFQ/RFP), recurring and periodic contract commercial reviews, insurance and tax compliance validation, and ongoing spend analytics for sustainable cost reduction. The Senior Manager, Procurement will drive the transition to an environment where essentially all spend flows through procedures where competitive sourcing, PO discipline, and vendor accountability are the operating standards.


The role initially covers all MBU operations, with scope expansion into Miami Freedom Park (MFP) contemplated as that business platform matures. The Senior Manager, Procurement will report directly to the MBU Chief Financial Officer, and unify source-to-pay execution under a single accountable owner and function.


The Senior Manager, Procurement will serve as a trusted operational partner across the organization, translating procurement discipline into measurable outcomes: quantified savings, improved control coverage, cleaner vendor data, and defensible spend governance visible to lenders, auditors, and ultimately the ownership group.


Key Responsibilities:


Procurement Policy and Enforcement

  • Author, publish, and enforce the Club's Cost Control Policy Framework, including purchase order requirements, approval authority matrices, vendor onboarding standards, and payment governance.
  • Exercise stop-work and stop-payment authority for any commitment or invoice that does not comply with established procurement policy, escalating exceptions to the Chief Financial Officer on a documented basis.
  • Serve as the Club's primary internal enforcement authority for third-party spend discipline, including formal partnership with cost center leaders on remediation of policy exceptions.
  • Design and administer training programs and materials for department leaders, budget owners, and approvers on procurement policy, personal accountability standards, and system workflows.
  • Establish and maintain the exceptions process, including documentation, review cadence, escalation protocol, and highly visible compliance reporting.

  

Strategic Sourcing and Cost Reduction

  • Design and lead all RFI, RFQ, and RFP activity for the Club, including scope definition, vendor identification, bid evaluation, and award recommendation for new and all existing vendor relationships
  • Build and execute a competitive re-bid program for legacy vendors who have never been formally sourced, prioritized by annual spend and strategic importance.
  • Develop category strategies for the Club's major spend categories, including retail merchandise (inventory), variable matchday operations (e.g., day of game / event), third-party outsourced professional services, marketing, and travel.
  • Identify, quantify, and deliver measurable cost savings through consolidation, competitive bidding, negotiated terms, business back, and category rationalization.
  • Oversee the Club’s corporate credit card, employee reimbursement, and capital expenditure policies and administration. 
  • Partner with department leads (i.e., cost centers) and Legal on commercial term negotiation for material third-party contracts.
  • Design regular enterprise tests to ensure effective control environment around spend.

  

Vendor Management and Master Data

  • Own the vendor master data file, including new vendor onboarding procedures, periodic re-validation, deactivation of dormant vendors, and duplicate vendor resolution.
  • Establish and enforce vendor onboarding standards including W-9 collection, banking verification, insurance and certificate of insurance validation, sanctions screening, and 1099 readiness.
  • Administer the Club's contract and renewal calendar, ensuring proactive engagement on renewals, expirations, and auto-renewal exposures.
  • Monitor vendor performance against contractual service levels and escalate non-performance to the appropriate business owner.

  

Purchase Order Governance

  • Design and administer the Club's purchase order workflow utilizing existing platforms , including approval routing, expense category discipline, and system configuration.
  • Evaluate and determine if existing procurement-related technology stack sufficiently scales to the heighted business complexity and transaction volume of the organization.
  • Drive purchase order compliance from current baseline toward best-practice benchmarks (at or above 90% of spend under PO).
  • Enforce the "no PO, no pay" standard, including formal return-to-requester process for non-compliant invoices.
  • Monitor and report to the executive leadership team and ownership group on PO compliance by cost center, category, and dollar band.

  

Accounts Payable Operations

  • Directly supervise the accounts payable function, providing day-to-day direction, quality review, and supervision.
  • Own AP operations end-to-end, including invoice intake, three-way match, payment run execution, and month-end AP close activities.
  • Administer the Club's rush payment policy, requiring documented business justification and Chief Financial Officer approval for any exception to standard payment timing.
  • Ensure integrity of the AP subledger and its reconciliation to the general ledger, in coordination with the Club’s accounting team.


Spend Analytics and Reporting

  • Establish a recurring spend analytics capability, including monthly PO compliance reporting, quarterly spend-by-category analysis, and annual savings realization tracking.
  • Deliver executive-level reporting on procurement KPIs, vendor risk exposures, and cost containment outcomes.
  • Partner with Financial Planning and Analysis on the annual budget cycle to align procurement sourcing calendars with budget commitments.
  • Support internal and external inquiries (including audit engagements) as the primary point of contact for procurement, AP, and vendor master data inquiries.

  

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as the primary Finance interface with department leads, Legal, and executive leadership on all third-party spend matters.
  • Partner with Legal on contract commercial review, MSA and SOW structuring, and any renewal negotiations.
  • Coordinate with the Senior Director, Controller and the Senior Director, Finance on treasury, budget, and reporting alignment.
  • Support the Chief Financial Officer on ad-hoc initiatives, including cross-entity procurement, MFP scope expansion, executive-level cost management reporting, and cost reduction strategies.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Supply Chain, or a related field required.
  • 6+ years of progressive procurement, sourcing, or category management experience, including 2+ years leading procurement in a high-growth or transformation environment.
  • Demonstrated success authoring and enforcing procurement policy in an organization that previously lacked one.
  • Track record of delivering quantified cost savings through competitive sourcing, vendor consolidation, and category strategy.
  • Deep experience with source-to-pay technology platforms; direct experience with Tipalti and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central is helpful but not required.
  • Working knowledge of accounts payable operations, three-way match, and vendor master data governance.
  • Experience managing direct reports, with a demonstrated ability to develop an AP function with procurement staff.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to hold firm on policy in cross-functional and executive settings.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage a high-volume vendor and contract portfolio across multiple entities and stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder sourcing initiatives from scoping through implementation and handoff.
  • Strong financial acumen with the ability to identify, quantify, and communicate savings, risk, and exposure to senior leadership.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to define structure, process, and controls where none currently exist.
  • Bias towards initiative, is resourceful and solutions-oriented, and can break down complex problems into digestible, actionable components.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and procurement/project management tools.
  • High degree of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality.

Preferred Experience

  • MBA or other relevant advanced degree or professional certification.
  • Prior experience building a procurement function from the ground up in a scaling organization.
  • Background in professional sports, live events, hospitality, stadium operations, or high-growth consumer brands.
  • Experience with real estate development, construction procurement, or capital project sourcing (relevant to future MFP scope expansion).
  • Familiarity with lender-facing environments where procurement discipline supports covenant compliance and audit readiness.
  • Experience with vendor risk programs, insurance and COI compliance, and 1099 administration.
  • Bilingual English / Spanish given vendor and community mix.

 

Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.


All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check.


Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

- Design and administer the Club's purchase order workflow utilizing existing platforms , including approval routing, expense category discipline, and system configuration. - Evaluate and determine if existing procurement-related technology stack sufficiently scales to the heighted business complexity and transaction volume of the organization. - Drive purchase order compliance from current baseline toward best-practice benchmarks (at or above 90% of spend under PO). - Enforce the "no PO, no pay" standard, including formal return-to-requester process for non-compliant invoices. - Monitor and report to the executive leadership team and ownership group on PO compliance by cost center, category, and dollar band.
Accounts Payable Operations
- Directly supervise the accounts payable function, providing day-to-day direction, quality review, and supervision. - Own AP operations end-to-end, including invoice intake, three-way match, payment run execution, and month-end AP close activities. - Administer the Club's rush payment policy, requiring documented business justification and Chief Financial Officer approval for any exception to standard payment timing. - Ensure integrity of the AP subledger and its reconciliation to the general ledger, in coordination with the Club’s accounting team.
Spend Analytics and Reporting
- Establish a recurring spend analytics capability, including monthly PO compliance reporting, quarterly spend-by-category analysis, and annual savings realization tracking. - Deliver executive-level reporting on procurement KPIs, vendor risk exposures, and cost containment outcomes. - Partner with Financial Planning and Analysis on the annual budget cycle to align procurement sourcing calendars with budget commitments. - Support internal and external inquiries (including audit engagements) as the primary point of contact for procurement, AP, and vendor master data inquiries.
Cross-Functional Partnership
- Serve as the primary Finance interface with department leads, Legal, and executive leadership on all third-party spend matters. - Partner with Legal on contract commercial review, MSA and SOW structuring, and any renewal negotiations. - Coordinate with the Senior Director, Controller and the Senior Director, Finance on treasury, budget, and reporting alignment. - Support the Chief Financial Officer on ad-hoc initiatives, including cross-entity procurement, MFP scope expansion, executive-level cost management reporting, and cost reduction strategies.
Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Supply Chain, or a related field required. - 6+ years of progressive procurement, sourcing, or category management experience, including 2+ years leading procurement in a high-growth or transformation environment. - Demonstrated success authoring and enforcing procurement policy in an organization that previously lacked one. - Track record of delivering quantified cost savings through competitive sourcing, vendor consolidation, and category strategy. - Deep experience with source-to-pay technology platforms; direct experience with Tipalti and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central is helpful but not required. - Working knowledge of accounts payable operations, three-way match, and vendor master data governance. - Experience managing direct reports, with a demonstrated ability to develop an AP function with procurement staff. - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to hold firm on policy in cross-functional and executive settings. - Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage a high-volume vendor and contract portfolio across multiple entities and stakeholders. - Demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder sourcing initiatives from scoping through implementation and handoff. - Strong financial acumen with the ability to identify, quantify, and communicate savings, risk, and exposure to senior leadership. - Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority. - Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to define structure, process, and controls where none currently exist. - Bias towards initiative, is resourceful and solutions-oriented, and can break down complex problems into digestible, actionable components. - Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and procurement/project management tools. - High degree of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality.
Preferred Experience
- MBA or other relevant advanced degree or professional certification. - Prior experience building a procurement function from the ground up in a scaling organization. - Background in professional sports, live events, hospitality, stadium operations, or high-growth consumer brands. - Experience with real estate development, construction procurement, or capital project sourcing (relevant to future MFP scope expansion). - Familiarity with lender-facing environments where procurement discipline supports covenant compliance and audit readiness. - Experience with vendor risk programs, insurance and COI compliance, and 1099 administration. - Bilingual English / Spanish given vendor and community mix.
Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.

job.title: Coordinator, Shipping & Receiving
job.html_description:
Description

The Coordinator, Shipping and Receiving is responsible for managing and distributing mail within an organization. This role is essential for ensuring smooth communication and efficient mail handling within our organization.  


Essential Duties and Responsibilities: 

  • Collect incoming mail from postal workers, sort it by departments, and distribute it accordingly.  
  • Maintain an organized and clean mail room. 
  • Prepare and dispatch outgoing mail, including weighing packages, affixing postage, and ensuring timely delivery. 
  • Maintain accurate records of incoming and outgoing mail, including dates and recipients. 
  • Manage the receipt and delivery of packages, including special deliveries like overnight shipments. 
  • Assist with customer inquiries regarding postal rates, delivery times, and other mail-related questions. 
  • Ensure the mailroom and the business office is stocked with postage stamps, envelopes, packing materials and essential office supplies.  
  • Assist the security team when needed at the security control room desk. 
  • All other duties as assigned. 

Requirements

  • High school degree or GED 
  • Accurate sorting and record-keeping is crucial 
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively 
  • Clear communication with colleagues and postal workers 
  • Ability to lift and move packages, sometimes up to 50lbs
  • Proficiency preferred with mail sorting software and tracking systems, CCTV camera system, 24/7 Incident Management System and Envoy (visitor check in and tracking system)
  • Must be able to work flexible hours including some weekends and/or holidays
  • Ability to speak and understand Spanish is a plus 
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office suite
  • Forklift certification a plus


Physical Demands:

  • Must be able to move and/or lift up to 50 pounds. 
  • This position requires work inside and outside of the building and some exposure to adverse conditions. 
  • Work in various positions, including but not limited to, stooping, standing, walking, bending over, sitting, kneeling, and squatting for extended periods of time. 

 

Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.


All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check.


Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Coordinator, Operations (Academy)
job.location: 1350 NW 55 Street, Fort Lauderdale, FL, 33309, US
job.html_description:
Description

Inter Miami CF is looking for a passionate and dedicated Coordinator, Operations (Academy) to join our Operations team. In this full-time role, you’ll play a vital part in maintaining world-class operations and facilities that meet the highest professional standards.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Assist with all the academy’s operational aspects, including set-up, breakdown, scheduling, communication, event coordination, general maintenance, etc.
  • Assist with managing the department’s equipment inventory, including maintaining accurate records and ensuring the availability of necessary materials
  • Create standard operating procedures, checklists, and training manuals for all areas of oversight.
  • Responsible for event recap notes.
  • Assist with IMCF II matches in the stadium, serving as the POC for the venue.
  • Execute other projects as assigned.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Facilities / Event Management, Maintenance, or related field preferred.
  • Ability or willingness to learn how to operate necessary equipment/software to complete required tasks.
  • Availability for academy matches and other events throughout the season (primarily evenings, weekends, and holidays).
  • Event/operations management in sports & entertainment venues preferred.
  • Very strong communication, organizational, problem-solving, and teamwork skills.
  • Team player able to handle a variety of tasks.
  • Ability to speak and understand Spanish is a plus.
  • A passion for fútbol is a plus.

Physical Demands:

  • Ability to lift 50 pounds of weight frequently throughout the assigned workday.
  • Ability to work in various degrees of outdoor weather conditions, including but not limited to extreme heat or rain.
  • Ability to work in various positions, including but not limited to stooping, standing, bending over, sitting, kneeling, and squatting for extended periods of time.

Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. 


Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.

job.title: Coordinator, Operations (Nu Stadium)
job.html_description:
Description

The Coordinator, Operations is responsible for daily activities required to coordinate, plan, run, maintain and service the stadium and events.


Responsibilities & Duties

  • Responsible for the planning and execution of special events including partner, client, hospitality events etc.
  • Develop a complete understanding of the requirements for every special event.
  • Assist researching vendors and make selections based on their creativity, quality, and cost.
  • Participates and leads client tours, coordinating the event needs with the client, and helping to determine relevant equipment, personnel and services required and estimated costs.
  • Responsible for making all departments aware of special event needs by generating event orders, diagrams, etc. to internal departments and 3rd party providers as needed.
  • Assist in regularly tracking the overall event finances.
  • Ensure all events are ready for guests, clients and teams as required.
  • Support and assist Operations Managers in large scale events and operations projects.
  • Act as the Event Manager on Duty for partner, client, and hospitality events.
  • Carefully supervise load-ins and event preparation activities.
  • Offer solutions to resolve problems in a timely manner.
  • Create event sheets and post-event summaries for partner, client, hospitality events etc.
  • Provide regular feedback to leadership and participates in continuous improvement for efficiency of operations and events.
  • Assist in maintaining the events calendar.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Facilities / Event Management or related field preferred.
  • Event / operations management in sports & entertainment venues preferred.
  • Demonstrate knowledge of practices and procedures related to event planning, set-up and conversions.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and teamwork skills.
  • Team player able to handle a variety of tasks.
  • Ability to speak and understand Spanish a plus.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including but not limited to evenings, weekends and holidays.
  • A passion for fútbol is a plus.

Physical Demands:

  • Must be able to move and/or lift up to 50 pounds.
  • This position requires work inside and outside of the building and some exposure to adverse conditions.
  • Ability to work extended hours, weekends, evenings and holidays as needed.

 

Equal Opportunity Statement 

Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Merchandise Planner (Retail)
job.html_description:
Description

Inter Miami CF is seeking a Merchandise Planner to support the financial planning, forecasting, and inventory optimization of the club’s retail and e-commerce merchandise business. This role is responsible for driving data-informed planning decisions that maximize sales, margin, and inventory productivity across channels. The ideal candidate is analytically strong, detail-oriented, and collaborative, with experience balancing financial targets, inventory health, and business needs in a fast-paced retail environment.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:


Financial Planning & Forecasting

  • Develop and manage seasonal and annual merchandise plans, forecasts, and budgets.
  • Own sales, margin, and inventory forecasts across retail, stadium, and e-commerce channels.
  • Partner with Finance to align merchandise plans with broader financial targets and reporting.
  • Monitor performance against plan and proactively recommend adjustments to optimize results.


Inventory Management & Optimization

  • Manage inventory flow, depth, and timing to support demand while minimizing risk.
  • Analyze sell-through, weeks of supply, and inventory turns to drive replenishment and exit strategies.
  • Identify risks and opportunities related to overages, shortages, and aging inventory.
  • Support allocation and replenishment strategies to ensure the right product is in the right place at the right time.


Performance Analysis & Reporting

  • Produce regular reporting on sales performance, inventory health, and margin trends.
  • Partner with Merchandising and Licensing teams to provide insights that inform assortment and buy decisions.
  • Analyze product-level and category-level performance to support future planning cycles.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Merchandising, Licensing, Retail Operations, and Supply Chain to align planning assumptions and execution.
  • Support go-to-market planning for key launches, events, and peak business moments.
  • Translate data and insights into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders.


Ownership

  • Maintain accurate planning tools, forecasts, and documentation with high attention to detail.
  • Continuously refine planning processes to improve accuracy, efficiency, and scalability.
  • Operate with a solutions-oriented mindset, balancing precision with business agility.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in merchandise planning, retail planning, or a related analytical role.
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills with advanced proficiency in Excel or planning tools.
  • Experience forecasting sales, managing inventory metrics, and analyzing performance.
  • Ability to communicate insights clearly to both analytical and non-analytical partners.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven retail environment.

job.title: Store Supervisor (Fort Lauderdale International Airport)
job.location: 100 Terminal Drive, Fort Lauderdale, FL, 33315, US
job.html_description:
Description

A Store Supervisor for the Inter Miami CF retail location at Fort Lauderdale International Airport leads daily operations in a fast-paced, high-traffic environment driven by passionate fans and international travelers. This role focuses on maximizing sales of official club merchandise, maintaining strict compliance with airport security and safety regulations, and delivering an exceptional customer experience that reflects the energy and identity of the club. 


Essential Duties & Responsibilities: 

  • Maintain high store standards and adhere to airport security protocols. 
  • Oversee all warehouse shipping and receiving functions, ensuring timely and accurate processing of incoming and outgoing merchandise. 
  • Manage the replenishment process to ensure the retail floor is consistently stocked with merchandise.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe store environment.
  • Work with the General Manager to determine the most efficient layout and storage solutions.
  • Ensure all stock is clearly labeled, stored systematically, and accessible for restocking and inventory management. 
  • Keep accurate records of all shipping, receiving, and inventory processes.
  • Audit markdowns and inventory processes for accuracy and compliance with standards.
  • Partner with the General Manager to train and develop store associates, fostering a positive and productive work environment. 
  • Recognize and encourage team members through regular feedback and collaboration.
  • Act as a brand ambassador for Inter Miami CF, ensuring merchandise operations reflect the club's professionalism and values. 
  • Ensure exceptional customer service to travelers in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Support additional projects and duties as assigned by the General Manager, including assisting with retail initiatives, seasonal promotions, and operational improvements. 
  • Support scheduling and daily workforce planning to ensure proper staffing coverage aligned with business needs. 
  • Provide hands-on leadership, setting expectations, monitoring performance, and holding team members accountable to operational and customer service standards.

Requirements

  • 1-5 years of experience in warehouse, logistics, or inventory management, preferably in a retail or merchandising setting. 
  • Proven leadership and problem-solving skills. 
  • Attention to detail and ability to maintain an efficient and well-organized workspace. 
  • Maintain full-time availability to work rotating shifts and ensure continuous, smooth operation of the Inter Miami CF airport retail store. 
  • Excellent interpersonal skills for dealing with staff, airport authorities, and diverse customers. 
  • Ability to lift, push, and pull up to 50 lbs. and work in demanding environments. 
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred but not required. 
  • Ability to pass comprehensive airport background checks.

Description

As a Retail Sales Associate, you’ll help fans show their pride and take home a piece of Inter Miami CF. Be part of the energy in our shops at Fort Lauderdale International Airport.

  • Keep the store organized and visually appealing throughout the shift.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned to support store operations.

  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Must be available to work during home matches, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.

  • Physical ability to lift, move, and organize inventory in both indoor and outdoor settings.
  • Dependable transportation required.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) candidates are a plus.
  • Ability to pass comprehensive airport background checks.

job.title: Commercial Matchday Hosts
job.html_description:
Job Title: Commercial Matchday Hosts

Responsible to: Head of Commercial

Apply here: https://forms.office.com/e/12c4GXBGmg

About The Role:

As a host at Elland Road, you will be the first point of contact for many of our VIP hospitality guests. In this role you would be required to act as the face of the Club within your allocated hospitality lounge, creating a seamless link between our hospitality department, our catering department and our VIP matchday guests. This will ensure that our guests receive the highest possible standard of service and have an exceptional hospitality experience.

Allocation Main Responsibilities

  • Positions are offered for matchdays only, with a typical shift lasting approximately seven to eight hours.

  • Attending pre-match hospitality host / hostess briefing prior to each shift;

  • Familiarise yourself with your designated suite (which may change each shift), checking the suite and other guests facilities meet required standards and ensuring corporate lanyards and programmes are set out as per the guests chosen package;

  • Welcoming all guests into your suite, building relationships by using eye contact and escorting guests to their assigned dining area / table;

  • Build relationships with customers pre-match, at half time and full time.

  • Continuously managing the flow of guests in to the suite ensuring all

    guests catering needs are being met and all guests are happy;

  • Be particularly attentive to new guests to ensure they are comfortable in their surroundings whilst being observant towards and engaging with all guests at all times to ensure the highest levels of service throughout the day;

  • Resolving any issues as they arise to ensure the guests' matchday experience is not effected, raising to the next level and / or appropriate departments as required (usually Duty Manager in your allocated lounge)

  • Directing guests to the appropriate match seats;

  • Answering any questions hospitality guests may have about other events

    and fixtures;

  • Report any faults with facilities and any catering issues without delay;

  • Any other reasonable duties

Required Technical Skills

  • Previous experience as a host or hostess, or hospitality waiter or waitress in a hospitality environment, or front of house experience, is preferred.

Required Behavioural Attitudes

  • Strong interpersonal skills

  • Candidates must be well presented, mature, professional and have an outgoing personality

  • The ability to work efficiently in a high pressured and dynamic sporting environment

  • A good approach to teamwork and ability to manage a busy hospitality area

  • Ability to troubleshoot under pressure

  • Excellent customer service skills and spoken English required

  • Ability to use initiative and be creative

  • Strong customer service skills

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Ability to prioritise case load and manage time effectively

  • Confident and assertive

  • Ambition, passion and willingness to learn
