job.title: Premier League Primary Stars Coordinator, LFC Foundation
job.location: Anfield Sports & Community Centre, United Kingdom
job.html_description:
We have an exciting opportunity for individuals to join our Liverpool FC Foundation team as a PL Primary Stars Coordinators.

In this role you will support the delivery of the LFC Foundations’ current Premier League Primary Stars Programme and be tasked with delivering classroom lessons for pupils on topics which will include PSHE, English and Maths. You will support the schools by providing extra-curricular clubs, school assemblies, workshops, social action projects, tournaments, competitions and support with transition to secondary schools. You will work with teachers to improve confidence in running PE lessons and work as part of a team across mass participation events.  

The Premier League Primary Stars uses the appeal of the Premier League and Liverpool football club to inspire children to learn, be active and develop important life skills.

What will you be doing?

  • Update LFC Foundation’s reporting database. 
  • Take responsibility for the delivery of the Premier League Primary Stars programme in a designated cohort of schools. 
  • Plan and prepare prior to each session using the PL Primary Stars templates and ensure that careful consideration is given to all abilities, ages, and SEND considerations. 
  • Deliver on the following topics to the highest possible standard across a variety of ages and abilities including: PE, PSHE, English, Maths, Extra-Curricular Clubs, School Assemblies, Workshops, Social Action, Tournament and competitions, Transition to secondary school sessions, Teacher CPD events/sessions and mentoring. 
  • Ensure that all activities are delivered in line with the current primary school curriculum and OFSTED guidelines. 
  • Work closely with primary school teachers to provide support and advice to improve their confidence in delivering PE. 
  • Organise and run teacher training workshops to designated primary schools and staff as part of the PL Primary Stars programme. 
  • Develop and maintain positive relationships with LFC partner schools and their key staff including head teachers, PE coordinators and receptionists
  • Liaise directly with partner schools to support and promote additional LFC activity 
  • Collect the appropriate monitoring and evaluation documentation for each Premier League primary stars session and assist in the upkeep of VIEWS/Salesforce online monitoring and evaluation. This must be done in a timely and effective manner. 
  • Ensure all activities are correctly monitored with the appropriate risk assessment and health and safety measures. 
  • Willingness to improve through CPD and courses. 
  • The well-being of young people is paramount at the LFC Foundation, you will be expected to understand safeguarding policies and procedures. 
  • Deliver bespoke interventions to individuals or cohorts.     
  • Support holiday camps and half term activation when needed. 

Who are we looking for?

To be successful in this role, you will have a proven track record of delivering sports coaching in schools to young people of all ages and abilities. You will have comprehensive knowledge of the PE national curriculum across KS1 & KS2 and an understanding of different teaching and learning styles. 

You will have excellent communication skills and the ability to build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders. 

Desirable qualifications

  • Hold/Willing to work towards the 1st 4sport level 3 certificate in supporting the delivery of physical education or working towards it.
  • Hold/Willing to work towards 1st 4sport level 2 award in multi-skills development in sport.

Why should you apply?

This role is offering full-time fixed-term contract opportunities for a period of 12 months, working 35 hours per week, on a 5 from 7-day basis including evenings and weekends when required. Your main base will be Anfield Sports & Community Centre, Liverpool however the post holder will also be required to work from other locations across Merseyside from time to time and be willing to travel within England and Wales. 

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:

  • Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5%
  • Life Assurance Cover
  • Free financial guidance and mortgage advice
  • Car salary sacrifice scheme for affordable driving
  • Cycle to Work scheme to keep you active
  • Purchase season ticket loans for easier commuting
  • Exclusive shopping discounts & cashback with top retailers
  • Will Writing Service for future planning
  • Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support
  • Medicash Health Cash Plan for everyday healthcare needs
  • Volunteering opportunities to give back to the community
  • Special LFC perks – retail discounts, partner offers, free LFCTV GO access, and priority tickets for matches, events & concerts

…and much more! LFC Benefits.pdf

At Liverpool Football Club, we have an unwavering commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion and are always looking to making a positive difference in the communities that we operate within. We are proud of our achievements in this area; maintaining the Premier League Equality Standard Advanced Level, becoming a founding signatory of the Football Association’s Football Leadership Diversity Code and being recognised as a leader in this important area on and off the pitch. We take our responsibilities in this area seriously and through the work being done across the club, we are committed to increasing the diversity of our people and becoming an increasingly inclusive workplace for all. We are committed to hiring great people representative of diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills across our entire business. If you share our enthusiasm and passion for inclusivity, then we want to hear from you.

Liverpool FC is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and vulnerable adults and expects all Colleagues and Volunteers to share this commitment. This role is subject to a satisfactory enhanced DBS check.

#LFCJobs

job.title: Casual Concourse Food Service Assistants
job.location: Anfield Stadium, Anfield Road Anfield Liverpool, United Kingdom
job.html_description:
What will you be doing?

Working on our busy concourse kiosks, you’ll help serve over 45,000 fans on matchdays and events, providing fast, friendly service in a high-energy environment.

This role is perfect for individuals who enjoy working in a fast-paced, hands-on service setting.

 In this role, you will:

  • Serve a range of food and drinks from concourse kiosks, including hot drinks, alcoholic beverages, pies, burgers, and snacks.
  • Work behind busy counters and bar-style service areas during peak periods.
  • Take orders quickly and accurately while delivering great customer service.
  • Maintain a fast, efficient service during high-volume matchday demand.
  • Keep your area clean, organised, and well-stocked throughout your shift.
  • Support your team to ensure smooth and coordinated service.

Average shift length: approximately 6 hours.

Please be aware that this role involves the handling and serving of alcoholic beverages, as well as various food products, including pork.

Who are we looking for?

We’re looking for people who are:

  • Friendly, approachable, and enjoy working with the public.
  • Confident in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
  • Comfortable handling food and drinks, including alcohol service.
  • Reliable and able to work effectively as part of a team.
  • Willing to learn and take on a variety of tasks.
  • Experience in hospitality, catering, or customer service is beneficial but not essential.

Please note: We may close this vacancy earlier than the advertised closing date if we receive a high volume of suitable applications. We therefore encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible.

This is a casual position, offering variable hours including evenings and weekends on a flexible assignment basis.

job.title: HR & Corporate Back Office Technology Business Partner
job.html_description:
We are looking for a HR & Corporate Back Office Technology Business Partner to join the team here at Liverpool Football Club. 

You will own and support the technology and systems used by teams including HR, Legal, Procurement and Communications, driving technical change that meets business needs. As the go-to expert for HR and Corporate Back Office technology, you will champion innovation, improve processes, ensure compliance with governance and security requirements, manage key supplier relationships and work across the Club to deliver effective technology solutions. 

What will you be doing? 

Product Leadership & Strategy 

  • Support business leads and the Senior Manager, Finance & HR Systems in shaping and delivering the technology strategy for HR, Legal, Procurement and Communications. 
  • Manage the roadmap and backlog for your business areas, balancing efficiency, commercial value, user experience and innovation. 
  • Drive improvements in partnership with business stakeholders and product teams. 
  • Champion appropriate uses of AI to improve internal processes and systems, in line with Club policies. 
  • Use data to evaluate performance, identify cost-saving opportunities and inform roadmap priorities. 
  • Support the development of business cases and investment proposals for technology change. 

Technology & Vendor Management 

  • Manage day-to-day technical relationships with suppliers across HR and Corporate Back Office systems. 
  • Evaluate and onboard new suppliers, and oversee system integrations. 
  • Identify opportunities to simplify the supplier landscape where appropriate.

Operational Excellence & Compliance 

  • Ensure systems, projects and suppliers meet relevant legal, governance, information security and risk requirements. 
  • Promote responsible and compliant use of AI. 
  • Champion strong data control, organisation and documentation across the system estate. 
  • Create and monitor technical KPIs to measure system performance and effectiveness. 
  • Provide subject matter expertise to help operational teams and business functions achieve the best outcomes. 

Innovation & Cross-Functional Collaboration 

  • Lead technical change and improvements across the Club’s internal HR, Legal, Procurement and Communications technology estate. 
  • Partner with teams across Liverpool FC to align system capabilities with wider business goals. 
  • Work with Digital Product colleagues to incorporate HR and Corporate Back Office requirements into wider projects and improvements. 
  • Support compliance activity and internal audits. 

Who are we looking for? 

Essential Knowledge & Experience 

  • Proven experience in a senior HR technology or product role, ideally within a complex organisation. 
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills, with confidence engaging at all levels. 
  • Ability to understand, document and present complex user journeys and information clearly. 
  • Experience creating reports and using data to generate recommendations and support decisions. 
  • A creative and analytical mindset, with a proactive approach to learning and independent problem-solving. 
  • Experience working in Agile or Scrum environments and using tools such as Trello, Jira, GitLab or similar. 
  • Working knowledge of compliance, governance and security requirements. 
  • An understanding of UX/UI principles and a focus on delivering a strong user experience. 
  • Experience using AI and automation to simplify processes and save time or cost. 

Essential Technical & Functional Skills 

  • Experience setting and monitoring KPIs, targets and performance measures. 
  • Strong analytical capability, with confidence creating and interpreting reports and dashboards. 
  • Experience managing third-party suppliers and collaborating with Scrum teams across multiple locations. 
  • Ability to work independently, self-motivate and lead upwards. 
  • Proven ability to explain the value of Agile ways of working and technical projects to non-technical audiences. 
  • Confidence representing the organisation at industry events, including travel where required. 

Desirable 

  • Experience with systems such as Zellis MyView, Ubeya, Benefex and SharePoint. 
  • Familiarity with analytics tools and business intelligence dashboards. 

Why should you apply?

This is a full-time perm position working 35 hours per week. Your main base will be our city centre office in Liverpool.

job.title: Associate, Finance Technology Business Partner
job.html_description:
We are looking for a Finance Technology Business Partner to join the team at Liverpool FC. 

You will own and support the Finance team's technology and systems, driving system improvements, integrations, and technical change initiatives. Acting as the Finance technology expert, they will lead innovation, enhance processes, ensure compliance with governance and security standards, manage key supplier relationships, and collaborate with stakeholders across the Club to deliver effective technology solutions that meet business needs.

What will you be doing?

Product Leadership & Strategy

  • Support the development and delivery of the Finance Technology strategy.
  • Manage the Finance systems roadmap, backlog, and improvement priorities.
  • Drive system enhancements, integrations, and process optimisation initiatives.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders and product teams to deliver business-focused solutions.
  • Champion AI and innovation opportunities to improve efficiency and performance.
  • Use data and insights to inform decision-making, prioritisation, and cost optimisation.
  • Support business case development and investment proposals for technology change.

Technology & Vendor Management

  • Manage relationships with Finance technology suppliers and partners.
  • Evaluate, onboard, and oversee third-party technology providers.
  • Lead and support Finance system integrations across the Club's technology landscape.

Operational Excellence & Compliance

  • Ensure Finance systems and suppliers comply with governance, security, and regulatory requirements.
  • Promote the responsible and compliant use of AI technologies.
  • Drive high standards of data management, documentation, and system governance.
  • Develop and monitor KPIs to measure Finance system performance and effectiveness.
  • Provide expert guidance on Finance technology to support operational excellence and business outcomes.

Who are we looking for?

Essential Knowledge & Experience

  • Proven experience in a senior Finance Technology/Product role within a complex organisation.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills.
  • Ability to analyse, document, and present complex processes and user journeys.
  • Experience creating reports, dashboards, and communicating insights from data.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive, adaptable approach.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and using tools such as Jira, Trello, or similar.
  • Good understanding of UX/UI principles and process improvement.
  • Knowledge of compliance, governance, and security requirements.
  • Experience leveraging AI and automation to improve efficiency and business outcomes.

Essential Technical Skills

  • Experience with Finance platforms, including Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O) and Microsoft Fabric.
  • Experience defining and monitoring KPIs, targets, and performance metrics.
  • Familiarity with analytics and business intelligence tools.
  • Experience managing third-party suppliers and working with geographically dispersed teams.
  • Ability to work independently, self-motivate, and confidently engage with senior stakeholders.

Desirable

  • Understanding of customer journeys across ticketing, retail, memberships, events, or entertainment sectors.
  • Experience working within a fan-focused, sport, leisure, or entertainment organisation.

job.title: Retail Sales Advisor, Chester Store
job.html_description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an enthusiastic individual to join our Liverpool FC team as a Retail Sales Advisor at our Chester Store. 

We’re looking for passionate, customer-focused individuals who love working as part of a team. In this role, you’ll be at the heart of our in‑store experience, ensuring every visitor enjoys the highest possible standard of service and leaves feeling part of the LFC family.

What will you be doing?

  • Dealing with customer sales and refunds, ensuring a focus on customer care and the customer experience.
  • Till work including processing cash and card payments.
  • Gaining and building upon Product knowledge to provide advice and guidance on product selection to customers.
  • Basic Sales Management through driving the AVS, UPT and Conversion by offering add on sales and upselling.
  • Merchandising/display.
  • Stock shrinkage and cash flow controls.
  • Supporting in receiving and storing the delivery of large amounts of stock.

Who are we looking for?

To be successful, you must have recent retail store and customer service experience in a customer facing role and can demonstrate this important skill set, with excellent numeracy and literacy skills. Having strong interpersonal and communication skills, you will be confident in delivering excellent customer service and working as part of a team. A retail and/or customer service qualifications would be advantageous. You will be able to work flexible hours.

Why should you apply?

This position is offering permanent positions working 8 hours per week on a 5 from 7 day basis. Your main base will be our Chester Store.

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:

  • Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5%
  • Life Assurance Cover
  • Free financial guidance and mortgage advice
  • Car salary sacrifice scheme for affordable driving

job.title: Kitchen Porter
job.html_description:
We are looking for Kitchen Porters to join the team at Liverpool FC. 

You will support the kitchen team by maintaining high standards of cleanliness across kitchen, wash-up and back-of-house areas. You will assist with cleaning kitchen equipment, crockery, utensils and work areas, ensuring all activity is carried out safely and in line with Health, Safety, Hygiene, COSHH and company standards.

What will you be doing?

  • Support the Head Kitchen Porter and wider kitchen team in keeping kitchen, wash-up and back-of-house areas clean, tidy and safe at all times.
  • Clear dirty crockery, cutlery, utensils and equipment promptly and ensure clean items are stored neatly in the correct locations.
  • Operate dishwashing machines and cleaning equipment safely and in line with agreed procedures and training.
  • Assist with daily and event-day cleaning schedules, ensuring tasks are completed to the required standard.
  • Maintain high standards of hygiene and follow food safety, Health and Safety and COSHH requirements at all times.
  • Clean up spillages and breakages immediately and report hazards to the Head Kitchen Porter or manager on duty.
  • Ensure kitchen equipment, floors, surfaces and bins are cleaned and maintained as directed.
  • Report equipment faults, maintenance issues or damaged items to the Head Kitchen Porter or Head of Department.
  • Work flexibly across kitchens and service areas during matchdays, events and day-to-day operations.

Who are we looking for?

Essential Skills

  • Willingness to learn and follow instructions from supervisors and managers
  • Flexible in hours of work and able to work evenings, weekends, matchdays and events
  • Ability to work as part of a team in a busy and fast-paced kitchen environment
  • Positive attitude, reliability and good timekeeping
  • Commitment to maintaining high standards of cleanliness, hygiene and safety

Desirable Skills

  • Previous experience in a kitchen, wash-up or cleaning role
  • Basic Food Hygiene qualification or willingness to work towards one
  • Awareness of Health and Safety, food hygiene and COSHH requirements
  • Experience working in events, hospitality or catering environments.

Why should you apply?

This is a full-time perm position working 40 hours per week. Your main base will be Anfield Stadium.

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:

  • Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5%
  • Life Assurance Cover
  • Free financial guidance and mortgage advice
  • Car salary sacrifice scheme for affordable driving
  • Cycle to Work scheme to keep you active
  • Purchase season ticket loans for easier commuting
  • Exclusive shopping discounts & cashback with top retailers
  • Will Writing Service for future planning
  • Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support
  • Medicash Health Cash Plan for everyday healthcare needs
  • Volunteering opportunities to give back to the community
  • Special LFC perks – retail discounts, partner offers, free LFCTV GO access, and priority tickets for matches, events & concerts

…and much more! LFC Benefits.pdf

We are proud of our achievements in this area; maintaining the Premier League Equality Standard Advanced Level, becoming a founding signatory of the Football Association’s Football Leadership Diversity Code and being recognised as a leader in this important area on and off the pitch. We take our responsibilities in this area seriously and through the work being done across the club, we are committed to increasing the diversity of our people and becoming an increasingly inclusive workplace for all. job.title: Commis Chefs
job.html_description:
We are looking for Commis Chefs to join the team at Liverpool FC. 

As a Commis Chef, you will support our senior chefs in delivering high-quality food across our stadium on a matchday and during events. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone at the early stages of their chef career who is eager to learn, develop their skills, and gain experience within a fast-paced stadium environment.

What will you be doing?

As part of our culinary brigade, you will play a vital role in helping deliver exceptional food experiences to supporters, guests, and VIP clients. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Assisting in the preparation and cooking of food to the highest standards.
  • Ensuring all food is prepared in line with recipes, portion control guidelines, and presentation standards.
  • Maintaining high levels of cleanliness, organisation, and safety within your section
  • Following all food safety, allergen, and hygiene procedures at all times.
  • Supporting stock rotation and minimising waste in line with company guidelines
  • Working collaboratively with colleagues to ensure smooth and efficient service across all areas.
  • Demonstrating a positive attitude and willingness to learn from senior chefs

Who are we looking for?

  • Some previous experience in a professional kitchen environment (placement, apprenticeship, or similar desirable).
  • A Basic Food Hygiene Certificate.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced kitchen and remain calm under pressure.
  • A strong team-player mindset with a positive, proactive attitude.
  • Enthusiasm for developing skills

Why should you apply?

This is a full-time perm position working 40 hours per week. Your main base will be Anfield Stadium.

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

job.title: Casual Matchday Kitchen Assistants
job.location: Anfield Stadium, Anfield Road Anfield Liverpool, United Kingdom
job.html_description:
What will you be doing?

You’ll work in our state-of-the-art kitchens alongside a team of highly skilled and creative chefs, supporting the delivery of high-quality food across match days and events.

You will:

  • Assist with basic food preparation.
  • Unload and store deliveries safely and efficiently.
  • Maintain cleanliness by emptying bins, sweeping, and mopping floors.
  • Ensure all kitchen equipment is cleaned and stored correctly.
  • Carry out deep cleaning of fridges and storage areas to meet hygiene standards.
  • Support with washing up, ensuring all items are cleaned and ready for service.
  • Keep back-of-house areas clear and organised, including end-of-day cleaning and waste removal.

Who are we looking for?

We’re looking for people who are:

  • Experienced in working in a fast-paced kitchen or similar environment.
  • Knowledgeable or aware of manual handling techniques.
  • Familiar with basic kitchen equipment and processes.
  • Reliable, proactive, and able to work as part of a team.
  • Committed to maintaining high standards of cleanliness and food safety.

Due to the nature of this role, applicants must be 18 years of age or over at the time of application. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider applications from anyone under the age of 18 for this role.

Please note: We may close this vacancy earlier than the advertised closing date if we receive a high volume of suitable applications. We therefore encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible.

Why should you apply?

This is a casual position, offering variable hours including evenings and weekends on a flexible assignment basis.

job.title: Retail Sales Advisors, Dublin Stores
job.html_description:
We have an exciting opportunities for enthusiastic individuals to join our Liverpool FC team as Retail Sales Advisors at our Dublin (Ireland) stores located in the ILAC and Swords. 

We’re looking for passionate, customer-focused individuals who love working as part of a team. In this role, you’ll be at the heart of our in‑store experience, ensuring every visitor enjoys the highest possible standard of service and leaves feeling part of the LFC family.

What will you be doing?

  • Dealing with customer sales and refunds, ensuring a focus on customer care and the customer experience.
  • Till work including processing cash and card payments.
  • Gaining and building upon Product knowledge to provide advice and guidance on product selection to customers.
  • Basic Sales Management through driving the AVS, UPT and Conversion by offering add on sales and upselling.
  • Merchandising/display.
  • Stock shrinkage and cash flow controls.
  • Supporting in receiving and storing the delivery of large amounts of stock.

Who are we looking for?

To be successful, you must have recent retail store and customer service experience in a customer facing role and can demonstrate this important skill set, with excellent numeracy and literacy skills. Having strong interpersonal and communication skills, you will be confident in delivering excellent customer service and working as part of a team. A retail and/or customer service qualifications would be advantageous. You will be able to work flexible hours.

Why should you apply?

This position is offering permanent roles of either 20 hours or 18 hours per week at our ILAC Store, and either 18 hours or 8 hours per week at our Swords Store. If you would be interested in working across both stores, please let us know.

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

job.title: Business Development & Philanthropy Manager LFC Foundation
job.location: Anfield Sports & Community Centre, United Kingdom
job.html_description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an individual to join our LFC Foundation team as a Business Development & Philanthropy Manager.

You will drive income growth by securing high-value donations, sponsorships, and partnerships. The role focuses on building and managing a strong fundraising pipeline, developing relationships with donors and corporate partners, and identifying new opportunities through networking and events. Acting as an ambassador for the Foundation, the successful candidate will leverage the LFC brand and the Foundation's impact to create sustainable funding opportunities that support long-term growth and community impact.

What will you be doing?

Business Development & Prospect Research

  • Develop and deliver strategies to secure new philanthropic income opportunities.
  • Identify, research and qualify major donors, corporate partners, sponsors and philanthropic organisations.
  • Build and manage a strong pipeline of prospects to generate sustainable income.
  • Conduct prospect research and due diligence to assess giving potential and engagement opportunities.
  • Collaborate with senior leaders, Trustees and Club stakeholders to maximise fundraising opportunities.

Pipeline Management & CRM

  • Manage the full donor cultivation journey from prospect identification to stewardship.
  • Lead the use and continuous improvement of Salesforce and CRM systems.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline reporting, income forecasting and performance tracking.
  • Implement effective prospect management processes and monitor conversion rates.
  • Develop strategies to enhance engagement and fundraising performance.

Networking & Lead Generation

  • Represent the Foundation at corporate, community and networking events.
  • Build and maintain influential relationships across business, philanthropy and football sectors.
  • Generate and convert qualified leads through strategic networking.
  • Work with LFC departments to maximise opportunities from sponsors, hospitality guests, partners and VIP supporters.

Relationship Management & Lead Conversion

  • Manage inbound and internally generated fundraising leads.
  • Develop tailored engagement plans for major donors and corporate partners.
  • Lead follow-up activity from events, introductions, referrals, sponsors, hospitality guests and existing supporters.
  • Build long-term relationships that drive repeat giving, multi-year commitments and strategic partnerships.
  • Manage a portfolio of major donors, ensuring excellent stewardship and engagement.

Fundraising Strategy & Leadership

  • Support the development and delivery of the Foundation's fundraising and philanthropy strategy.
  • Identify market trends, opportunities and best practices to drive income growth.
  • Create impactful donor engagement experiences and stewardship programmes.
  • Collaborate with Marketing and Communications on fundraising campaigns and donor communications.
  • Provide regular reporting and recommendations on fundraising performance.

Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure fundraising activities comply with relevant legislation, regulations and Foundation policies.
  • Conduct appropriate donor due diligence and risk management.
  • Manage budgets effectively to maximise return on investment.

Who are we looking for?

Essential

  • Proven experience in business development, fundraising, major donor fundraising, sponsorship sales or partnership management.
  • Demonstrable success in developing and converting high-value sales, fundraising or partnership pipelines.
  • Experience using Salesforce or equivalent CRM systems to manage pipelines, relationships and performance reporting.
  • Strong networking capability with the confidence to engage and influence senior business leaders, high-net-worth individuals and key stakeholders.
  • Experience identifying, developing and converting new business opportunities.
  • Excellent relationship management and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Strong commercial awareness and understanding of relationship-led sales processes.
  • Excellent presentation, communication and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously and work towards ambitious income targets. 

Desirable

  • Existing network of philanthropic, corporate or high-net-worth contacts.
  • Experience working within a charity, foundation, sports organisation or membership-based organisation.
  • Knowledge of philanthropy, fundraising and grant-making trends.
  • Experience securing six-figure gifts, sponsorships or partnership agreements.
  • Experience of implementing and managing Salesforce CRM.

Why should you apply? 

This is a permanent, full-time position, working 5 in 7. Your main base will be Anfield Sports and Community Centre with travel to our city centre office as and when needed.

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:

  • Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5%
  • Life Assurance Cover
  • Free financial guidance and mortgage advice
  • Car salary sacrifice scheme for affordable driving
  • Cycle to Work scheme to keep you active
  • Purchase season ticket loans for easier commuting
  • Exclusive shopping discounts & cashback with top retailers
  • Will Writing Service for future planning
  • Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support
  • Medicash Health Cash Plan for everyday healthcare needs
  • Volunteering opportunities to give back to the community
  • Special LFC perks – retail discounts, partner offers, free LFCTV GO access, and priority tickets for matches, events & concerts

…and much more! LFC Benefits.pdf

At Liverpool Football Club, we have an unwavering commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion and are always looking to making a positive difference in the communities that we operate within. We are proud of our achievements in this area; maintaining the Premier League Equality Standard Advanced Level, becoming a founding signatory of the Football Association’s Football Leadership Diversity Code and being recognised as a leader in this important area on and off the pitch. We take our responsibilities in this area seriously and through the work being done across the club, we are committed to increasing the diversity of our people and becoming an increasingly inclusive workplace for all. We are committed to hiring great people representative of diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills across our entire business. If you share our enthusiasm and passion for inclusivity, then we want to hear from you. 

Liverpool FC is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and vulnerable adults and expects all Colleagues and Volunteers to share this commitment. This role is subject to a satisfactory enhanced DBS check.

job.title: Casual Experienced Matchday Chefs
job.html_description:
Location: Anfield Stadium, Liverpool

Pay: £16-£18 per hour (depending on experience) + 12.07% holiday pay.

Start: From September 2026

We are looking for experienced Chef de Partie, Sous Chef and Lead Chef level professionals to join our matchday culinary team at Liverpool FC. Opportunities are available for experienced chefs who thrive in fast-paced, high-volume hospitality environments.

This is a casual position, offering variable hours on matchdays, on a flexible assignment basis. It's ideal for experienced chefs looking to pick up additional shifts around existing work or commitments.

Interview Process

We will be reviewing applications as they are received and are looking to hold interviews from the week commencing 14th September 2026. 

What will you be doing?

  • Leading or managing your section to deliver high-quality food service to agreed standards.
  • Preparing and cooking dishes in line with recipes, specifications, and service requirements.
  • Maintaining excellent standards of food quality, consistency, and presentation.
  • Supporting kitchen operations during busy matchday and event service periods.
  • Ensuring full compliance with food safety, allergen, and hygiene standards.
  • Assisting with stock control, wastage reduction, and effective kitchen organisation.
  • Supporting and mentoring junior kitchen team members where required.
  • Contributing to a professional, high-performing kitchen environment.

Who are we looking for?

  • Previous experience as a Chef de Partie, Sous Chef, Lead Chef, or equivalent within a professional kitchen.
  • Experience working in high-volume hospitality, events, stadium, hotel, or restaurant environments.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to perform under pressure during busy service periods.
  • A good working knowledge of food safety and allergen management.
  • Level 2 Food Hygiene Certificate (minimum).

What's on offer?

  • £16-£18 per hour (depending on experience) + 12.07% holiday pay.
  • Weekly pay.
  • Home games only – no away travel required.
  • Casual position offering shifts on a flexible assignment basis.
  • Shifts offered through our app, giving you flexibility to accept or decline work around your schedule.
  • Opportunities available from September 2026.
  • The chance to work behind the scenes at one of the world's most iconic football clubs.

job.title: Partnership Executive (Delivery)
job.html_description:
We are looking for a Partnership Executive to join the team at Liverpool FC.  

You will be apart of the Partnerships Delivery Team and you will support the Managers and Senior Partnerships Managers to contribute to the day-to-day management of Club Partners in achieving their marketing and partnership objectives. In addition, you will build relationships with internal departments to ensure the effective delivery of the partner campaigns with the involvement of the appropriate internal and external stakeholders.

What will you be doing?

  • Maintain regular and appropriate interaction with Partner contacts to build excellent working relationships.
  • Develop trust and confidence within the Partner organisations you work with.
  • Support the Managers in determining KPIs for each Partner and report on these appropriately, including producing case studies for each campaign or project undertaken by the Partner.
  • Support the Managers in delivering 360˚ account management: planning, delivery, measurement, financial reporting, and feedback, with appropriate regular reporting both internally and externally.
  • Lead on the efficient delivery of specific rights as agreed with the relevant Managers. Be proactive in updating progress and finding solutions to any roadblocks.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Partner industries and their competitive markets.
  • Own key internal projects with other Club departments, focusing on speed and efficiency.
  • Provide support to the wider LFC Partnerships Department with renewal and new business discussions where requested.
  • Complete administrative tasks in a detailed and efficient manner, working in partnership with the Partnership Managers.
  • Be a positive contributor and collaborator within the Partnerships Team to all internal and external stakeholders.
  • Bring fresh ideas and new ways of working to both internal and external environments.
  • Manage additional projects assigned by the Managers/Senior Partnership Managers, including contributing to financial and budget tasks, database completion, impact tracking, etc. 

Who are we looking for?

The ideal candidate will hold a degree and/ or have significate years of relevant experience within Partnership or Sponsorship roles gained in the sports marketing industry. They will have a proven ability to manage multiple accounts simultaneously, supported by strong knowledge of marketing campaigns, brand trends, and analytics tools such as Google Analytics. With excellent written, verbal and presentation skills, they will communicate confidently both internally and externally and be able to influence and persuade a range of audiences. Highly organised and methodical, they will consistently deliver high-quality work, demonstrate exceptional attention to detail, and manage their own workload effectively to meet deadlines. The role requires someone adaptable, self‑driven, and confident working independently, with the initiative to solve problems and the ability to build and maintain strong relationships. Proficiency across Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and Excel, along with experience in event management, is also essential.

Why should you apply?

This is a full-time permanent role working 35 hours per week. Your main base will be our city centre office on chapel Street, Liverpool. 

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:

  • Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5%
  • Life Assurance Cover
  • Free financial guidance and mortgage advice
  • Car salary sacrifice scheme for affordable driving
  • Cycle to Work scheme to keep you active
  • Purchase season ticket loans for easier commuting
  • Exclusive shopping discounts & cashback with top retailers
  • Will Writing Service for future planning
  • Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support
  • Medicash Health Cash Plan for everyday healthcare needs
  • Volunteering opportunities to give back to the community
  • Special LFC perks – retail discounts, partner offers, free LFCTV GO access, and priority tickets for matches, events & concerts

…and much more! LFC Benefits.pdf

job.title: Administration & Talent Manager, LFC Foundation
job.location: Anfield Sports & Community Centre, United Kingdom
job.html_description:
Are you an organised, people-focused professional who enjoys bringing structure to a busy environment? Join the LFC Foundation as our Administration & Talent Manager and become the dependable centre of our people and office operations. You will keep essential processes running smoothly, deliver a welcoming experience for colleagues and candidates, and help us build the workforce needed to extend our impact across our communities. 

This is a varied, hands-on role with real scope to improve how we work. Your first priority will be high-quality people and office administration, followed by talent and recruitment, and then workforce planning. By combining responsive day-to-day support with thoughtful process improvement, you will help the Foundation operate efficiently, recruit inclusively and grow sustainably. 

What will you be doing? 

1. People & Office Administration  

  • Act as the first point of contact for people and office enquiries.
  • Co-ordinate charity requests and ensure timely responses.
  • Oversee day-to-day office needs, supplies, kit, uniforms and room support.
  • Administer the apprenticeship scheme and related compliance requirements.
  • Manage casual workforce recruitment, onboarding and exits.
  • Support governance, board reports and audits.
  • Support overtime, working time and contract compliance.

2. Talent & Recruitment 

  • Maintain job descriptions, organisation charts and resource records.
  • Manage vacancies from approval to onboarding.
  • Build inclusive talent pipelines with colleges and community partners.
  • Improve recruitment materials and candidate communications.
  • Support recruitment approvals for casual, fixed-term and permanent roles.
  • Post vacancies and support fair shortlisting.
  • Co-ordinate interviews and support hiring managers.
  • Retain and file recruitment documents in line with legal requirements.
  • Improve recruitment reporting, including time to fill, platform engagement and candidate quality.
  • Ensure compliance across visas, DBS checks, records and audits.

3. Workforce Planning 

  • Monitor workforce compliance and required actions.
  • Use succession data to support internal recruitment.
  • Support effective recruitment and deployment of fixed-term roles.
  • Create consistent processes for casual workers and volunteers.
  • Learn from charity sector practice to shape effective workforce models.
  • Develop talent pipelines and career pathways across the workforce.
  • Work with Finance on labour costs and recruitment plans.

Other  

  • Attend Foundation events and programmes when required.
  • Support People projects and organisational change.
  • Provide ad hoc support to People and Leadership colleagues.
  • Provide essential cover when the Head of People or People Administrator is absent.
  • Support surveys, roadshows, benefits, pay review and goal setting.

The duties listed within this advert provide an overview of the role. Additional duties may be required in line with business needs. A full Job Description can be provided to shortlisted candidates at the interview stage upon request. 

What will help you thrive in this role? 

  • Strong administration experience in a fast-moving environment, with a track record of keeping accurate records, co-ordinating competing priorities and delivering responsive support.
  • Experience supporting end-to-end recruitment, candidate communications and onboarding.
  • Experience of workforce planning, or of working in a role with broad workforce planning responsibilities.
  • Experience of preparing data and turning it into clear plans, reports and communications.
  • Ability to manage a varied workload, prioritise effectively and work at pace.
  • A clear understanding of how to build candidate and apprenticeship pipelines that support growth and future skills needs.
  • A relevant Chartered Institute of Personnel and Development (CIPD) qualification, or equivalent knowledge gained through experience.
  • A passion for helping people reach their potential and develop their careers.
  • An interest in the charity sector and volunteering environment.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders and communicate people plans clearly and confidently.
  • Ability to work at pace, show resilience and handle challenging conversations professionally 

You do not need to have followed one particular career path to succeed here. If you bring strong administration skills, sound judgement and relevant experience across several of these areas, we encourage you to apply. 

Why join us? 

You will join a purpose-led organisation where excellent administration directly supports the people delivering positive change in our communities. You will have the opportunity to improve established processes, work with colleagues across the Foundation and wider Club, and see the practical impact of your work every day. 

This is a full-time, permanent role working 35 hours per week. Your main base will be Anfield Sports & Community Centre, with time also spent at our Head Office in Chapel Street. 

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:

  • Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5%
  • Life Assurance Cover
  • Free financial guidance and mortgage advice
  • Car salary sacrifice scheme for affordable driving
  • Cycle to Work scheme to keep you active
  • Purchase season ticket loans for easier commuting
  • Exclusive shopping discounts & cashback with top retailers
  • Will Writing Service for future planning
  • Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support
  • Medicash Health Cash Plan for everyday healthcare needs
  • Volunteering opportunities to give back to the community
  • Special LFC perks – retail discounts, partner offers, free LFCTV GO access, and priority tickets for matches, events & concerts

…and much more! LFC Benefits.pdf

At Liverpool Football Club, we have an unwavering commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion and are always looking to making a positive difference in the communities that we operate within. We are proud of our achievements in this area; maintaining the Premier League Equality Standard Advanced Level, becoming a founding signatory of the Football Association’s Football Leadership Diversity Code and being recognised as a leader in this important area on and off the pitch. We take our responsibilities in this area seriously and through the work being done across the club, we are committed to increasing the diversity of our people and becoming an increasingly inclusive workplace for all. We are committed to hiring great people representative of diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills across our entire business. If you share our enthusiasm and passion for inclusivity, then we want to hear from you.

Liverpool FC is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and vulnerable adults and expects all Colleagues and Volunteers to share this commitment. This role is subject to a satisfactory enhanced DBS check.

job.title: Information Security Analyst
job.html_description:
Information Security Analyst

We are looking for an Information Security Analyst to join the team at Liverpool FC and help protect the people, systems, data and digital services that support one of the world’s most recognisable football clubs.

This is a hands-on role with real breadth, working across security operations, vulnerability management, cloud and Microsoft security technologies, third-party assurance, data protection and security awareness. You will work closely with our managed Security Operations Centre, internal technology teams and business stakeholders to identify, investigate and reduce cyber security risks across the Club. This hybrid role is based in Liverpool, with three days per week on-site, and would suit an analyst who has built a strong foundation in information security or cyber operations and is looking for a broader position with greater visibility, ownership and opportunity to influence security maturity across a complex and high-profile organisation.

What will you be doing?

  • Support the management, investigation and coordination of security alerts, incidents and vulnerabilities, working with our managed Security Operations Centre and internal teams to ensure effective response and remediation.
  • Own the tracking and follow-up of vulnerabilities, control gaps and remediation actions, helping to drive measurable security improvement across the Club.
  • Conduct security reviews, assurance activity, control testing and risk assessments across business systems, cloud services, suppliers and technology projects.
  • Support and improve security awareness activity, including colleague communications, training content, phishing simulations and targeted guidance for higher-risk scenarios.
  • Contribute to the delivery of information security projects and continuous improvement initiatives, including enhancements to Microsoft security tooling, monitoring, identity, data protection and cloud security controls.
  • Monitor emerging cyber threats, security technologies and regulatory requirements, translating relevant developments into practical recommendations for the Club.
  • Produce clear security reports, dashboards and key metrics for management reporting, risk tracking and decision-making.
  • Build strong relationships with colleagues across the Club, promoting practical security behaviours and helping teams understand and manage information security risks.
  • Work with Microsoft security technologies, including Defender, Sentinel, Entra ID, Intune and Purview, supporting monitoring, investigation, configuration review and control improvement activity.
  • Support supplier and third-party security assurance activities, including security questionnaires, risk reviews and follow-up of identified issues.
  • Help maintain compliance with information security standards, regulations and internal policies, including ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials, PCI DSS and Premier League cyber security requirements.

Who are we looking for?

Experience & Qualifications

  • Demonstrable experience in an information security, cyber operations, SOC, cloud security, IT security or similar technical role.
  • Experience of investigating security alerts, vulnerabilities, incidents or control weaknesses in a business environment.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft 365 security technologies, ideally including Defender, Sentinel, Entra ID, Intune and Purview.
  • Understanding of cyber security frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials, PCI DSS and NIST.
  • Experience working with managed security providers, technology teams, business stakeholders or third-party suppliers.
  • Degree, professional certification, or equivalent experience in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Cyber Security or a related field.
  • Relevant security certifications, such as Security+, SC-200, AZ-500, CySA+, CISSP, CISM or CEH, would be advantageous.

Skills & Personal Attributes

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and data interpretation skills, with the ability to identify patterns, assess risk and recommend practical action.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to explain technical issues clearly to a range of audiences.
  • Ability to build effective working relationships across a business and influence stakeholders in a collaborative and pragmatic way.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented and comfortable managing competing priorities in a busy and evolving environment.
  • Trusted to handle sensitive information with discretion, integrity and sound judgement.
  • Curious, proactive and committed to continuous improvement, with a desire to keep developing technical and professional security skills.

Desirable Technical Knowledge

  • Microsoft 365 security technologies and the wider Microsoft E5 security ecosystem.
  • SIEM, SOAR, endpoint detection and response, identity protection and cloud security technologies.
  • Azure, AWS or similar cloud platforms, including cloud security posture, logging, monitoring and access control concepts.
  • Email security, phishing prevention, security awareness platforms and user behaviour risk reduction.
  • Secure web gateway, CASB, cloud application control and Data Loss Prevention technologies.
  • Threat intelligence, security monitoring, vulnerability management and incident response processes.

WHy should you apply?

This is an opportunity to join a small, influential information security team at a globally recognised football club, with exposure to a broad and modern security environment. You will have the chance to work across security operations, Microsoft security tooling, cloud security, vulnerability management, supplier assurance, awareness and governance activity, helping to shape how information security continues to mature across the Club.

If you are looking for a role that moves beyond alert handling and gives you the opportunity to work with technology teams, business stakeholders and external partners on meaningful security improvement, this could be an excellent next step. 

This is a full-time permanent position working 35 hours per week. Your main base will be our city centre office in Liverpool.

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To reward your hard work and commitment, we offer a competitive salary, 25 days’ holiday, plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days. You will also have access to our benefits kit bag, which includes but is not limited to:

  • Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5%
  • Life Assurance Cover
  • Free financial guidance and mortgage advice
  • Car salary sacrifice scheme for affordable driving
  • Cycle to Work scheme to keep you active
  • Purchase season ticket loans for easier commuting
  • Exclusive shopping discounts & cashback with top retailers
  • Will Writing Service for future planning
  • Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support
  • Medicash Health Cash Plan for everyday healthcare needs
  • Volunteering opportunities to give back to the community
  • Special LFC perks – retail discounts, partner offers, free LFCTV GO access, and priority tickets for matches, events & concerts

…and much more! LFC Benefits.pdf

At Liverpool Football Club, we have an unwavering commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion and are always looking to make a positive difference in the communities that we operate within. We are proud of our achievements in this area; maintaining the Premier League Equality Standard Advanced Level, becoming a founding signatory of the Football Association’s Football Leadership Diversity Code and being recognised as a leader in this important area on and off the pitch. We take our responsibilities in this area seriously and, through the work being done across the Club, we are committed to increasing the diversity of our people and becoming an increasingly inclusive workplace for all. We are committed to hiring great people representative of diverse backgrounds, perspectives and skills across our entire business. If you share our enthusiasm and passion for inclusivity, then we want to hear from you.

Liverpool FC is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and vulnerable adults and expects all Colleagues and Volunteers to share this commitment.

job.title: Casual Goalkeeping Coach, LFC Foundation
job.location: Anfield Sports & Community Centre, United Kingdom
job.html_description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an individual to join our LFC Foundation team as a Casual Goalkeeping Coach. In this role you will support and develop all players within the group to attain the highest levels of performance in a safe, secure, and supportive environment and drive and nurture a positive culture within the training group. Be a coach who makes the Football Development Programme a place where players learn, have fun, and develop a love for the game.

What will you be doing?

  • Contribute to the LFC Foundation Delivery Blueprint / Curriculum ensuring there is Goalkeeping provision which complements the football programme.  
  • Deliver – or oversee the delivery of – Girls Goalkeeping Centre and Football Development programme, including:
  • Design and deliver individualised Goalkeeping specific programmes as well as group training sessions 
  • Work with Physiotherapist/Sports Therapist to develop and support an activation / prehab programme
  • Manage facilities and equipment within the Girls Pathway and Football Development Programme so that it is well maintained and safe to use
  • Maintain a comprehensive database of work conducted with players and coaches.  Keep records which meet the standard required by The FA and the appropriate professional bodies
  • Communicate with parents in the event of Goalkeeping related queries, generally and specifically to their children.  Educate parents with regard to their role in supporting Goalkeeping development, injury prevention, injury care, recovery, diet and other factors relating to lifestyle away from the environment. 
  • Advise and direct other staff on the needs of players.   Attend case management meetings and provide professional opinion /input
  • Educate coaches on the Goalkeeping provision and embedding outcomes within technical sessions
  • Work with the LFC Foundations Safeguarding Manager to ensure that the wellbeing and welfare of all players and staff is always an operational priority

Who are we looking for?

Essential:

  • Experience working with young athletes in a football environment.
  • A good understanding of young players, including their physical and psychological development.
  • Up-to-date knowledge of child protection and safeguarding procedures.
  • Experience in a role that supports an understanding of how children learn and develop, such as teaching or coaching.
  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends and public holidays.
  • Ability to adapt to changing situations and support players in a positive way.
  • A genuine care for player needs, with the ability to provide personalised support and clear communication.
  • An innovative and open-minded approach, with confidence to try new ideas that help players develop, engage and enjoy the game.
  • National Goalkeeping Course and FA UEFA C qualification.
  • FA DBS, FA Safeguarding Children, and FA Level 1 Introduction to First Aid in Football or FA Emergency Aid qualification.
  • Understanding of goalkeeping within an applied team setting, with knowledge of how key goalkeeping concepts apply across women’s, girls’ and boys’ football pathways.
  • Experience developing and delivering individual and group goalkeeping preparation and recovery strategies for children and adolescent players.
  • Knowledge of injury minimisation strategies.

Desirable:

  • Working towards, or already completed, UEFA B Goalkeeping or Outfield qualification would be beneficial.
  • Talent identification and development knowledge, including awareness of unconscious bias, performance and potential.
  • Commitment to continued professional development.
  • A coaching or mentoring qualification, such as EMCC, would be desirable.

Why should you apply?

This is a casual position, working variable hours across the week including evening, weekends and public holidays on a flexible assignment basis. The role is based at the LFC Academy and local sites across Merseyside for fixtures.

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

job.title: Retail Sales Advisor, Belfast Store
job.html_description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an enthusiastic individual to join our Liverpool FC team as Retail Sales Advisor at our Belfast Store. 

We’re looking for passionate, customer-focused individuals who love working as part of a team. In this role, you’ll be at the heart of our in‑store experience, ensuring every visitor enjoys the highest possible standard of service and leaves feeling part of the LFC family. 

What will you be doing? 

  • Dealing with customer sales and refunds, ensuring a focus on customer care and the customer experience.
  • Till work including processing cash and card payments.
  • Gaining and building upon Product knowledge to provide advice and guidance on product selection to customers.
  • Basic Sales Management through driving the AVS, UPT and Conversion by offering add on sales and upselling.
  • Merchandising/display.
  • Stock shrinkage and cash flow controls.
  • Supporting in receiving and storing the delivery of large amounts of stock.

Who are we looking for? 

To be successful, you must have recent retail store and customer service experience in a customer facing role and can demonstrate this important skill set, with excellent numeracy and literacy skills. Having strong interpersonal and communication skills, you will be confident in delivering excellent customer service and working as part of a team. A retail and/or customer service qualifications would be advantageous. You will be able to work flexible hours. 

Why should you apply? 

This position is offering a permanent contract working 24 hours per week, on a 5 from 7-day basis, including evenings and weekends. Your main base will be our Belfast store. 

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

job.title: People Services Administrator
job.html_description:
We are looking for a People Services Administrator to join the team at Liverpool FC. 

We have a key role within our People Services Team for a proactive with HR or recruitment/onboarding experience. Within this role you will have responsibility for coordinating the onboarding and vetting process for new starters, including our safer recruitment roles, and liaising closely with candidates and hiring managers to make sure we provide a high standard onboarding experience.  

You’ll also provide administrative support across other stages of the employee journey, including contractual changes, promotions and leavers. As part of the People Services team, you’ll help colleagues with their queries and support the continued improvement of our processes.

What will you be doing?

  • Supporting the onboarding journey from offer through to the new colleague’s start date.
  • Coordinating onboarding and vetting checks, making sure they are completed and recorded accurately and on time.
  • Supporting safer recruitment processes, including monitoring the completion of required checks such as DBS checks.
  • Maintaining accurate employee records and handling personal information with care and confidentiality.
  • Supporting People Services processes such as contractual changes, promotions and leavers.
  • Responding to People-related queries and directing colleagues to the right information or team when needed.
  • Providing general administrative support to the People Services and wider People and Culture teams.
  • Learning how our People systems and processes work and developing your knowledge through practical experience and support from the team. 

Who are we looking for?
 You’ll be organised, motivated and comfortable working in a busy environment where priorities can change. You’ll have strong attention to detail and take pride in completing work accurately and on time.

You’ll also:

  • Have good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Be able to build effective working relationships with colleagues at different levels.
  • Be comfortable using Microsoft Office and learning new systems.
  • Be able to organise your workload and keep track of several tasks.
  • Understand the importance of confidentiality when handling personal information.
  • Be willing to ask questions, learn from others and develop your skills.
  • Have some experience in an administrative, customer service, recruitment or HR environment, although full training and support will be provided.

Why should you apply?

This is a full-time perm position working 35 hours per week. Your main base will be our city centre office in Liverpool.

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:

  • Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5%
  • Life Assurance Cover
  • Free financial guidance and mortgage advice
  • Car salary sacrifice scheme for affordable driving
  • Cycle to Work scheme to keep you active
  • Purchase season ticket loans for easier commuting
  • Exclusive shopping discounts & cashback with top retailers
  • Will Writing Service for future planning
  • Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support
  • Medicash Health Cash Plan for everyday healthcare needs
  • Volunteering opportunities to give back to the community
  • Special LFC perks – retail discounts, partner offers, free LFCTV GO access, and priority tickets for matches, events & concerts

…and much more! LFC Benefits.pdf

At Liverpool Football Club, we have an unwavering commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion and are always looking to making a positive difference in the communities that we operate within. We are proud of our achievements in this area; maintaining the Premier League Equality Standard Advanced Level, becoming a founding signatory of the Football Association’s Football Leadership Diversity Code and being recognised as a leader in this important area on and off the pitch. We take our responsibilities in this area seriously and through the work being done across the club, we are committed to increasing the diversity of our people and becoming an increasingly inclusive workplace for all. We are committed to hiring great people representative of diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills across our entire business. If you share our enthusiasm and passion for inclusivity, then we want to hear from you.

Liverpool FC is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and vulnerable adults and expects all Colleagues and Volunteers to share this commitment.

We are looking for Commis Chefs, Line Chefs, and Chef de Parties (or similar) to join our matchday culinary team at Liverpool FC. Opportunities are available for chefs with previous professional kitchen experience who enjoy working in a fast-paced, high-volume hospitality environment.

job.title: Coordinator, Global Partnership Sales
job.html_description:
We are looking for a Coordinator, Global Partnership Sales to join the team at Liverpool FC. In this role you will be responsible for supporting the LFC Sales Team across all key sales initiatives, helping to drive significant commercial revenue for LFC. The role will provide support across all projects and sales efforts, working closely with the LFC Sales Team, Partner Strategy & Growth Team and other Internal stakeholders.

What will you be doing?

  • Take a lead role in the early identification and targeting of categories and brands for the sales team to focus on. 
  • Proactively monitor industry trends and competitor activity to ensure LFC sales team is fully across market shifts, activity and pricing. 
  • Identify new sales prospects and source key decision maker contact details. Research new and existing prospects to identify sales hooks to support outreach and proposition development. 
  • Lead on the reporting and capturing of up-to-date brand updates for Global Sales Call meetings 
  • Join relevant prospect calls and meetings alongside the LFC Sales Team, to take notes that will shape future sales materials (mostly virtual with travel on occasion). 
  • Build and manage sales presentations, proposals, and other materials alongside the LFC Sales Team, design team and internal stakeholders, ensuring that the content, flow and narrative addresses prospect needs and questions. 
  • Develop company reports in advance of sales calls with new prospects. 
  • Prepare company biographies for the Sales Team and Senior Executives.  
  • Identify key industry events and opportunities for LFC to be present within the brand / advertising industry, building this out into an annual calendar of events for the sales team to attend. 
  • Lead the organization of the weekly Sales Pipeline meeting for the LFC Sales Team and VP, Global Partnership Sales, planning the agenda alongside relevant Internal LFC Stakeholders 
  • Manage communication with Internal LFC Stakeholders across the Club on behalf of the LFC Sales Team, to support sales requests and prospect conversations. 
  • Manage administrative efforts on behalf of the LFC Sales Team, including scheduling meetings with Internal and External Stakeholders.  
  • Draft internal documents, such as Proposal Briefing Form and Contract Briefing Form for the LFC Sales Team to review and send to relevant Internal Stakeholders. 

Who are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s Degree (degree in business, marketing, or related field preferred) or equivalent experience. 
  • 1-2 years of experience within sponsorship, brand strategy, digital strategy, and/or sales for a rights holder, brand, agency, or within a corporate setting. 
  • Passion for sports marketing, media, advertising, and sponsorship sales. 
  • A great teammate and can-do attitude. 
  • Innovative and well-organised with a strong work ethic and a desire/willingness to learn. 
  • Aggressive, self-motivated team player that has the ability to focus on individual and team goals. 
  • Strong project management skills. 
  • Excellent written communication and presentation-building skills  
  • Ability to develop strong relationships internally and externally. 
  • Ability to work with a broad cross-section of functional internal teams. 
  • Available to travel domestically, work evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed. 

Why should you apply?

This is a full-time permanent position working 35 hours per week. Your main base will be our London Office.

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:

  • Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5%
  • Life Assurance Cover
  • Free financial guidance and mortgage advice
  • Car salary sacrifice scheme for affordable driving
  • Cycle to Work scheme to keep you active
  • Purchase season ticket loans for easier commuting
  • Exclusive shopping discounts & cashback with top retailers
  • Will Writing Service for future planning
  • Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support
  • Medicash Health Cash Plan for everyday healthcare needs
  • Volunteering opportunities to give back to the community
  • Special LFC perks – retail discounts, partner offers, free LFCTV GO access, and priority tickets for matches, events & concerts

…and much more! LFC Benefits.pdf

At Liverpool Football Club, we have an unwavering commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion and are always looking to making a positive difference in the communities that we operate within. We are proud of our achievements in this area; maintaining the Premier League Equality Standard Advanced Level, becoming a founding signatory of the Football Association’s Football Leadership Diversity Code and being recognised as a leader in this important area on and off the pitch. We take our responsibilities in this area seriously and through the work being done across the club, we are committed to increasing the diversity of our people and becoming an increasingly inclusive workplace for all. We are committed to hiring great people representative of diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills across our entire business. If you share our enthusiasm and passion for inclusivity, then we want to hear from you.

  • Merchandising/display.
  • Stock shrinkage and cash flow controls.
  • Supporting in receiving and storing the delivery of large amounts of stock.

Who are we looking for? 

To be successful, you must have recent retail store and customer service experience in a customer facing role and can demonstrate this important skill set, with excellent numeracy and literacy skills. Having strong interpersonal and communication skills, you will be confident in delivering excellent customer service and working as part of a team. A retail and/or customer service qualifications would be advantageous. You will be able to work flexible hours. 

Why should you apply? 

This position is offering a fixed term contract for a period of 2 months working 8 hours per week  Your main base will be our Belfast Store.

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
