job.title: Cleaning Assistant - Events
job.html_description:
Events Cleaning Assistant

Permanent, Full Time (Match Day working included)

St. James’ Park, Newcastle upon Tyne
Competitive Salary

Closing Date: 2 October 2026

Be part of something bigger. Help us create exceptional environments and experiences.

We are the heartbeat of the city, a club with bold ambitions on a global stage and deep roots in our community. If you’re driven to raise the bar, make an impact and contribute to a high-performance culture, you’ll find the platform, the people and the pride to do your best work here.

We work as One Club, with excellence, integrity, accountability and relentless ambition shaping how we work together.

This is a great opportunity to develop, learn and make a real contribution in a fast-paced and exciting environment. You’ll be encouraged to bring curiosity, take ownership, share ideas and keep improving, helping us move Newcastle United forward, together.

About the role

We’re looking for a reliable and hardworking Cleaning Assistant to join our Venue Operations team.

This role will be primarily focused on cleaning and preparing our event rooms, helping to ensure these important spaces are consistently clean, welcoming and ready for the wide range of events held at St. James’ Park.

You’ll take pride in maintaining high standards across your allocated areas, working independently and alongside colleagues to deliver an excellent experience for guests, visitors and colleagues. You may also provide additional cleaning support across the stadium, including before, during and after home matches and other events.

What you’ll do

You’ll:

  • Clean, prepare and maintain event rooms and associated areas to a consistently high standard.
  • Carry out general cleaning duties, including sweeping, mopping, vacuuming and maintaining floors.
  • Use cleaning equipment safely and correctly, including completing manual-handling activities where necessary.
  • Complete daily, weekly and monthly cleaning tasks efficiently and with minimal supervision.
  • Deliver excellent customer service and communicate positively with colleagues.
  • Provide cleaning support before, during and after home matches and other events held at the stadium.
  • Follow all relevant health and safety requirements, Club policies and working procedures.

About you

You’ll have previous experience in a cleaning or similar role and take genuine pride in delivering high standards.

You’ll be able to manage your time effectively, work confidently with minimal supervision and contribute positively as part of a wider team. Strong communication skills, reliability and a helpful, approachable manner will also be important.

As our events and fixtures can take place outside standard working hours, you’ll need the flexibility to work home matchdays and other scheduled events, including some evenings, weekends and public holidays.

A relevant cleaning qualification, such as an NVQ Level 2, and industry training in areas such as COSHH would be great, although these are not essential

The team

You’ll be part of a friendly, supportive and dedicated team who will help you settle in and succeed. We value curiosity, teamwork and a positive approach, and we’re committed to creating an environment where people feel trusted, included and empowered to do their best work.

We work with high standards and a continuous improvement mindset, supporting each other as One Club and taking pride in doing the right thing

United As One

We’re committed to building an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone feels safe, respected and able to thrive. Equality, diversity and inclusion are central to who we are, and we believe the diversity of our people is one of our greatest strengths.

We work as One Club, reflecting the communities we serve, acting with integrity, and creating an environment where everyone can be their authentic self and achieve their full potential.

Safeguarding

Permanent, Full Time (Match Day working included)
St. James’ Park, Newcastle upon Tyne Competitive Salary
Closing Date: 2 October 2026
Be part of something bigger. Help us create exceptional environments and experiences.
We are the heartbeat of the city, a club with bold ambitions on a global stage and deep roots in our community. If you’re driven to raise the bar, make an impact and contribute to a high-performance culture, you’ll find the platform, the people and the pride to do your best work here.
We work as One Club, with excellence, integrity, accountability and relentless ambition shaping how we work together.
This is a great opportunity to develop, learn and make a real contribution in a fast-paced and exciting environment. You’ll be encouraged to bring curiosity, take ownership, share ideas and keep improving, helping us move Newcastle United forward, together.
About the role
We’re looking for a reliable and hardworking Cleaning Assistant to join our Venue Operations team.
This role will be primarily focused on cleaning and preparing our event rooms, helping to ensure these important spaces are consistently clean, welcoming and ready for the wide range of events held at St. James’ Park.
You’ll take pride in maintaining high standards across your allocated areas, working independently and alongside colleagues to deliver an excellent experience for guests, visitors and colleagues. You may also provide additional cleaning support across the stadium, including before, during and after home matches and other events.
What you’ll do
You’ll:
- Clean, prepare and maintain event rooms and associated areas to a consistently high standard. - Carry out general cleaning duties, including sweeping, mopping, vacuuming and maintaining floors. - Use cleaning equipment safely and correctly, including completing manual-handling activities where necessary. - Complete daily, weekly and monthly cleaning tasks efficiently and with minimal supervision. - Deliver excellent customer service and communicate positively with colleagues. - Provide cleaning support before, during and after home matches and other events held at the stadium. - Follow all relevant health and safety requirements, Club policies and working procedures.
About you
You’ll have previous experience in a cleaning or similar role and take genuine pride in delivering high standards.
You’ll be able to manage your time effectively, work confidently with minimal supervision and contribute positively as part of a wider team. Strong communication skills, reliability and a helpful, approachable manner will also be important.
As our events and fixtures can take place outside standard working hours, you’ll need the flexibility to work home matchdays and other scheduled events, including some evenings, weekends and public holidays.
A relevant cleaning qualification, such as an NVQ Level 2, and industry training in areas such as COSHH would be great, although these are not essential
The team
You’ll be part of a friendly, supportive and dedicated team who will help you settle in and succeed. We value curiosity, teamwork and a positive approach, and we’re committed to creating an environment where people feel trusted, included and empowered to do their best work.
We work with high standards and a continuous improvement mindset, supporting each other as One Club and taking pride in doing the right thing
United As One

Safeguarding
We’re committed to creating an environment where everyone is safe, heard, valued and able to thrive. Safeguarding and welfare are central to the way we work, and we expect everyone to play their part in doing the right thing and upholding the highest standards of care.

job.title: Supporter Services Executive New
job.location: Newcastle upon Tyne Discipline: Commercial Job type: Permanent Job ref: 011422 Published: about 19 hours ago Expiry date: 04 Oct 2026 23:45
job.html_description:
Supporter Services Executive

Newcastle upon Tyne

Permanent

Competitive Salary

Closing Date: 4th October 2026

We are the heartbeat of the city. Come and be a part of a long and proud history where we strive to be the best in everything we do, on and off the pitch. Bringing the people and communities together, join the Newcastle United Family, as we embark on the next steps of our exciting journey.

About the role

We’re looking for a motivated and customer‑focused Supporter Services Executive to join our Supporter Services team. In this role, you will help grow and strengthen the relationship between the Club and its supporters by providing high‑quality advice, delivering excellent customer care, and supporting a wide range of fan-facing activities. You will be responsible for managing enquiries across multiple platforms, handling feedback and complaints, and ensuring supporters receive timely, effective, and professional responses.

Your impact

In this role, you will communicate with a wide range of supporters across various platforms, ensuring they receive the highest levels of customer service. You will take ownership of enquiries and complaints, working from start to finish to resolve issues. You will support the Supporter Services Manager in implementing the Club’s customer case‑management system, respond to queries relating to ticketing, retail, membership, hospitality, tours, and general Club matters, and work collaboratively with internal teams to deliver smooth, consistent supporter experiences. You will also assist fans face‑to‑face at St James’ Park on matchdays and non‑matchdays, utilise supporter systems and databases to produce useful reporting insights, and proactively identify ways to enhance engagement, retention, and overall supporter satisfaction.

Location

This role is based in Newcastle upon Tyne, please note if you live outside the North East, you will either need to commute or relocate for this role.

United As One

We’re committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and believe in equal opportunities for all. We recognise that the diversity of our people is one of our greatest strengths. We work together to reflect the communities we serve and to maintain an inclusive environment in which everyone can be their authentic self and is enabled to achieve their full potential.

Safeguarding

We’re committed to being a place where everyone is safe, heard, valued and able to thrive, so we place high value on the safeguarding and welfare of everyone we engage with. As this role involves supporting a wide range of fans and interactions across the Club, it requires an enhanced criminal records check with BLC

How to apply

To access the full job description for this role please click here.

For further information on this role and about the Club and our values, please visit our careers page.

Please apply as soon as possible as this vacancy may close early should we receive a high volume of suitable candidates.

Recruitment Agencies – please note that we do not accept unsolicited / speculative candidate details or applications. Any candidates supplied, unless formally requested, will be taken as a direct / free candidate.

job.title: Netball Community Coaches
job.location: The City Ground, Nottingham, NG2 5FJ, GB
job.html_description:
Engagement: Variable hours available

Location: The City Ground, Nottingham, NG2 5FJ

Department: Netball

About the Role:

To deliver high-quality coaching sessions, planning training programmes, and supporting administrative tasks to ensure the smooth running and development of each squad, working across a range of age groups and performance levels within the Netball Community Programmes.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Plan and deliver high-quality netball coaching sessions to players of all ages and abilities.

  • Foster a positive and inclusive environment that encourages participation and enjoyment of netball.

  • Develop and implement training programs that cater to the individual needs of players.

  • Monitor and evaluate player progress, providing constructive feedback to help them improve.

  • Ensure the safety and well-being of all participants during coaching sessions.

  • Promote Nottingham Forest Netball and its programs within local communities.

  • Assist in organising and running local netball events, tournaments, and competitions.

  • Maintain equipment and ensure it is used safely and effectively.

  • Attend CPD events organised by Nottingham Forest.

  • Committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of young people

What are we looking for:

  • Netball coaching qualification for Head Coach (LEVEL 2 or ABOVE)

  • Netball coaching qualification for Assistant Coach (LEVEL 1 or ABOVE)

  • ·Previous coaching experience, preferably within a community setting.

  • Excellent communication.

  • Ability to inspire and motivate players of all ages and abilities.

  • Strong organisational and time management skills.

  • Commitment to promoting equality, diversity, and inclusion in sports.

  • Valid driver's license and access to a vehicle for travel between locations.

  • First Aid certification

  • Safeguarding certification

Forest For Everyone

Nottingham Forest Football Club is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified persons, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marital / civil partnership status, pregnancy / maternity leave, race, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Nottingham Forest Football Club is a signatory of the FA’s Football Leadership Diversity Code. We are committed to developing policies to promote equal opportunities and diversity within our workforce. To monitor our progress against these commitments, we require all applicants to provide accurate diversity data during the application process.

Disability Confident Committed Employer

We are a Disability Confident Committed employer. We encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions. If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a "disabled person" according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment selections.

Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity & Inclusion

Nottingham Forest Football Club is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified persons, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marital / civil partnership status, pregnancy / maternity leave, race, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Nottingham Forest are committed to developing policies to promote equal opportunities and diversity within our workforce. To monitor our progress against these commitments, we require all applicants to provide accurate diversity data during the application process.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

As part of the Club’s commitment to safeguarding, the successful applicant may be required to undergo a Disclosure Barring Service (“DBS”) check. The level of check required will depend on the requirements of the role. Individuals will be asked to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, warnings or bind-overs that they are required to disclose for the level of check applicable to the role, in accordance with the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 (as amended) and the DBS filtering rules. job.title: Netball Performance Pathway Coaches
job.location: The City Ground, Nottingham, NG2 5FJ, GB
job.html_description:
Engagement: Variable hours available

Location: The City Ground, Nottingham, NG2 5FJ

Department: Netball

Reporting to: Netball Pathway Lead

About the Role:

To deliver high-quality coaching sessions, planning training programmes, and supporting administrative tasks to ensure the smooth running and development of each squad, working across a range of age groups and performance levels within the Netball Pathway.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Support with the implementation of the vision and culture of the Nottingham Forest Netball Pathway.

  • To work with the various coaches across the pathway in creating high performance environments enabling each athlete to develop their technical, tactical, physical and psychological competences.

  • To work closely with the Pathway Head Coach & Sport Science Sports Medicine team to support delivery of a high quality periodised training and competition programmes for targeted players.

  • Committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of young people

What are we looking for:

  • UKCC Level 2 (E) and above

  • Experience of coaching netball within a performance environment

  • Experience of working with athletes aged between 14-19 within a performance environment

  • Excellent athlete management experience

  • Experience of planning & implementing a high-performance program

  • An ability to inspire individuals, build trust and a create a positive & ambitious team culture

  • An ability to balance Nottingham Forest Netball responsibilities with other commitments

  • An ability to work in a team

  • An ability to articulate tactical changes and technical improvements to athletes in a pressurised situation in a concise and meaningful manner

  • Knowledge of HUDL and Performance Analysis

job.title: Host Family Provider
job.location: The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR, GB
job.html_description:
Contract: Temporary engagement

Location: Within three miles (15 minutes), easy access to The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR

Working Arrangements: Remote

Closing Date For Applications: INSERT

About the Role:

We are recruiting for host families who can provide accommodation for our Academy players to support them living away from home. This is a unique and rewarding opportunity to make a real difference to their experience and provide vital support to the players as they develop as young people alongside their football.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Provide a homely and friendly environment for our young people

  • Support with the development of our young people in your care with their independent living and self-care skills

  • Include our young people in family life as much as they feel comfortable with

  • Provide access to a private bedroom, bathroom, laundry facilities, and communal areas of the house

  • Provide a nutritious evening meal 

  • Report any welfare concerns to the Safeguarding and Welfare team should they occur.

  • Allow access from the Club for regular inspection and visits throughout the season.

  • Adhere to any further and ongoing requirements of Host Families, as outlined in the application process, guidance will be provided by the Club on this. 

What are we looking for:

  • Provide a warm, welcoming and safe environment for our young person

  • Provide the young person with their own private bedroom and relevant amenities 

  • Excellent communication and listening skills

  • Ability to cope with the young person's flexible schedule throughout the football season

  • Previous experience of working with young people

  • Ability to promote and demonstrate anti-discriminatory practice 

As part of the recruitment process the Club would need to conduct a number of home visits to determine suitability and ensure the home meets the requirements for hosting young people within the Academy.

- Provide a homely and friendly environment for our young people - Support with the development of our young people in your care with their independent living and self-care skills - Include our young people in family life as much as they feel comfortable with - Provide access to a private bedroom, bathroom, laundry facilities, and communal areas of the house - Provide a nutritious evening meal - Report any welfare concerns to the Safeguarding and Welfare team should they occur. - Allow access from the Club for regular inspection and visits throughout the season. - Adhere to any further and ongoing requirements of Host Families, as outlined in the application process, guidance will be provided by the Club on this.
What are we looking for:
- Provide a warm, welcoming and safe environment for our young person - Provide the young person with their own private bedroom and relevant amenities - Excellent communication and listening skills - Ability to cope with the young person's flexible schedule throughout the football season - Previous experience of working with young people - Ability to promote and demonstrate anti-discriminatory practice

job.html_description:

Contract: Full Time, 42 hours a week

Location: The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR

Department: First Team Catering

Reporting to: Head Performance Chef

Closing Date For Applications: 23rd September

About the Role:

Works alongside our Chefs to manage daily menu preparation, ensuring food quality, consistency and freshness

The Perks of the Job:

  • Opportunity to access tickets for events at The City Ground.

  • Employee Assistance Programme.

  • Access to high street and gym discounts.

  • Discount within our Club shop.

  • Free on-site parking.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Preparing, cooking and presenting high quality nutritious dishes within the given specification

  • Assisting the Head Performance Chef in creating menu items

  • Preparing Carbohydrates, vegetables, vegetarian, protein (meat and fish)

  • Assisting with the management of health and safety

  • Assisting with the management of food hygiene practices

  • Managing and training any Commis Chefs

  • Monitoring portion and waste control

  • Overseeing the maintenance of kitchen and food safety standards

What are we looking for:

  • City & Guilds 706/1 | 706/2 Catering or NVQ Level 2

  • Level 2 Food Safety Award

  • Minimum 4 years relevant experience

  • Awareness of manual handling techniques

  • Awareness of Control of Substances Hazardous to Health Regulations (COSHH) and chemical safety

  • Experience of kitchen equipment

  • Experience of dangerous equipment such as knives

  • Ability to work without close supervision

  • Ability to manage Commis Chefs

  • Good communication skills

  • Good level of numeracy

  • Enthusiasm to develop your own skills and knowledge plus those around you

  • Adaptability to change and willingness to embrace new ideas and processes

  • Positive and approachable manner

  • Excellent team player

job.title: Womens Sport Psychologist
job.location: The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR, GB
job.html_description:
Salary: Please state your expectations within your application

Contract: Part Time, Fixed Term until 30th June 2027

Location: The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR

Department: Forest Women

Reporting to: Head of Women and Girls Football

Closing Date For Applications: 1st October

About the Role:

As the Lead Sport Psychologist for the Women’s Team, you will implement a psychology program focused on building an elite performance culture. Your responsibilities include collaborating with coaches and multidisciplinary staff to integrate a unified psychological framework, utilising Spotlight Profiling for development, managing player mental health screenings, and supporting players through transitions, injuries, and loans. Additionally, you will drive your own professional growth through external club visits and international sports relationships.

The Perks of the Job:

  • Opportunity to access tickets for events at The City Ground.

  • Employee Assistance Programme.

  • Access to high street and gym discounts.

  • Discount within our Club shop.

  • Free on-site parking.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

Player Support

  • Individual Support: Deliver regular 1-to-1 sessions, applying psychological practice to help players shape inner experiences, meet game demands, and navigate challenges, uncertainty, and high-pressure situations with flexibility.

  • Team Workshops: Deliver group sessions and team workshops, implementing a psychological syllabus to drive performance and ensure consistent on- and off-pitch values.

  • Transitions: Provide support across key career and life stages, including injury, selection, maternity, career changes, retirement, new signings, departures, and loans

  • Leadership Group: Contribute insight, strategy, and advocacy to develop leaders, shaping a progressive, person-centred, and high-performing future.

Staff Support

  • Player Profiles: Utilise Spotlight Profiles to help staff understand how to work effectively with different player profiles.

  • Department Collaboration: Collaborate closely within the MDT and performance staff to align everyday environments with psychological principles, establishing a unified language and methodology.

  • Individual Support: Provide psychological support and development for staff members.

  • Staff Workshops: Deliver staff workshops and development sessions using Spotlight Profiling for staff.

Cross-Club Collaboration

  • Cross-Club Alignment: Work alongside the First Team psychologist and club systems to install a club-wide psychology methodology and language across the club.

What are we looking for:

  • Postgraduate degree in Psychology or Sport Psychology

  • Member of the Health and Care Professions Council (HCPC)

  • FA Safeguarding Children

  • Experience of working in an elite sporting environment

  • Experience of working in Academy football

  • Mental Health First Aid Qualification

  • UK Anti-Doping Introduction to Clean Sport Certificate

job.title: NXT GEN Head Coach
job.location: The City Ground, Nottingham, NG2 5FJ, GB
job.html_description:
Salary: Please state your expectations within your application

Location: The City Ground, Nottingham, NG2 5FJ

Department: Nottingham Forest Netball

Reporting to: Netball Head Coach

Closing Date For Applications: 2nd October 2026

About the Role:

Nottingham Forest Netball is seeking an ambitious, inspiring and forward-thinking NXT GEN Head Coach to lead the next generation of athletes within our performance pathway. The NXT GEN programme is a key part of Nottingham Forest Netball's performance structure, designed to identify, develop and prepare emerging athletes for the demands of elite domestic netball and, ultimately, the Netball Super League and international pathways. This is an exciting opportunity for an outstanding coach to play a significant role in shaping the future of Nottingham Forest Netball.

The successful candidate will be responsible for creating a high-performance environment in which athletes are challenged, supported and empowered to reach their potential both on and off court.

We are looking for a coach who can combine technical excellence, athlete development, leadership and culture-building, while aligning closely with the wider Nottingham Forest Netball performance philosophy.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Lead the planning, delivery and review of the NXT GEN programme.

  • Develop athletes technically, tactically, physically and psychologically.

  • Create an environment that promotes high standards, accountability, learning and enjoyment.

  • Develop a clear and identifiable Nottingham Forest style of play.

  • Support athletes to understand the demands of elite and professional netball.

  • Identify and maximise individual athlete potential.

  • Establish a clear pathway between NXT GEN, the Nottingham Forest Netball NSL programme and wider England Netball pathways.

  • Work collaboratively with the Nottingham Forest Netball Head Coach, performance staff, pathway coaches and wider support team.

  • Contribute to the long-term development of Nottingham Forest Netball's player pathway.

Coaching & Performance

  • Lead all NXT GEN training sessions and competitive fixtures.

  • Develop and implement a clear coaching and playing philosophy aligned to Nottingham Forest Netball.

  • Plan progressive training programmes that challenge athletes and support individual development.

  • Deliver high-quality technical and tactical coaching.

  • Prepare the team effectively for competition through detailed opposition analysis, tactical planning and match preparation.

  • Review team and individual performance using appropriate performance analysis tools.

  • Set clear expectations around preparation, professionalism, behaviour and performance.

  • Establish an environment where athletes are encouraged to take ownership of their development.

  • Ensure training intensity and standards reflect the demands of elite netball.

  • Continually evaluate and evolve the programme in response to athlete and team needs.

Athlete Development

  • The successful candidate will place athlete development at the heart of the programme.

  • They will:

  • Create individual development plans for athletes.

  • Identify individual strengths, areas for improvement and performance goals.

  • Support athletes in developing the technical, tactical and physical qualities required for senior netball.

  • Encourage athletes to develop game understanding, decision-making and tactical awareness.

  • Help athletes develop resilience, confidence, leadership and accountability.

  • Prepare athletes for the physical and psychological demands of high-performance sport.

  • Support athletes to understand the behaviours and standards expected within an elite environment.

  • Provide regular feedback and meaningful opportunities for reflection and learning.

  • Recognise that athlete development is individual and should be tailored to the needs, ambitions and stage of each player.

  • The Head Coach should be passionate about developing people as well as developing players.

Pathway Development

  • A fundamental responsibility of the role will be to create a clear and sustainable pathway for emerging athletes.

  • The Head Coach will:

  • Identify athletes with the potential to progress into NSL elite netball.

  • Work closely with the Nottingham Forest Netball senior programme to support transition into NSL environments.

  • Maintain strong relationships with the NXT GEN development and U19 pathway.

  • Collaborate with England Netball pathway structures and other relevant performance programmes.

  • Support athletes who are selected for England pathway and other international opportunities.

  • Ensure the programme provides appropriate preparation for athletes progressing to higher levels.

  • Create opportunities for NXT GEN athletes to experience senior training environments where appropriate.

  • Work closely with senior coaches to ensure continuity in playing philosophy, language and expectations.

  • Nottingham Forests pathway philosophy places significant importance on developing a sustainable pipeline of athletes and creating seamless progression from age-group and development environments into senior performance, alongside the development of home-grown talent. The Nottingham Forest NXT GEN Head Coach will be central to delivering that ambition within the club. 

Leadership & Culture

  • Establish a positive, ambitious and inclusive team culture.

  • Set and maintain high standards of behaviour and professionalism.

  • Develop strong relationships with athletes and staff.

  • Create an environment where athletes feel valued, challenged and supported.

  • Promote accountability and personal responsibility.

  • Encourage athletes to embrace challenge and learn from setbacks.

  • Develop future leaders within the group.

  • Role-model the values and behaviours expected across Nottingham Forest Netball.

  • Ensure the NXT GEN programme contributes positively to the wider identity and culture of the club.

  • We want our athletes to leave the NXT GEN programme as better netballers, better teammates and better people.

Performance Support & Multidisciplinary Working

  • The Head Coach will work collaboratively with the wider Nottingham Forest Netball performance team.

  • This may include:

  • Strength & conditioning

  • Performance analysis

  • Medical and physiotherapy support

  • Nutrition

  • Psychology / wellbeing

  • Talent identification and pathway staff

  • Senior coaching staff

  • NXT GEN Development/ U19 / academy coaching staff

  • The Head Coach will ensure that support services are effectively integrated into the athlete development programme and that communication between coaches and support staff is consistent and purposeful.

Recruitment & Talent Identification

  • The Head Coach will contribute to the identification and recruitment of athletes capable of progressing through the Nottingham Forest Netball pathway.

  • Responsibilities may include:

  • Supporting player identification and recruitment.

  • Attending relevant competitions and talent events.

  • Building relationships with clubs, schools, universities and pathway programmes.

  • Monitoring emerging talent within the region and nationally.

  • Contributing to selection processes.

  • Ensuring selection decisions are transparent, objective and aligned to programme requirements.

Communication & Stakeholder Management

  • The successful candidate will build strong relationships across the Nottingham Forest Netball environment.

  • They will communicate effectively with:

  • Head of Netball Operations

  • Franchise Pathway Lead

  • Athletes

  • Parents/guardians where appropriate

  • Nottingham Forest Netball senior coaching staff

  • NXT GEN development and U19 coaches

  • Performance support staff

  • England Netball pathway personnel

  • University partners

  • Clubs and talent development organisations

  • Wider Nottingham Forest Netball stakeholders

  • The Head Coach will be expected to represent Nottingham Forest Netball professionally and positively at all times.

Planning, Review & Evaluation

  • The Head Coach will take responsibility for the effective planning and evaluation of the programme.

  • Annual and seasonal planning.

  • Training plans.

  • Competition preparation.

  • Individual athlete development plans.

  • Performance reviews.

  • Selection processes.

  • Post-match analysis.

  • Programme evaluation.

  • Reporting on athlete progression.

  • Setting measurable objectives for the team and individual athletes.

  • Success will not be measured solely by results. The Head Coach will be expected to demonstrate clear evidence of athlete progression, programme quality and pathway outcomes.

What are we looking for:

Essential

  • We are looking for an individual who can demonstrate:

  • Experience within NPL, NXT GEN, or equivalent high-performance environments.

  • Level 2 England Netball coaching qualification.

  • Strong technical and tactical knowledge of the game.

  • Experience of developing young or emerging athletes.

  • An understanding of the demands of elite performance environments.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Strong leadership and organisational ability.

  • The ability to create positive, challenging and inclusive environments.

  • Experience of planning, delivering and reviewing structured training programmes.

  • The ability to provide clear, constructive and individualised feedback.

  • A commitment to safeguarding and athlete wellbeing.

  • A commitment to continuing professional development.

Desirable

  • Experience within NSL or equivalent high-performance environments.

  • Level 3 England Netball coaching qualification.

  • Experience of coaching athletes within an England Netball pathway.

  • Experience of working within a multidisciplinary performance team.

  • Performance analysis experience.

  • Experience of talent identification and recruitment.

  • Experience of developing individual athlete development plans.

  • Previous experience of working within a professional sporting organisation.

  • A strong network within the domestic netball pathway.

Forest For Everyone

We aim to create a culture which embraces and celebrates our differences, enables individuals to feel comfortable, maximise their potential and eliminate discrimination.

Nottingham Forest Football Club is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified persons, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marital / civil partnership status, pregnancy / maternity leave, race, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

The results of any check will be considered on an individual basis, and the Club will act proportionately in deciding whether to proceed with the appointment. Salary: Please state your expectations within your application
Location: The City Ground, Nottingham, NG2 5FJ
Department: Nottingham Forest Netball
Reporting to: Netball Head Coach
Closing Date For Applications: 2nd October 2026
About the Role:
Nottingham Forest Netball is seeking an ambitious, inspiring and forward-thinking NXT GEN Head Coach to lead the next generation of athletes within our performance pathway. The NXT GEN programme is a key part of Nottingham Forest Netball's performance structure, designed to identify, develop and prepare emerging athletes for the demands of elite domestic netball and, ultimately, the Netball Super League and international pathways. This is an exciting opportunity for an outstanding coach to play a significant role in shaping the future of Nottingham Forest Netball.
The successful candidate will be responsible for creating a high-performance environment in which athletes are challenged, supported and empowered to reach their potential both on and off court.
We are looking for a coach who can combine technical excellence, athlete development, leadership and culture-building, while aligning closely with the wider Nottingham Forest Netball performance philosophy.
Key Tasks and Responsibilities:
- Lead the planning, delivery and review of the NXT GEN programme. - Develop athletes technically, tactically, physically and psychologically. - Create an environment that promotes high standards, accountability, learning and enjoyment. - Develop a clear and identifiable Nottingham Forest style of play. - Support athletes to understand the demands of elite and professional netball. - Identify and maximise individual athlete potential. - Establish a clear pathway between NXT GEN, the Nottingham Forest Netball NSL programme and wider England Netball pathways. - Work collaboratively with the Nottingham Forest Netball Head Coach, performance staff, pathway coaches and wider support team. - Contribute to the long-term development of Nottingham Forest Netball's player pathway.
Coaching & Performance
- Lead all NXT GEN training sessions and competitive fixtures. - Develop and implement a clear coaching and playing philosophy aligned to Nottingham Forest Netball. - Plan progressive training programmes that challenge athletes and support individual development. - Deliver high-quality technical and tactical coaching. - Prepare the team effectively for competition through detailed opposition analysis, tactical planning and match preparation. - Review team and individual performance using appropriate performance analysis tools. - Set clear expectations around preparation, professionalism, behaviour and performance. - Establish an environment where athletes are encouraged to take ownership of their development. - Ensure training intensity and standards reflect the demands of elite netball. - Continually evaluate and evolve the programme in response to athlete and team needs.
Athlete Development
- The successful candidate will place athlete development at the heart of the programme. - They will: - Create individual development plans for athletes. - Identify individual strengths, areas for improvement and performance goals. - Support athletes in developing the technical, tactical and physical qualities required for senior netball. - Encourage athletes to develop game understanding, decision-making and tactical awareness. - Help athletes develop resilience, confidence, leadership and accountability. - Prepare athletes for the physical and psychological demands of high-performance sport. - Support athletes to understand the behaviours and standards expected within an elite environment. - Provide regular feedback and meaningful opportunities for reflection and learning. - Recognise that athlete development is individual and should be tailored to the needs, ambitions and stage of each player. - The Head Coach should be passionate about developing people as well as developing players.
Pathway Development
- A fundamental responsibility of the role will be to create a clear and sustainable pathway for emerging athletes. - The Head Coach will: - Identify athletes with the potential to progress into NSL elite netball. - Work closely with the Nottingham Forest Netball senior programme to support transition into NSL environments. - Maintain strong relationships with the NXT GEN development and U19 pathway. - Collaborate with England Netball pathway structures and other relevant performance programmes. - Support athletes who are selected for England pathway and other international opportunities. - Ensure the programme provides appropriate preparation for athletes progressing to higher levels. - Create opportunities for NXT GEN athletes to experience senior training environments where appropriate. - Work closely with senior coaches to ensure continuity in playing philosophy, language and expectations. - Nottingham Forests pathway philosophy places significant importance on developing a sustainable pipeline of athletes and creating seamless progression from age-group and development environments into senior performance, alongside the development of home-grown talent. The Nottingham Forest NXT GEN Head Coach will be central to delivering that ambition within the club.
Leadership & Culture
- Establish a positive, ambitious and inclusive team culture. - Set and maintain high standards of behaviour and professionalism. - Develop strong relationships with athletes and staff. - Create an environment where athletes feel valued, challenged and supported. - Promote accountability and personal responsibility. - Encourage athletes to embrace challenge and learn from setbacks. - Develop future leaders within the group. - Role-model the values and behaviours expected across Nottingham Forest Netball. - Ensure the NXT GEN programme contributes positively to the wider identity and culture of the club. - We want our athletes to leave the NXT GEN programme as better netballers, better teammates and better people.
Performance Support & Multidisciplinary Working
- The Head Coach will work collaboratively with the wider Nottingham Forest Netball performance team. - This may include: - Strength & conditioning - Performance analysis - Medical and physiotherapy support - Nutrition - Psychology / wellbeing - Talent identification and pathway staff - Senior coaching staff - NXT GEN Development/ U19 / academy coaching staff - The Head Coach will ensure that support services are effectively integrated into the athlete development programme and that communication between coaches and support staff is consistent and purposeful.
Recruitment & Talent Identification
- The Head Coach will contribute to the identification and recruitment of athletes capable of progressing through the Nottingham Forest Netball pathway. - Responsibilities may include: - Supporting player identification and recruitment. - Attending relevant competitions and talent events. - Building relationships with clubs, schools, universities and pathway programmes. - Monitoring emerging talent within the region and nationally. - Contributing to selection processes. - Ensuring selection decisions are transparent, objective and aligned to programme requirements.
Communication & Stakeholder Management
- The successful candidate will build strong relationships across the Nottingham Forest Netball environment. - They will communicate effectively with: - Head of Netball Operations - Franchise Pathway Lead - Athletes - Parents/guardians where appropriate - Nottingham Forest Netball senior coaching staff - NXT GEN development and U19 coaches - Performance support staff - England Netball pathway personnel - University partners - Clubs and talent development organisations - Wider Nottingham Forest Netball stakeholders - The Head Coach will be expected to represent Nottingham Forest Netball professionally and positively at all times.
Planning, Review & Evaluation
- The Head Coach will take responsibility for the effective planning and evaluation of the programme. - Annual and seasonal planning. - Training plans. - Competition preparation. - Individual athlete development plans. - Performance reviews. - Selection processes. - Post-match analysis. - Programme evaluation. - Reporting on athlete progression. - Setting measurable objectives for the team and individual athletes. - Success will not be measured solely by results. The Head Coach will be expected to demonstrate clear evidence of athlete progression, programme quality and pathway outcomes.
What are we looking for:
Essential
- We are looking for an individual who can demonstrate: - Experience within NPL, NXT GEN, or equivalent high-performance environments. - Level 2 England Netball coaching qualification. - Strong technical and tactical knowledge of the game. - Experience of developing young or emerging athletes. - An understanding of the demands of elite performance environments. - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. - Strong leadership and organisational ability. - The ability to create positive, challenging and inclusive environments. - Experience of planning, delivering and reviewing structured training programmes. - The ability to provide clear, constructive and individualised feedback. - A commitment to safeguarding and athlete wellbeing. - A commitment to continuing professional development.
Desirable
- Experience within NSL or equivalent high-performance environments. - Level 3 England Netball coaching qualification. - Experience of coaching athletes within an England Netball pathway. - Experience of working within a multidisciplinary performance team. - Performance analysis experience. - Experience of talent identification and recruitment. - Experience of developing individual athlete development plans. - Previous experience of working within a professional sporting organisation. - A strong network within the domestic netball pathway.
Forest For Everyone

job.html_description:
Location: The City Ground, Nottingham, NG2 5FJ

Department: Frest Netball

Reporting to: Netball Head Coach

Closing Date For Applications: 2nd October 2026

About the Role:

Nottingham Forest Netball is seeking an ambitious, collaborative and development-focused coach to join our performance environment in the dual role of NSL Assistant Coach and NXT GEN Assistant Coach.

This is a unique opportunity to work across two interconnected levels of the Nottingham Forest Netball performance pathway, supporting both the performance of our senior NSL programme and the development of the next generation of athletes.

The successful candidate will play an important role in creating a clear and connected pathway from emerging talent through to NSL elite netball.

Working closely with both the NSL Head Coach and NXT GEN Head Coach, the Assistant Coach will contribute to the planning and delivery of high-performance training, match preparation, performance review and individual athlete development.

The role will require someone who can operate effectively in both a senior performance environment and an athlete development environment, understanding when to challenge, when to support and how to adapt their coaching approach to the needs of different athletes.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

NSL Assistant Coach

  • Supporting the planning and delivery of NSL training sessions.

  • Contributing to weekly training plans and session design.

  • Delivering individual, unit and small-group coaching.

  • Providing technical and tactical feedback to athletes.

  • Supporting the implementation of the team's playing philosophy.

  • Assisting with opposition preparation and analysis.

  • Contributing to match-day tactical planning.

  • Supporting the Head Coach with in-game decision-making and tactical adjustments.

  • Observing and analysing performance during matches.

  • Contributing to post-match review and evaluation.

  • Supporting individual athlete development within the NSL squad.

  • Maintaining high standards of professionalism, preparation and performance.

  • Contributing to selection discussions where appropriate.

  • Supporting the Head Coach in creating a positive, challenging and high-performance environment.

NXT GEN Assistant Coach

  • Supporting the planning and delivery of NXT GEN training sessions.

  • Delivering technical and tactical coaching.

  • Supporting individual athlete development plans.

  • Providing regular, constructive and athlete-centred feedback.

  • Helping athletes understand the demands of NSL-level netball.

  • Supporting the development of tactical understanding and decision-making.

  • Creating opportunities for athletes to develop leadership and accountability.

  • Supporting match preparation and competitive performance.

  • Contributing to opposition analysis and post-match review.

  • Monitoring individual athlete progress.

  • Identifying athletes who may be ready for increased exposure to the NSL environment.

  • Supporting appropriate transition opportunities between NXT GEN and NSL.

  • Helping athletes understand and demonstrate the behaviours required within a high-performance environment.

Connecting the NSL & NXT GEN Pathway

  • A key responsibility of this dual role will be to ensure that the two programmes are connected rather than operating independently.

  • The Assistant Coach will:

  • Maintain strong communication between the NSL and NXT GEN coaching teams.

  • Promote consistency in coaching language and terminology.

  • Support alignment of technical and tactical principles.

  • Help NXT GEN athletes understand the expectations of the NSL environment.

  • Identify opportunities for NXT GEN athletes to train with or observe the NSL programme.

  • Provide feedback to NXT GEN coaches following athlete exposure to the senior environment.

  • Support the transition of NXT GEN athletes into NSL training and competition where appropriate.

  • Help identify future NSL athletes through observation and assessment.

  • Share relevant performance observations with the appropriate coaching and support staff.

  • Contribute to long-term succession planning within Nottingham Forest Netball.

Athlete Development

  • Build positive and professional relationships with athletes.

  • Understand the individual needs, ambitions and development areas of players.

  • Provide clear and constructive feedback.

  • Challenge athletes appropriately.

  • Encourage athletes to take ownership of their development.

  • Help athletes develop technical consistency and tactical awareness.

  • Develop decision-making under pressure.

  • Support athletes in developing resilience and confidence.

  • Encourage leadership and accountability.

  • Support athletes in understanding the demands of elite sport.

  • Contribute to individual development plans and reviews.

  • Track athlete progression and identify emerging potential.

Coaching & Technical Development

The Assistant Coach will be expected to demonstrate strong technical and tactical knowledge and contribute actively to the evolution of Nottingham Forest's playing philosophy.

This will include:

  • Technical skill development.

  • Position-specific coaching.

  • Tactical understanding.

  • Decision-making.

  • Transition play.

  • Attacking and defensive principles.

  • Unit combinations.

  • Set-piece and restart strategies.

  • Game management.

  • Understanding of opposition.

  • Developing players' ability to read and respond to the game.

Match-Day Responsibilities

The Assistant Coach will support the Head Coach on match days across both programmes.

This may include:

  • Pre-match preparation.

  • Opposition analysis.

  • Warm-up support.

  • Individual player preparation.

  • Bench management.

  • Live tactical observation.

  • Statistical and performance information.

  • Half-time analysis and feedback.

  • Supporting tactical changes.

  • Post-match review.

  • Player feedback.

Performance Analysis

  • Reviewing match footage.

  • Analysing opposition.

  • Identifying tactical trends.

  • Reviewing individual and team performance.

  • Supporting video review sessions.

  • Providing coaches and athletes with relevant performance information.

  • Using analysis to inform future training sessions.

  • Identifying recurring performance trends and development priorities.

Multidisciplinary Working

The Assistant Coach will work closely with Nottingham Forest Netball's wider performance team.

This may include:

  • Strength & conditioning staff

  • Physiotherapy and medical staff

  • Performance analysis

  • Psychology / wellbeing

  • Nutrition

  • Talent identification

  • Pathway coaches

  • Senior coaching staff

Culture & Leadership

  • Model professionalism and high standards.

  • Promote a positive and inclusive environment.

  • Build trust and strong relationships.

  • Challenge inappropriate behaviours.

  • Encourage accountability.

  • Promote learning and reflection.

  • Support athlete wellbeing.

  • Develop leadership within the playing group.

  • Demonstrate integrity and professionalism at all times.

  • Represent Nottingham Forest Netball positively.

  • The Assistant Coach should be someone athletes want to learn from and want to be around, while still being willing to challenge them to improve.

Talent Identification & Recruitment

  • Watching relevant competitions.

  • Supporting trials and selection processes.

  • Monitoring NXT GEN and pathway athletes.

  • Identifying emerging talent.

  • Building relationships with clubs, schools, universities and other performance programmes.

  • Providing informed feedback on prospective athletes.

  • Supporting long-term recruitment planning.

What are we looking for:

Essential

  • The successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • Recognised Level 2 England Netball coaching qualification.

  • Experience coaching within NSL/NXT GEN environment or equivalent.

  • Strong technical and tactical knowledge.

  • Experience of developing athletes.

  • Understanding of the transition from pathway to senior performance.

  • Excellent communication skills.

  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

  • Ability to work collaboratively within a coaching team.

  • Ability to provide clear and constructive feedback.

  • Strong organisational and planning skills.

  • Commitment to safeguarding and athlete welfare.

  • Commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion.

  • Commitment to continuing professional development.

Desirable

  • Coaching at international level.

  • Recognised Level 3 England Netball coaching qualification.

  • England Netball pathway environments.

  • Working with Future Roses / England pathway athletes.

  • Multidisciplinary performance environments.

  • Performance analysis.

  • Talent identification.

  • Individual athlete development planning.

  • Senior match-day coaching.

  • Supporting athlete transition between pathway and senior environments.

Forest For Everyone

We aim to create a culture which embraces and celebrates our differences, enables individuals to feel comfortable, maximise their potential and eliminate discrimination.

Nottingham Forest Football Club is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified persons, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marital / civil partnership status, pregnancy / maternity leave, race, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Nottingham Forest Football Club is a signatory of the FA’s Football Leadership Diversity Code. We are committed to developing policies to promote equal opportunities and diversity within our workforce. To monitor our progress against these commitments, we Invite all applicants to provide diversity data during the application process.

Disability Confident Committed Employer

We are a Disability Confident Committed employer. We encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions. If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a "disabled person" according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment selections.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

As part of the Club’s commitment to safeguarding, the successful applicant may be required to undergo a Disclosure Barring Service (“DBS”) check. The level of check required will depend on the requirements of the role. Individuals will be asked to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, warnings or bind-overs that they are required to disclose for the level of check applicable to the role, in accordance with the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 (as amended) and the DBS filtering rules. The results of any check will be considered on an individual basis, and the Club will act proportionately in deciding whether to proceed with the appointment. The Club reserves the right to carry out risk assessments where content has been disclosed if it feels that it is relevant to the job requirements of the role. Failure to satisfy the Club, FA’s and the PL's safeguarding requirements may lead to the job offer being withdrawn or, if they have already started employment, summary termination of the employment, in accordance with the Club's disciplinary procedures

Health and Safety

Nottingham Forest is committed to maintaining a safe and healthy working environment for all employees, contractors, visitors, and guests. All employees are expected to comply with company health and safety policies, procedures and risk assessments, use equipment and PPE correctly and report any hazards, accidents and near misses. Appropriate training will be provided to ensure everyone understands their health and safety responsibilities.

job.title: Academy Psychology Lead
job.location: The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR, GB
job.html_description:
Salary: Please state your expectations within your application

Contract: Full Time, 42 hours a week

Location: The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR

Department: Academy Player Care and Wellbeing

Reporting to: Academy Player Care and Wellbeing Lead

Closing Date For Applications: 6th October 2026

About the Role:

Lead the strategic delivery of psychology services to our Academy teams with a specific focus on the Boys Pathway (FP, YDP, PDP), Loans and Transition ensuring clarity of strategy and a consistent, complimentary approach for all Psychology services.

Working closely with the Academy Psychologist (U9s - U18s), you will manage the delivery of psychological support and development for all players, parents and staff across the Academy.

You will work closely with key staff within the Men’s First Team & Academy programmes to ensure a support pathway is present for players transitioning into either first team environments or progression to other clubs / career pathways.

The Perks of the Job:

  • Opportunity to access tickets for events at The City Ground.

  • Employee Assistance Programme.

  • Access to high street and gym discounts.

  • Discount within our Club shop.

  • Free on-site parking.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Lead Psychologist with a focus in the development and support of Academy players throughout the pathway (FP, YDP and PDP).

  • Specialist focus upon the development and performances of B Team players and staff through a range of support mechanisms including 1:1s and group sessions.

  • Work closely with the Player Pathway Manager in supporting loan players and within the transition to the first team or progression to other professional clubs.

  • Assist with any transitional periods for players such as onboarding of new signings and the progression support of current B Team players.

  • Lead the development and implementation of B Team IDP’s Mind Sections using Player Grading and observations to inform individual development plans.

  • Management of Academy Psychologist (U9s – U18s) and oversee the delivery of the syllabus throughout the FP, YDP & PDP.

  • Lead on an academy-wide transition strategy to help support the player journey through close MDT working and excellent departmental collaboration.

  • Assist with the preparation of retain and release decisions for all academy players working closely with the Academy Player Care and Wellbeing Lead, and Academy Psychologist (U9s – U18s).

  • Work collaboratively with the Academy Player Care & Wellbeing Lead in providing excellent after-care support and the development of an Academy Alumni programme.

  • Actively contribute as a member of the Safeguarding, Welfare, Education and Psychology (SWEP) team.

  • Contribute through both consultation and delivery of the Shared Space Mental Health Strategy & Action Plan to ensure e ective implementation in the academy.

  • Lead the Mental Health Screening process for all PDP players.

  • Support academy staff to continually enhance the working culture and promote an environment that supports positive mental health and wellbeing for young people.

  • Lead on the delivery of the Academy strategy relating to the Psychology provision ensuring it is live, reviewed, communicated and that strategic pillars, objectives and performance indicators are monitored with appropriate intervention and action where required.

  • Work closely with MDT staff to enhance the application of the psychological syllabus and skills through integration within the academy environment.

  • Produce monthly, quarterly and annual report in line with the strategy for the Head of Academy and Academy Management Team.

  • Responsible for leading academy audit preparation, annual reviews and ongoing compliance across Premier League, FA, UEFA and FIFA regulations within the Psychology area.

  • In conjunction with the Academy Player Care & Wellbeing Lead and Assistant Academy Manager lead on an enhanced programme for staff development to support all members academy staff.

  • Continued Academy-wide staff and team development through the implementation of Spotlight Profiling.

  • Continual professional development through external club visits, best-practice sport experiences and maintaining relationships with International Sports Organisations.

What are we looking for:

Essential:

  • Postgraduate degree in Psychology or Sport Psychology

  • Member of the Health and Care Professions Council (HCPC)

  • FA Safeguarding Children

  • Experience of working in an elite sporting environment

  • Experience of working in academy football

  • Experience supporting athletes, coaches and multi-disciplinary teams

  • Experience of supporting player transitions and long-term athlete development

Desirable:

  • Mindflick Spotlight Accreditation

  • Mental Health First Aid Qualification

  • UK Anti-Doping Introduction to Clean Sport Certificate

Forest For Everyone

We aim to create a culture which embraces and celebrates our differences, enables individuals to feel comfortable, maximise their potential and eliminate discrimination.

Nottingham Forest Football Club is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified persons, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marital / civil partnership status, pregnancy / maternity leave, race, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Nottingham Forest Football Club is a signatory of the FA’s Football Leadership Diversity Code. We are committed to developing policies to promote equal opportunities and diversity within our workforce. To monitor our progress against these commitments, we Invite all applicants to provide diversity data during the application process.

Disability Confident Committed Employer

We are a Disability Confident Committed employer.  We encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions.  If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a "disabled person" according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below.  The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment selections.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

As part of the Club’s commitment to safeguarding, the successful applicant may be required to undergo a Disclosure Barring Service (“DBS”) check. The level of check required will depend on the requirements of the role. Individuals will be asked to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, warnings or bind-overs that they are required to disclose for the level of check applicable to the role, in accordance with the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 (as amended) and the DBS filtering rules. The results of any check will be considered on an individual basis, and the Club will act proportionately in deciding whether to proceed with the appointment. The Club reserves the right to carry out risk assessments where content has been disclosed if it feels that it is relevant to the job requirements of the role. Failure to satisfy the Club, FA’s and the PL's safeguarding requirements may lead to the job offer being withdrawn or, if they have already started employment, summary termination of the employment, in accordance with the Club's disciplinary procedures

Health and Safety

Nottingham Forest is committed to maintaining a safe and healthy working environment for all employees, contractors, visitors, and guests. All employees are expected to comply with company health and safety policies, procedures and risk assessments, use equipment and PPE correctly and report any hazards, accidents and near misses. Appropriate training will be provided to ensure everyone understands their health and safety responsibilities.

job.title: HR Financial & Payroll Expert
job.html_description:
Job information
Division/Unit: Services / HR Operations
Contract type: Permanent (80-100%)
Location: Nyon (up to one day working from home per week)
Start date: 01.12.2026
Application deadline: 02.10.2026

Main goal

Are you a payroll and finance professional who enjoys combining technical expertise with meaningful people impact?

Then join us as our next HR Financial & Payroll Expert. Your role will be to ensure accurate payroll management, provide financial analysis to support business decisions, and manage workforce budgeting and forecasting.

Through close collaboration with the HR and Finance teams, you will help ensure compliance with policies and procedures, contribute to HR projects, and support the effective management of employee-related financial matters across UEFA.

Key responsibilities

  • Delivering accurate staff‑cost budgets and forecasts, anticipating workforce changes.
  • Ensuring accurate, timely and compliant monthly payroll delivery, in line with Swiss labour law and social security requirements.
  • Supporting strong governance by ensuring robust compliance and risk management across payroll, benefits and HR policies, including coordinating audits, and reporting reliably to UEFA's finance division, internal and external auditors and the competent authorities.
  • Providing UEFA's HR business partners and managers with expert advice on payroll and other matters relating to compensation and benefits, ensuring consistent application of the relevant guidelines.
  • Supporting employees with clear guidance on social security, pension, retirement and tax matters, improving understanding and compliance.
  • Partnering on organisation-wide HR initiatives that strengthen people practices, support workforce decisions and shape the future of work at UEFA.
  • Drive continuous improvement, standardisation and operational excellence across payroll, compensation and benefits processes.

Requirements

Experience

  • At least 7 years' experience handling payroll, compensation, social insurance and tax in a Swiss corporate environment.
  • Proven ability to maintain a robust, transparent HR financial infrastructure (budgeting, reporting and audit support).
  • Previous experience within an international organisation, ideally of comparable scale and complexity.
  • Experience with SAP or similar HRIS/payroll solutions.

Education:

  • University degree in Finance, Business Administration, human resources or similar field
  • Further education in human resources (e.g. Swiss brevet fédéral), pensions/insurance, finance or HRIS is an advantage.

Languages:

  • English: Proficient
  • French: Proficient

Other requirements:

  • Excellent knowledge of HR & Financial processes
  • Financial background
  • Ability to take initiative and lead projects with accountability and turn ideas into impactful results.
  • Strong commitment to service excellence and quality
  • High level of integrity, discretion and sound judgment, especially when handling sensitive HR and payroll information.
  • Advanced knowledge of MS Office
  • The successful candidate will be expected to be resident in Switzerland or nearby France.

Want to stay updated on our latest job opportunities, events, and behind-the-scenes insights? Join us on LinkedIn.

UEFA welcomes applications from all, actively working to ensure that we are an inclusive employer that finds the best candidate for our positions, regardless of aspects such as sex, gender identification, disability, age, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity or nationality.

Apply now and join UEFAPeople

job.title: EURO HB Live Producer
job.html_description:
Job information
Division/Unit: Marketing / Live Production and Editorial Content Services
Contract type: Max-term
Location: Nyon (WFH up to one day per week)

This role is based at UEFA’s Headquarters in Nyon, Switzerland for the UEFA EURO 2028 tournament. If you are looking for roles based in the UK & Ireland, please visit the UK & Ireland 2028 Limited page.

Start date: 01.02.2027
End date: 31.07.2028
Application deadline: 24.09.2026

Main goal

Working as part of the Live Production team to plan and implement the UEFA EURO 2028 host broadcast production plan.

Key responsibilities

  • Working on all aspects of live production for EURO 2028, in collaboration with UEFA's host broadcast venue operations and broadcast engineering teams
  • Coordinating with the appointed production teams and liaising with the technical suppliers during the preparation phase
  • Assisting with production-related documents (e.g. running orders, feeds plans, camera movements, workflows) and production team schedules
  • Preparing content for EURO 2028 workshops, briefings and manuals
  • Acting as live producer with one of the production teams or Quality Control Producer in the international broadcast centre during the tournament, ensuring the on-site delivery of the host broadcast production plan
  • Supporting production and providing editorial assistance across all UEFA competitions
  • Monitoring events from UEFA's match command centre and providing ad hoc on-site support for host broadcasts of matches throughout the season
  • Taking on the role of Host Broadcast Live Producer for one of UEFA's finals, including liaising with the TV domain leader and the host broadcast manager to prepare for the event, ensuring delivery on-site and overseeing all host broadcast elements of the multilateral feed

Requirements

Experience:

  • 4 to 6 years working in a live sport broadcast environment
  • 1 to 3 years working as a live sports producer, director, AP or other relevant live editorial role

Languages:

  • Proficient in English

Other requirements:

  • Solid understanding of all the elements of a sports outside broadcast
  • Good knowledge of new broadcast technologies, camera systems and developments in the broadcast industry
  • Team-oriented approach, with excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to multitask, work under pressure and deal sensitively and confidently with a diverse range of internal and external stakeholders
  • Relocation to Switzerland is expected

Want to stay updated on our latest job opportunities, events, and behind-the-scenes insights? Join us on LinkedIn.

job.title: National Associations Communications Intern
job.html_description:
Job information
Division/Unit: National Associations Communications / Communications
Contract type: Fixed-term
Location: Nyon (up to one day working from home per week)
Start date: 01.12.2026
End date: 31.05.2027
Application deadline: 02.10.2026

Main goal

The National Association Communications Intern will support the National Associations Communications unit in the delivery of two of its flagship projects involving participants from national associations: the UEFA Grow communications conference and the UEFA Strategic Communications Compact Course. The intern will provide logistical support and make meeting arrangements, paying constant attention to the service offered, guest experience and cost effectiveness, with a resolutely solution-oriented attitude.
In addition, they will produce content (presentations, short posts, etc.) for internal and external use and help manage the national association communications community across different platforms.

Key responsibilities

  • Supporting the unit in the delivery of the 2027 UEFA Grow communications conference, coordinating logistical matters with speakers and consultants
  • Helping the NA Communications Manager to successfully implement the eighth edition of the UEFA Strategic Communications Compact Course
  • Coordinating with colleagues and national association counterparts on national associations campaigns, content and stories
  • Supporting the organisation of work trips, workshops and meetings as required
  • Overseeing digital communities and communication platforms used to engage with national association counterparts
  • Creating content such as slides, presentations and posts for internal and external use
  • Managing the national association communications community across different platforms and ensuring that the relevant content repositories are up to date

Requirements

Experience:

  • Professional experience in an international environment, ideally in a marketing, communications, administrative or events role

Education:

  • Bachelor's in communications, marketing or business administration is a strong asset

Languages:

  • English / Advanced
  • Any other European language would be an asset

Other requirements:

- Understanding of and interest in the football landscape

- Strong MS Office skills

Contract type: Max-Term
Location: Nyon (WFH up to one day per week)

Provide administrative, logistical and operational support to the UEFA EURO Training & Knowledge team, assisting with the preparation and delivery of training, readiness, knowledge transfer, debriefing and learning activities.

  • Strong organisational and documentation skills

job.title: EURO Central Services Team Leader
job.html_description:
Job information
Division/Unit: Club CompetitionsOperations & Events /Logistics Operations
Contract type: Max-Term
Location: Nyon (WFH up to one day per week)

This role is based at UEFA’s Headquarters in Nyon, Switzerland for the UEFA EURO 28 tournament. If you are looking for roles based in the UK & Ireland, please visit the UK & Ireland 2028 Limited page.

Start date: 01/02/2027
End date: 31/08/2028

Main goal

The Central Services EURO Team Leader is responsible for assessing, planning and coordinating support service logistics for staff and suppliers working on the UEFA EURO 2028 tournament.

A key focus of the role is to lead needs assessments and oversee the planning and allocation of accommodation. The role is also responsible for coordinating travel arrangements for international staff in collaboration with UEFA's in-house travel agency, ensuring all services are planned and booked ahead of the tournament. During the tournament, the EURO Central Services Team Leader will oversee the change management process, coordinating late requests and managing amendments to pre-booked services to ensure efficient service delivery and operational continuity.

Reporting to the Central Services Senior Manager, the role involves close collaboration with a broad range of internal stakeholders and external suppliers. The successful candidate will contribute to a dynamic team environment while ensuring the effective delivery of essential support services across the tournament.

Key responsibilities

  • Managing accommodation requirements and changes to travel bookings
  • Supervising requests from other services
  • Managing training requirements and related services
  • Helping to populate, maintain and update the EURO 2028 staffing plan
